align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.term { font-weight: 600; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment(glossary: game.Glossary) -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    # `text|markdown(lang)`: sanitized HTML, with Game Terms in `lang`.\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = lambda text, lang: render_markdown(text, lang, glossary).html\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None,\n                 glossary: game.Glossary) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment(glossary)\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\")}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        published = guides.published(conn)\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n        glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    # Every Author with a Published Guide gets a page in both trees, even if\n    # none of their Guides has English text.\n    authors = {guide.author_id: guide.author_name for guide in published}\n    write = _Writer(out, current_patch=patches[0].name if patches else None,\n                    glossary=glossary)\n    write.page(\"\", \"site/root.html\")\n    for lang in LANGUAGES:\n        listed = [guide for guide in published if guide.has_text_in(lang)]\n        newest = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.published_at or \"\",\n                        reverse=True)[:NEWEST_ON_HOME]\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/\", \"site/home.html\", lang=lang, guides=newest,\n                   heroes=heroes)\n        for hero in heroes:\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/heroes/{hero.slug}/\", \"site/hero.html\", lang=lang,\n                       hero=hero, patches=by_patch(\n                           [guide for guide in listed if guide.hero_id == hero.id]))\n        for author_id, author_name in authors.items():\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/authors/{author_id}/\", \"site/author.html\", lang=lang,\n                       author_name=author_name,\n                       guides=[guide for guide in listed if guide.author_id == author_id])\n        for guide in listed:\n            # Only English can be missing, since Chinese text is required. The\n            # switch then leads to the Hero's English page, whose notice shows\n            # only when arrived at through this link.\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/guides/{guide.slug}/\", \"site/guide.html\",\n                       lang=lang, guide=guide,\n                       switch_to=None if guide.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                       else f\"heroes/{guide.hero_slug}/#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n    return out\n\n\nclass DeployFailed(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The push to gh-pages failed; the message says why.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\ndef deploy(out: Path, message: str = \"Publish site\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Push `out` to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves.\n    Raises DeployFailed with git's own explanation if the push fails.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", message, str(out)],\n        capture_output=True, text=True)\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        raise DeployFailed(result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip()\n                           or f\"ghp-import exited with {result.returncode}\")\n\n\ndef build_site() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Render the site and put it online. Raises DeployFailed if the push\n    fails, in which case the build is not recorded.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        started_at = conn.execute(f\"SELECT {db.NOW}\").fetchone()[0]\n    out = render_site()\n    deploy(out)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_builds (started_at) VALUES (?)\", (started_at,))\n    return out\n\n\ndef changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides changed since the last successful Site build started\n    (all of them, if there has never been one): Published Guides edited\n    since, Guides Unpublished since, which the next build leaves out, and\n    Published Guides moved to or restored from the Trash since.\"\"\"\n    last = conn.execute(\"SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM site_builds\").fetchone()[0] or \"\"\n    changed = {guide.id for guide in guides.published(conn) if guide.updated_at > last}\n    return len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n               | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step. A database made\nbefore a table gained a column gets the column added on connect (see\nADDED_COLUMNS); a schema change that adding columns can't express needs a new\ntable instead.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\n-- last_login_at was added in T09 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_login_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\n-- nicknames, one per line, were added in T07 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\n-- A Guide is in the Trash while trashed_at is set (added in T06, as is\n-- restored_at; see ADDED_COLUMNS). That is separate from its status, so a\n-- restored Guide comes back exactly as it was; restored_at is when it last\n-- came back.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- A Revision is a pending change to a Published Guide, at most one per Guide.\n-- Publishing it copies it over the Guide and deletes it. base_updated_at is\n-- the Guide's updated_at when the Revision was opened, to tell whether the\n-- Guide changed since. Ids are never reused (AUTOINCREMENT), since review\n-- rounds keep the id of the Revision they Returned after it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    base_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    title_zh   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\n-- Each Return or Unpublish is a review round, kept for the Guide's history.\n-- A Draft with a Return or Unpublish behind it came back to its Author: a\n-- Guide only leaves Submitted or Published for Draft through one.\n-- A Return of a Revision records the Revision's id (revision_id; added in T06,\n-- see ADDED_COLUMNS). It belongs to that Revision while it is open and joins\n-- the Guide's own history once it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_notes (\n    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    quote    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quote != ''),\n    advice   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (advice != '')\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_guide ON review_rounds (guide_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_notes_by_round ON review_notes (round_id);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- Published Guides deleted for good from the Trash. Their rows are gone, so\n-- this is how the dashboard still counts them as a change not on the site.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed_guides (\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    removed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to a table after it was first created: (table, column, type).\n# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an older table as it was, so connect()\n# adds whichever of these it lacks.\nADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    (\"users\", \"last_login_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"trashed_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"restored_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"review_rounds\", \"revision_id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n    (\"game_terms\", \"nicknames\", \"TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\"),\n]\n\n# Indexes on added columns, made once the columns are sure to exist.\nINDEXES = \"\"\"\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_revision ON review_rounds (revision_id);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, column, type_ in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n        existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        if column not in existing:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {type_}\")\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(INDEXES)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | notice | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game, guides, site, trash, users\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.AdminRequired, web.admin_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(game.router)\n    app.include_router(guides.router)\n    app.include_router(site.router)\n    app.include_router(trash.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","is_error":false}]}}

{"parentUuid":"b9fa5fe8-65ed-4d27-8540-c92cab3acdf6","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"c1eb83c5-b84d-415d-ac9b-da0cc5184931","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_018osXHEMQh18bPrTeKkZh2P","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"The Site build: render everything Published into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe site has a Chinese tree (zh/) and an English tree (en/), and every page is\nan index.html in its own folder, so its address is the folder (`zh/guides/\nvanessa-12/`). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is read here. A Draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\ndeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. Only a build whose deploy\nsucceeded is recorded, and the dashboard counts the changes since then.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport itertools\nimport posixpath\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides, settings\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, \"PingFang SC\", \"Microsoft YaHei\", sans-serif;\n       margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.term { font-weight: 600; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment(glossary: game.Glossary) -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    # `text|markdown(lang)`: sanitized HTML, with Game Terms in `lang`.\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = lambda text, lang: render_markdown(text, lang, glossary).html\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None,\n                 glossary: game.Glossary) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment(glossary)\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\")}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        published = guides.published(conn)\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n        glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    # Every Author with a Published Guide gets a page in both trees, even if\n    # none of their Guides has English text.\n    authors = {guide.author_id: guide.author_name for guide in published}\n    write = _Writer(out, current_patch=patches[0].name if patches else None,\n                    glossary=glossary)\n    write.page(\"\", \"site/root.html\")\n    for lang in LANGUAGES:\n        listed = [guide for guide in published if guide.has_text_in(lang)]\n        newest = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.published_at or \"\",\n                        reverse=True)[:NEWEST_ON_HOME]\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/\", \"site/home.html\", lang=lang, guides=newest,\n                   heroes=heroes)\n        for hero in heroes:\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/heroes/{hero.slug}/\", \"site/hero.html\", lang=lang,\n                       hero=hero, patches=by_patch(\n                           [guide for guide in listed if guide.hero_id == hero.id]))\n        for author_id, author_name in authors.items():\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/authors/{author_id}/\", \"site/author.html\", lang=lang,\n                       author_name=author_name,\n                       guides=[guide for guide in listed if guide.author_id == author_id])\n        for guide in listed:\n            # Only English can be missing, since Chinese text is required. The\n            # switch then leads to the Hero's English page, whose notice shows\n            # only when arrived at through this link.\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/guides/{guide.slug}/\", \"site/guide.html\",\n                       lang=lang, guide=guide,\n                       switch_to=None if guide.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                       else f\"heroes/{guide.hero_slug}/#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n    return out\n\n\nclass DeployFailed(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The push to gh-pages failed; the message says why.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\ndef deploy(out: Path, message: str = \"Publish site\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Push `out` to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves.\n    Raises DeployFailed with git's own explanation if the push fails.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", message, str(out)],\n        capture_output=True, text=True)\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        raise DeployFailed(result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip()\n                           or f\"ghp-import exited with {result.returncode}\")\n\n\ndef build_site() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Render the site and put it online. Raises DeployFailed if the push\n    fails, in which case the build is not recorded.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        started_at = conn.execute(f\"SELECT {db.NOW}\").fetchone()[0]\n    out = render_site()\n    deploy(out)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_builds (started_at) VALUES (?)\", (started_at,))\n    return out\n\n\ndef changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides changed since the last successful Site build started\n    (all of them, if there has never been one): Published Guides edited\n    since, Guides Unpublished since, which the next build leaves out, and\n    Published Guides moved to or restored from the Trash since.\"\"\"\n    last = conn.execute(\"SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM site_builds\").fetchone()[0] or \"\"\n    changed = {guide.id for guide in guides.published(conn) if guide.updated_at > last}\n    return len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n               | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step. A database made\nbefore a table gained a column gets the column added on connect (see\nADDED_COLUMNS); a schema change that adding columns can't express needs a new\ntable instead.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\n-- last_login_at was added in T09 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_login_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\n-- nicknames, one per line, were added in T07 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\n-- A Guide is in the Trash while trashed_at is set (added in T06, as is\n-- restored_at; see ADDED_COLUMNS). That is separate from its status, so a\n-- restored Guide comes back exactly as it was; restored_at is when it last\n-- came back.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- A Revision is a pending change to a Published Guide, at most one per Guide.\n-- Publishing it copies it over the Guide and deletes it. base_updated_at is\n-- the Guide's updated_at when the Revision was opened, to tell whether the\n-- Guide changed since. Ids are never reused (AUTOINCREMENT), since review\n-- rounds keep the id of the Revision they Returned after it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    base_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    title_zh   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\n-- Each Return or Unpublish is a review round, kept for the Guide's history.\n-- A Draft with a Return or Unpublish behind it came back to its Author: a\n-- Guide only leaves Submitted or Published for Draft through one.\n-- A Return of a Revision records the Revision's id (revision_id; added in T06,\n-- see ADDED_COLUMNS). It belongs to that Revision while it is open and joins\n-- the Guide's own history once it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_notes (\n    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    quote    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quote != ''),\n    advice   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (advice != '')\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_guide ON review_rounds (guide_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_notes_by_round ON review_notes (round_id);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- Published Guides deleted for good from the Trash. Their rows are gone, so\n-- this is how the dashboard still counts them as a change not on the site.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed_guides (\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    removed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to a table after it was first created: (table, column, type).\n# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an older table as it was, so connect()\n# adds whichever of these it lacks.\nADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    (\"users\", \"last_login_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"trashed_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"restored_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"review_rounds\", \"revision_id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n    (\"game_terms\", \"nicknames\", \"TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\"),\n]\n\n# Indexes on added columns, made once the columns are sure to exist.\nINDEXES = \"\"\"\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_revision ON review_rounds (revision_id);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, column, type_ in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n        existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        if column not in existing:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {type_}\")\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(INDEXES)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | notice | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Make one per capability at import time, so FastAPI's\n    per-request cache recognises it.\"\"\"\n    def guard(user: Annotated[accounts.User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> accounts.User:\n        if not user.can(capability):\n            raise AdminRequired(user)\n        return user\n    ADMIN_GUARDS.add(guard)\n    return guard\n\n\nadmin_user = requires(\"manage_game\")\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> HTMLResponse:\n    user = exc.user if isinstance(exc, AdminRequired) else None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/refused.html\", {\"title\": \"没有权限\", \"user\": user},\n        status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game, guides, site, trash, users\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.AdminRequired, web.admin_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(game.router)\n    app.include_router(guides.router)\n    app.include_router(site.router)\n    app.include_router(trash.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"f2beb969-f63a-4730-8f97-fb2699d3d554","timestamp":"2026-10-18T02:28:45.525Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"The Site build: render everything Published into site/ as plain HTML.\n\nThe site has a Chinese tree (zh/) and an English tree (en/), and every page is\nan index.html in its own folder, so its address is the folder (`zh/guides/\nvanessa-12/`). Two rules the rubric checks:\n\n  1. Only PUBLISHED content is read here. A Draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"../../style.css\"), never root-absolute\n     (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n\nA Site build (the console's 更新网站 button) is render_site() followed by\ndeploy(), which pushes site/ to the gh-pages branch. Only a build whose deploy\nsucceeded is recorded, and the dashboard counts the changes since then.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport itertools\nimport posixpath\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Any\n\nfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n\nfrom app import db, game, guides, settings\nfrom app.rendering import render_markdown\n\nCSS = \"\"\"/* Minimal starter styles — make them yours. */\n:root { color-scheme: light dark; }\nbody { font: 16px/1.6 system-ui, \"PingFang SC\", \"Microsoft YaHei\", sans-serif;\n       margin: 0 auto; max-width: 42rem; padding: 1rem; }\nheader { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .5rem 1rem; align-items: baseline; }\nheader .brand { font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; margin-inline-end: auto; }\nmain { margin-block: 2rem; }\n.term { font-weight: 600; }\n.fallback-notice { display: none; }\n.fallback-notice:target { display: block; }\n\"\"\"\n\nLANGUAGES = (\"zh\", \"en\")\n\n# The words on the public site, in each language.\nLABELS = {\n    \"zh\": {\"site_name\": \"大巴扎攻略站\", \"current_patch\": \"当前版本：\",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"最新攻略\", \"heroes\": \"英雄\", \"no_guides\": \"还没有攻略。\",\n           \"updated\": \"更新于\",\n           \"other_language\": \"English\"},\n    \"en\": {\"site_name\": \"The Bazaar Guides\", \"current_patch\": \"Current Patch: \",\n           \"newest_guides\": \"Newest guides\", \"heroes\": \"Heroes\",\n           \"no_guides\": \"No English guides yet.\", \"updated\": \"Updated\",\n           \"other_language\": \"中文\"},\n}\nNEWEST_ON_HOME = 10\nNO_ENGLISH_TEXT = \"no-english-text\"  # the id of the fallback notice\n\n\ndef environment(glossary: game.Glossary) -> Environment:\n    env = Environment(\n        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    )\n    # `guide|localized(\"title\", lang)` is guide.title_zh or guide.title_en.\n    env.filters[\"localized\"] = lambda item, field, lang: getattr(item, f\"{field}_{lang}\")\n    # `text|markdown(lang)`: sanitized HTML, with Game Terms in `lang`.\n    env.filters[\"markdown\"] = lambda text, lang: render_markdown(text, lang, glossary).html\n    return env\n\n\ndef by_patch(listed: list[guides.Guide]) -> list[tuple[str, list[guides.Guide]]]:\n    \"\"\"Guides grouped by Patch, newest Patch first, keeping each group's order.\"\"\"\n    ordered = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_id, reverse=True)\n    return [(patch_name, list(group)) for patch_name, group\n            in itertools.groupby(ordered, key=lambda guide: guide.patch_name)]\n\n\ndef relative(target: str, page: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative link from the page at folder `page` to `target`. Both are\n    paths from the site root; a folder ends in \"/\" (\"\" is the root itself).\n    `target` may end in a \"#fragment\".\"\"\"\n    target, hash_mark, fragment = target.partition(\"#\")\n    link = posixpath.relpath(target or \".\", page or \".\")\n    if target.endswith(\"/\") or not target:\n        link += \"/\"\n    return f\"{link}{hash_mark}{fragment}\"\n\n\nclass _Writer:\n    \"\"\"Writes pages into `out`. Each page can make relative links with\n    `site_link(path from the root)` and, inside a language tree, with\n    `link(path inside the tree)`. A page in a language tree also gets\n    `switch_link`, the language switch: the same page in the `other` tree\n    unless `switch_to` names another path inside that tree.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, out: Path, current_patch: str | None,\n                 glossary: game.Glossary) -> None:\n        self.out = out\n        self.env = environment(glossary)\n        self.current_patch = current_patch\n\n    def page(self, path: str, template: str, *, lang: str | None = None,\n             switch_to: str | None = None, **context: Any) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Write the page Readers get at `path`: \"\" for the root, or a folder\n        such as \"zh/guides/vanessa-12/\".\"\"\"\n        def site_link(target: str) -> str:\n            return relative(target, path)\n\n        if lang:\n            other = \"en\" if lang == \"zh\" else \"zh\"\n            same_page = path.removeprefix(f\"{lang}/\")\n            context |= {\"lang\": lang, \"other\": other, \"t\": LABELS[lang],\n                        \"link\": lambda target: site_link(f\"{lang}/{target}\"),\n                        \"switch_link\": site_link(f\"{other}/{switch_to or same_page}\")}\n        file = self.out / path / \"index.html\"\n        file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n        file.write_text(self.env.get_template(template).render(\n            site_link=site_link, current_patch=self.current_patch, **context))\n\n\ndef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    out = out or settings.SITE\n    if out.exists():\n        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        published = guides.published(conn)\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n        glossary = game.glossary(conn)\n    (out / \"style.css\").write_text(CSS)\n    # Every Author with a Published Guide gets a page in both trees, even if\n    # none of their Guides has English text.\n    authors = {guide.author_id: guide.author_name for guide in published}\n    write = _Writer(out, current_patch=patches[0].name if patches else None,\n                    glossary=glossary)\n    write.page(\"\", \"site/root.html\")\n    for lang in LANGUAGES:\n        listed = [guide for guide in published if guide.has_text_in(lang)]\n        newest = sorted(listed, key=lambda guide: guide.published_at or \"\",\n                        reverse=True)[:NEWEST_ON_HOME]\n        write.page(f\"{lang}/\", \"site/home.html\", lang=lang, guides=newest,\n                   heroes=heroes)\n        for hero in heroes:\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/heroes/{hero.slug}/\", \"site/hero.html\", lang=lang,\n                       hero=hero, patches=by_patch(\n                           [guide for guide in listed if guide.hero_id == hero.id]))\n        for author_id, author_name in authors.items():\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/authors/{author_id}/\", \"site/author.html\", lang=lang,\n                       author_name=author_name,\n                       guides=[guide for guide in listed if guide.author_id == author_id])\n        for guide in listed:\n            # Only English can be missing, since Chinese text is required. The\n            # switch then leads to the Hero's English page, whose notice shows\n            # only when arrived at through this link.\n            write.page(f\"{lang}/guides/{guide.slug}/\", \"site/guide.html\",\n                       lang=lang, guide=guide,\n                       switch_to=None if guide.has_text_in(\"en\")\n                       else f\"heroes/{guide.hero_slug}/#{NO_ENGLISH_TEXT}\")\n    return out\n\n\nclass DeployFailed(Exception):\n    \"\"\"The push to gh-pages failed; the message says why.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\ndef deploy(out: Path, message: str = \"Publish site\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Push `out` to the gh-pages branch, which GitHub Pages serves.\n    Raises DeployFailed with git's own explanation if the push fails.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [sys.executable, \"-m\", \"ghp_import\", \"-n\", \"-p\", \"-m\", message, str(out)],\n        capture_output=True, text=True)\n    if result.returncode != 0:\n        raise DeployFailed(result.stderr.strip() or result.stdout.strip()\n                           or f\"ghp-import exited with {result.returncode}\")\n\n\ndef build_site() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Render the site and put it online. Raises DeployFailed if the push\n    fails, in which case the build is not recorded.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        started_at = conn.execute(f\"SELECT {db.NOW}\").fetchone()[0]\n    out = render_site()\n    deploy(out)\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO site_builds (started_at) VALUES (?)\", (started_at,))\n    return out\n\n\ndef changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides changed since the last successful Site build started\n    (all of them, if there has never been one): Published Guides edited\n    since, Guides Unpublished since, which the next build leaves out, and\n    Published Guides moved to or restored from the Trash since.\"\"\"\n    last = conn.execute(\"SELECT MAX(started_at) FROM site_builds\").fetchone()[0] or \"\"\n    changed = {guide.id for guide in guides.published(conn) if guide.updated_at > last}\n    return len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n               | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step. A database made\nbefore a table gained a column gets the column added on connect (see\nADDED_COLUMNS); a schema change that adding columns can't express needs a new\ntable instead.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\n-- last_login_at was added in T09 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_login_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\n-- nicknames, one per line, were added in T07 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\n-- A Guide is in the Trash while trashed_at is set (added in T06, as is\n-- restored_at; see ADDED_COLUMNS). That is separate from its status, so a\n-- restored Guide comes back exactly as it was; restored_at is when it last\n-- came back.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- A Revision is a pending change to a Published Guide, at most one per Guide.\n-- Publishing it copies it over the Guide and deletes it. base_updated_at is\n-- the Guide's updated_at when the Revision was opened, to tell whether the\n-- Guide changed since. Ids are never reused (AUTOINCREMENT), since review\n-- rounds keep the id of the Revision they Returned after it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    base_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    title_zh   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\n-- Each Return or Unpublish is a review round, kept for the Guide's history.\n-- A Draft with a Return or Unpublish behind it came back to its Author: a\n-- Guide only leaves Submitted or Published for Draft through one.\n-- A Return of a Revision records the Revision's id (revision_id; added in T06,\n-- see ADDED_COLUMNS). It belongs to that Revision while it is open and joins\n-- the Guide's own history once it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_notes (\n    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    quote    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quote != ''),\n    advice   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (advice != '')\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_guide ON review_rounds (guide_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_notes_by_round ON review_notes (round_id);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- Published Guides deleted for good from the Trash. Their rows are gone, so\n-- this is how the dashboard still counts them as a change not on the site.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed_guides (\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    removed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to a table after it was first created: (table, column, type).\n# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an older table as it was, so connect()\n# adds whichever of these it lacks.\nADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    (\"users\", \"last_login_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"trashed_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"restored_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"review_rounds\", \"revision_id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n    (\"game_terms\", \"nicknames\", \"TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\"),\n]\n\n# Indexes on added columns, made once the columns are sure to exist.\nINDEXES = \"\"\"\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_revision ON review_rounds (revision_id);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, column, type_ in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n        existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        if column not in existing:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {type_}\")\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(INDEXES)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\ntemplates.env.globals[\"submission_banned\"] = accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED\ntemplates.env.globals[\"min_password_length\"] = accounts.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with a 403\n    console page, which keeps the navigation for the signed-in `user`.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, user: accounts.User) -> None:\n        super().__init__()\n        self.user = user\n\n\n# Every guard made by requires(), so a test can find every route behind one.\nADMIN_GUARDS: set[Callable[..., accounts.User]] = set()\n\n\ndef requires(capability: str) -> Callable[..., accounts.User]:\n    \"\"\"A dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in user, if they have\n    `capability`. Anyone else is refused, whether they followed a link or\n    typed the URL. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game, guides, site, trash, users\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.AdminRequired, web.admin_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(game.router)\n    app.include_router(guides.router)\n    app.include_router(site.router)\n    app.include_router(trash.router)\n    app.include_router(users.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = <label>官方英文名\n      <input type=\"text\" name=\"name_en\" value=\"{{ name_en }}\" required>\n    </label>\n    <label>外号（可选，用 、 或 | 分隔）\n      <input type=\"text\" name=\"nicknames\" value=\"{{ guide|localized(\"hero_name\", lang) }} · {{ guide.patch_name }}\n        · {{ guide.author_name }} · {{ guide.updated_at[:10] }}</small>\n    </li>\n    {% endfor %}\n  </ul>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endmacro %}\n=== site/author.html\n{% extends \"site/base.html\" %}\n{% from \"site/_guides.html\" import guide_list with context %}\n{% block title %}{{ author_name }} · {{ t.site_name }}{% endblock current_patch }}</span>{% endif %}\n    <a class=\"language-switch\" href=\"{{ switch_link }}\" hreflang=\"{{ other }}\">{{ t.other_language }}</a>\n  </header>\n  <main>{% block content %}{% endblock %}</main>\n</body>\n</html>\n=== site/guide.html\n{% extends \"site/base.html\" %}\n{% block title %}{{ guide|localized(\"title\", lang) }} · {{ t.site_name }}{% endblock %}\n{% block content %}\n  <article>\n    <h1>{{ guide|localized(\"title\", lang) }}</h1>\n    <p>\n      <a href=\"{{ link(\"heroes/\" ~ guide.hero_slug ~ \"/\") }}\">{{ guide|localized(\"hero_name\", lang) }}</a>\n      · {{ guide.patch_name }}\n      · <a href=\"{{ link(\"authors/\" ~ guide.author_id ~ \"/\") }}\">{{ guide.author_name }}</a>\n      · {{ t.updated }} {{ guide.updated_at[:10] }}\n    </p>\n    {{ guide|localized(\"body\", lang)|markdown(lang)|safe }}\n  </article>\n{% endblock %}\n=== site/hero.html\n{% extends \"site/base.html\" %}\n{% from \"site/_guides.html\" import guide_list with context {{ guide_list(guides) }}\n  {% else %}\n    {{ guide_list([]) }}\n  {% endfor %}\n{% endblock %}\n=== site/home.html\n{% extends \"site/base.html\" %}\n{% from \"site/_guides.html\" import guide_list Full output saved to: /Users/yining/.claude/projects/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5/tool-results/bd4jjxq21.txt\n\nPreview (first 2KB):\n\"\"\"The game: Game Terms and Patches.\n\nA Game Term is a named thing in the game, of one of seven kinds, with an\nofficial Chinese and an official English name. A Hero is the kind of Game\nTerm every Guide is about. A Game Term may also have nicknames, the names\nplayers use for it that the game doesn't (瓦姐 for 瓦妮莎), so the editor\npreview can point them out. A Hero's URL slug is derived from the English Official name once, when the Hero\nis added, and never changes after that.\n\nA Patch is a game version such as `6.7`. Adding one makes it the Current\nPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom functools import partial\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\n# The seven kinds of Game Term, with the console's name for each.\nKINDS = {\"hero\": \"英雄\", \"item\": \"物品\", \"skill\": \"技能\", \"enchantment\": \"附魔\",\n         \"monster\": \"怪物\", \"merchant\": \"商人\", \"event\": \"事件\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Term:\n    id: int\n    kind: str\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n\n    @property\n    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n        return KINDS[self.kind]\n\n\ndef _term_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Term:\n    return Term(id=row[\"id\"], kind=row[\"kind\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"],\n                name_en=row[\"name_en\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n\n\ndef _stored_nicknames(row: sqlite3.Row) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n    return tuple(row[\"nicknames\"].splitlines())\n\n\ndef _to_store(nicknames: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Nicknames as parse_nicknames reads them, stored one per line.\"\"\"\n    return \"\\n\".join(parse_nicknames(nicknames))\n\n\n...\n</persisted-output>","is_error":false}]}}
