Adding one makes it the Current\nPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom functools import partial\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\n# The seven kinds of Game Term, with the console's name for each.\nKINDS = {\"hero\": \"英雄\", \"item\": \"物品\", \"skill\": \"技能\", \"enchantment\": \"附魔\",\n         \"monster\": \"怪物\", \"merchant\": \"商人\", \"event\": \"事件\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Term:\n    id: int\n    kind: str\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n\n    @property\n    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n        return KINDS[self.kind]\n\n\ndef _term_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Term:\n    return Term(id=row[\"id\"], kind=row[\"kind\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"],\n                name_en=row[\"name_en\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n\n\ndef _stored_nicknames(row: sqlite3.Row) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n    return tuple(row[\"nicknames\"].splitlines())\n\n\ndef _to_store(nicknames: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Nicknames as parse_nicknames reads them, stored one per line.\"\"\"\n    return \"\\n\".join(parse_nicknames(nicknames))\n\n\ndef nickname_notices(nicknames: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"A notice for each nickname that is a single Chinese character. It is\n    allowed, but it matches that character anywhere, so the preview may warn\n    about it often.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”只有一个汉字：预览会把正文里每一个“{nickname}”\"\n            \"都当作这个外号，可能出现很多提醒。\"\n            for nickname in nicknames\n            if re.fullmatch(r\"[\\u3400-\\u4dbf\\u4e00-\\u9fff\\uf900-\\ufaff]\", nickname)]\n\n\ndef parse_nicknames(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n    \"\"\"The nicknames in `text`, separated by 、 or | (or one per line),\n    trimmed, without blanks or repeats.\"\"\"\n    names = (name.strip() for name in re.split(r\"[、|\\n]\", text))\n    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(name for name in names if name))\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Patch:\n    id: int\n    name: str\n    is_current: bool\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Hero:\n    id: int\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    slug: str\n    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _hero_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Hero:\n    return Hero(id=row[\"id\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"], name_en=row[\"name_en\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n\n\ndef slugify(name_en: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`Vanessa` -> `vanessa`, `Black Knight` -> `black-knight`.\"\"\"\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _checked_names(name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed. Raises Refused if either is missing.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n    if not name_zh:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n    if not name_en:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n    return name_zh, name_en\n\n\ndef _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn: sqlite3.Connection, kind: str,\n                                 name_en: str, term_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if another Game Term of this kind already has this\n    English Official name, ignoring case. Compared in Python, as SQLite's\n    lower() folds only ASCII.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                        (kind, term_id))\n    for clash in rows:\n        if clash[\"name_en\"].casefold() == name_en.casefold():\n            raise Refused(f\"官方英文名 {clash['name_en']} 已被{KINDS[kind]}\"\n                          f\" {clash['name_zh']} 使用。\")\n\n\ndef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n                            name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n    either name is missing or another Hero already has that English name or\n    slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, \"hero\", name_en)\n    slug = slugify(name_en)\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n    clash = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ?\",\n        (slug,)).fetchone()\n    if clash:\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被英雄\"\n                      f\" {clash['name_zh']}（{clash['name_en']}）使用。\")\n    return name_zh, name_en, slug\n\n\ndef add_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, name_zh: str, name_en: str,\n             nicknames: str = \"\") -> Hero:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the English name\n    or slug is taken. `nicknames` is as parse_nicknames reads it.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, slug, nicknames)\"\n        \" VALUES ('hero', ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (name_zh, name_en, slug, _to_store(nicknames)))\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int) -> Hero | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\",\n                       (hero_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n              name_en: str, nicknames: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names and nicknames; its slug stays the one\n    it was given when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move.\"\"\"\n    if hero(conn, hero_id) is None:\n        raise Refused(\"找不到这个英雄。\")\n    edit_term(conn, hero_id, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en, nicknames=nicknames)\n\n\ndef heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n    return [_hero_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add_term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, kind: str, name_zh: str,\n             name_en: str, nicknames: str = \"\") -> Term:\n    \"\"\"Add a Game Term of a kind other than Hero (Heroes need a slug: see\n    add_hero). Raises Refused if the kind is unknown, either Official name\n    is missing, or another term of the kind has the English name.\"\"\"\n    if kind not in KINDS or kind == \"hero\":\n        raise Refused(\"请选择术语种类。\")\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, kind, name_en)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, nicknames)\"\n        \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (kind, name_zh, name_en, _to_store(nicknames)))\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _term_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term_id: int) -> Term | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (term_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _term_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef edit_term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n              name_en: str, nicknames: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change a Game Term's Official names and nicknames (never its kind, nor\n    a Hero's slug). Raises Refused if either name is missing or another term\n    of its kind has the English name.\"\"\"\n    current = term(conn, term_id)\n    if current is None:\n        raise Refused(\"找不到这个游戏术语。\")\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, current.kind, name_en, term_id)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, nicknames = ?\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en,\n                                   _to_store(nicknames), term_id))\n\n\n# Sorts Game Terms in KINDS order.\n_BY_KIND = (\"CASE kind \" + \" \".join(f\"WHEN '{kind}' THEN {i}\"\n                                    for i, kind in enumerate(KINDS)) + \" END\")\n\n\nclass Glossary:\n    \"\"\"Every Game Term, Heroes included, looked up by either Official name\n    (trimmed, ignoring case). Where several terms share a name, they come in\n    KINDS order (Heroes first), then in the order they were added.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, terms: Iterable[Term]) -> None:\n        self.terms = list(terms)\n        self._by_name: dict[str, list[Term]] = {}\n        for term in self.terms:\n            for name in {term.name_zh.casefold(), term.name_en.casefold()}:\n                self._by_name.setdefault(name, []).append(term)\n\n    def matching(self, name: str) -> list[Term]:\n        return self._by_name.get(name.strip().casefold(), [])\n\n    def nicknames_in(self, text: str) -> list[tuple[str, Term, int]]:\n        \"\"\"Each known nickname found in `text`, with its Game Term and how\n        many times it is there. Case is ignored, and a nickname starting or\n        ending in a Latin letter or digit must be a whole word at that end\n        (`Van` is not found in `Vanguard`), while Chinese has no spaces to\n        mark words, so 瓦姐 is found anywhere (see nickname_notices).\"\"\"\n        found = [(nickname, term,\n                  len(re.findall(_whole_word(nickname), text, re.IGNORECASE)))\n                 for term in self.terms for nickname in term.nicknames]\n        return [(nickname, term, count) for nickname, term, count in found if count]\n\n\ndef _whole_word(nickname: str) -> str:\n    pattern = re.escape(nickname)\n    if re.match(r\"[A-Za-z0-9]\", nickname):\n        pattern = r\"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])\" + pattern\n    if re.search(r\"[A-Za-z0-9]$\", nickname):\n        pattern += r\"(?![A-Za-z0-9])\"\n    return pattern\n\n\ndef glossary(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> Glossary:\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT * FROM game_terms ORDER BY {_BY_KIND}, id\")\n    return Glossary(_term_from_row(row) for row in rows)\n\n\ndef terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Term]:\n    \"\"\"Every Game Term but the Heroes, by kind, then English name.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind != 'hero'\"\n                        f\" ORDER BY {_BY_KIND}, name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n    return [_term_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Patch:\n    \"\"\"Add a Patch, which becomes the Current Patch.\n    Raises Refused if the name is blank or the Patch already exists.\"\"\"\n    name = name.strip()\n    if not name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写版本号，例如 6.7。\")\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO patches (name) VALUES (?)\", (name,))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(f\"版本 {name} 已存在。\") from None\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=True)\n\n\ndef patches(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Patch]:\n    \"\"\"Every Patch, newest first; the first is the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches ORDER BY id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=(i == 0))\n            for i, row in enumerate(rows)]\n\n\n# CSV import. The file's first row names its columns: kind, name_zh, name_en,\n# and optionally nicknames. A row whose kind and English Official name\n# (ignoring case) match an existing Game Term changes that term; any other\n# row adds one. Bad rows are rejected one by one, so the good ones can still\n# be imported.\n\nCSV_COLUMNS = (\"kind\", \"name_zh\", \"name_en\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass CsvRow:\n    number: int  # the row number a spreadsheet shows, the header being row 1\n    kind: str\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImportPlan:\n    added: list[CsvRow]\n    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]]  # the term as it is, and its row\n    unchanged: int\n    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]]  # (row number, reason)\n\n\ndef _kind_of(written: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The kind a CSV cell names, by its English key or its Chinese name.\"\"\"\n    written = written.strip()\n    return next((kind for kind, label in KINDS.items()\n                 if written.casefold() == kind or written == label), None)\n\n\ndef _csv_rows(csv_bytes: bytes) -> Iterator[tuple[int, dict[str, str]]]:\n    \"\"\"The file's rows after the header, numbered, with their cells trimmed;\n    wholly blank rows are skipped. Raises Refused if the file isn't UTF-8 or\n    lacks the header, or once a row can't be read as CSV.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        text = csv_bytes.decode(\"utf-8-sig\")  # Excel starts its UTF-8 with a BOM\n    except UnicodeDecodeError:\n        raise Refused(\"读不出这个文件。请把 CSV 存成 UTF-8 编码后再上传。\") from None\n    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))\n    try:\n        header = [cell.strip().lower() for cell in next(reader, [])]\n    except csv.Error:\n        header = []\n    if not set(CSV_COLUMNS) <= set(header):\n        raise Refused(\"CSV 第一行必须是表头：kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames\"\n                      \"（nicknames 一列可以省略）。\")\n    try:\n        for number, cells in enumerate(reader, start=2):\n            row = {column: cell.strip() for column, cell in zip(header, cells)}\n            if any(row.values()):\n                yield number, row\n    except csv.Error as error:\n        raise Refused(f\"读不出这个 CSV 文件（第 {reader.line_num} 行附近：{error}）。\"\n                      \"请检查引号是否成对。\") from None\n\n\ndef plan_import(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes) -> ImportPlan:\n    \"\"\"What importing the CSV file would add and change, and the rows it\n    would reject with the reason for each. Nothing is saved. An empty\n    nicknames cell keeps the nicknames a term already has.\"\"\"\n    existing = {(term.kind, term.name_en.casefold()): term\n                for term in glossary(conn).terms}\n    added: list[CsvRow] = []\n    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]] = []\n    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]] = []\n    unchanged = 0\n    row_of_term: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}  # each term's first row\n    row_of_new_slug: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for number, cells in _csv_rows(csv_bytes):\n        kind = _kind_of(cells.get(\"kind\", \"\"))\n        name_zh, name_en = cells.get(\"name_zh\", \"\"), cells.get(\"name_en\", \"\")\n        if kind is None:\n            rejected.append((number, f\"未知的种类“{cells.get('kind', '')}”。种类须是\"\n                             f\"{'、'.join(KINDS.values())}之一，\"\n                             f\"或其英文（{', '.join(KINDS)}）。\"))\n            continue\n        if not name_zh or not name_en:\n            rejected.append((number, f\"缺少官方{'中' if not name_zh else '英'}文名。\"))\n            continue\n        key = (kind, name_en.casefold())\n        if key in row_of_term:\n            rejected.append((number, f\"和第 {row_of_term[key]} 行是同一个游戏术语\"\n                             \"（种类和官方英文名都相同）。\"))\n            continue\n        row_of_term[key] = number\n        row = CsvRow(number, kind, name_zh, name_en,\n                     parse_nicknames(cells.get(\"nicknames\", \"\")))\n        term = existing.get(key)\n        if term is None and kind == \"hero\":\n            try:\n                slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)[2]\n            except Refused as refused:\n                rejected.append((number, refused.message))\n                continue\n            if slug in row_of_new_slug:\n                rejected.append((number, f\"网址名 {slug} 已被第\"\n                                 f\" {row_of_new_slug[slug]} 行的英雄使用。\"))\n                continue\n            row_of_new_slug[slug] = number\n        if term is None:\n            added.append(row)\n        elif (term.name_zh, term.name_en) != (name_zh, name_en) or (\n                row.nicknames and row.nicknames != term.nicknames):\n            changed.append((term, row))\n        else:\n            unchanged += 1\n    return ImportPlan(added, changed, unchanged, rejected)\n\n\ndef import_terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes, *,\n                 only_new: bool = False) -> ImportPlan:\n    \"\"\"Import the CSV file's good rows, as plan_import plans, and say what\n    was done. With `only_new`, Game Terms that already exist are left as\n    they are, and the plan says nothing changed.\"\"\"\n    plan = plan_import(conn, csv_bytes)\n    if only_new:\n        plan = ImportPlan(plan.added, [], plan.unchanged + len(plan.changed),\n                          plan.rejected)\n    for row in plan.added:\n        add = add_hero if row.kind == \"hero\" else partial(add_term, kind=row.kind)\n        add(conn, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n            nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames))\n    for term, row in plan.changed:\n        edit_term(conn, term.id, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n                  nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames or term.nicknames))\n    return plan\n\"\"\"Game Terms (Heroes on their own page) and Patches, managed by Admins only.\n\nThe router itself requires an Admin, so no route here can forget to; each\nroute's own `admin_user` is the same (cached) check, there to get the user.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport base64\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import admin_user, flash, redirect, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(admin_user)])\n\n\ndef flash_nickname_notices(request: Request, nicknames: Iterable[str]) -> None:\n    \"\"\"After a save: point out one-character Chinese nicknames, which were\n    saved but will make the preview warn often.\"\"\"\n    for notice in game.nickname_notices(nicknames):\n        flash(request, notice, \"notice\")\n\n\ndef hero_list_page(request: Request, user: User, *, name_zh: str = \"\",\n                   name_en: str = \"\", nicknames: str = \"\",\n                   error: str | None = None):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        heroes = game.heroes(conn)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/heroes.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"英雄\", \"user\": user, \"heroes\": heroes, \"name_zh\": name_zh,\n         \"name_en\": name_en, \"nicknames\": nicknames, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=400 if error else 200)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/heroes\")\ndef hero_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)]):\n    return hero_list_page(request, user)\n\n\n# Form fields default to \"\" so a blank field gets our message, not a 422.\n@router.post(\"/admin/heroes\")\ndef add_hero(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)],\n             name_zh: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n             name_en: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n             nicknames: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\"):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            hero = game.add_hero(conn, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en,\n                                 nicknames=nicknames)\n    except game.Refused as refused:\n        return hero_list_page(request, user, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en,\n                              nicknames=nicknames, error=refused.message)\n    flash(request, f\"已添加英雄：{hero.name_zh}（{hero.name_en}）。\")\n    flash_nickname_notices(request, hero.nicknames)\n    return redirect(\"/admin/heroes\")\n\n\ndef existing_hero(hero_id: int) -> game.Hero:\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        hero = game.hero(conn, hero_id)\n    if hero is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)\n    return hero\n\n\ndef hero_edit_page(request: Request, user: User, hero: game.Hero, *,\n                   name_zh: str, name_en: str, nicknames: str,\n                   error: str | None = None):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/hero_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": f\"编辑英雄：{hero.name_zh}\", \"user\": user, \"hero\": hero,\n         \"name_zh\": name_zh, \"name_en\": name_en, \"nicknames\": nicknames,\n         \"notices\": game.nickname_notices(hero.nicknames), \"error\": error},\n        status_code=400 if error else 200)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/heroes/{hero_id}/edit\")\ndef hero_edit_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)],\n                   hero: Annotated[game.Hero, Depends(existing_hero)]):\n    return hero_edit_page(request, user, hero, name_zh=hero.name_zh,\n                          name_en=hero.name_en, nicknames=\"、\".join(hero.nicknames))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/heroes/{hero_id}\")\ndef edit_hero(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)],\n              hero: Annotated[game.Hero, Depends(existing_hero)],\n              name_zh: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n              name_en: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n              nicknames: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\"):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            game.edit_hero(conn, hero.id, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en,\n                           nicknames=nicknames)\n    except game.Refused as refused:\n        return hero_edit_page(request, user, hero, name_zh=name_zh,\n                              name_en=name_en, nicknames=nicknames,\n                              error=refused.message)\n    flash(request, \"已保存英雄的官方名称和外号。\")\n    flash_nickname_notices(request, game.parse_nicknames(nicknames))\n    return redirect(\"/admin/heroes\")\n\n\ndef term_list_page(request: Request, user: User, *, kind: str = \"\",\n                   name_zh: str = \"\", name_en: str = \"\", nicknames: str = \"\",\n                   error: str | None = None):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        terms = game.terms(conn)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/terms.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"游戏术语\", \"user\": user, \"terms\": terms, \"kinds\": game.KINDS,\n         \"kind\": kind, \"name_zh\": name_zh, \"name_en\": name_en,\n         \"nicknames\": nicknames, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=400 if error else 200)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/terms\")\ndef term_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)]):\n    return term_list_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/terms\")\ndef add_term(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)],\n             kind: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n             name_zh: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n             name_en: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\",\n             nicknames: Annotated[str, Form()] = \"\"):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            term = game.add_term(conn, kind=kind, {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","hash":"7e2607a3bf2c36f36f2a0277e1baa36d254312b949d8acc366a310495c6f6278","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017UuSSDgjUKS11ZRmA4usY2","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The game: Game Terms and Patches.\n2\t\n3\tA Game Term is a named thing in the game, of one of seven kinds, with an\n4\tofficial Chinese and an official English name. A Hero is the kind of Game\n5\tTerm every Guide is about. A Game Term may also have nicknames, the names\n6\tplayers use for it that the game doesn't (瓦姐 for 瓦妮莎), so the editor\n7\tpreview can point them out. A Hero's URL slug is derived from the English Official name once, when the Hero\n8\tis added, and never changes after that.\n9\t\n10\tA Patch is a game version such as `6.7`. Adding one makes it the Current\n11\tPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n12\t\n13\tAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n14\t\"\"\"\n15\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n16\t\n17\timport csv\n18\timport io\n19\timport re\n20\timport sqlite3\n21\tfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator\n22\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n23\tfrom functools import partial\n24\t\n25\t\n26\tclass Refused(Exception):\n27\t    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n28\t\n29\t    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n30\t        super().__init__(message)\n31\t        self.message = message\n32\t\n33\t\n34\t# The seven kinds of Game Term, with the console's name for each.\n35\tKINDS = {\"hero\": \"英雄\", \"item\": \"物品\", \"skill\": \"技能\", \"enchantment\": \"附魔\",\n36\t         \"monster\": \"怪物\", \"merchant\": \"商人\", \"event\": \"事件\"}\n37\t\n38\t\n39\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n40\tclass Term:\n41\t    id: int\n42\t    kind: str\n43\t    name_zh: str\n44\t    name_en: str\n45\t    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n46\t\n47\t    @property\n48\t    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n49\t        return KINDS[self.kind]\n50\t\n51\t\n52\tdef _term_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Term:\n53\t    return Term(id=row[\"id\"], kind=row[\"kind\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"],\n54\t                name_en=row[\"name_en\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n55\t\n56\t\n57\tdef _stored_nicknames(row: sqlite3.Row) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n58\t    return tuple(row[\"nicknames\"].splitlines())\n59\t\n60\t\n61\tdef _to_store(nicknames: str) -> str:\n62\t    \"\"\"Nicknames as parse_nicknames reads them, stored one per line.\"\"\"\n63\t    return \"\\n\".join(parse_nicknames(nicknames))\n64\t\n65\t\n66\tdef nickname_notices(nicknames: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:\n67\t    \"\"\"A notice for each nickname that is a single Chinese character. It is\n68\t    allowed, but it matches that character anywhere, so the preview may warn\n69\t    about it often.\"\"\"\n70\t    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”只有一个汉字：预览会把正文里每一个“{nickname}”\"\n71\t            \"都当作这个外号，可能出现很多提醒。\"\n72\t            for nickname in nicknames\n73\t            if re.fullmatch(r\"[\\u3400-\\u4dbf\\u4e00-\\u9fff\\uf900-\\ufaff]\", nickname)]\n74\t\n75\t\n76\tdef parse_nicknames(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n77\t    \"\"\"The nicknames in `text`, separated by 、 or | (or one per line),\n78\t    trimmed, without blanks or repeats.\"\"\"\n79\t    names = (name.strip() for name in re.split(r\"[、|\\n]\", text))\n80\t    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(name for name in names if name))\n81\t\n82\t\n83\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n84\tclass Patch:\n85\t    id: int\n86\t    name: str\n87\t    is_current: bool\n88\t\n89\t\n90\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n91\tclass Hero:\n92\t    id: int\n93\t    name_zh: str\n94\t    name_en: str\n95\t    slug: str\n96\t    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n97\t\n98\t\n99\tdef _hero_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Hero:\n100\t    return Hero(id=row[\"id\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"], name_en=row[\"name_en\"],\n101\t                slug=row[\"slug\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n102\t\n103\t\n104\tdef slugify(name_en: str) -> str:\n105\t    \"\"\"`Vanessa` -> `vanessa`, `Black Knight` -> `black-knight`.\"\"\"\n106\t    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n107\t\n108\t\n109\tdef _checked_names(name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n110\t    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed. Raises Refused if either is missing.\"\"\"\n111\t    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n112\t    if not name_zh:\n113\t        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n114\t    if not name_en:\n115\t        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n116\t    return name_zh, name_en\n117\t\n118\t\n119\tdef _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn: sqlite3.Connection, kind: str,\n120\t                                 name_en: str, term_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n121\t    \"\"\"Raises Refused if another Game Term of this kind already has this\n122\t    English Official name, ignoring case. Compared in Python, as SQLite's\n123\t    lower() folds only ASCII.\"\"\"\n124\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n125\t                        (kind, term_id))\n126\t    for clash in rows:\n127\t        if clash[\"name_en\"].casefold() == name_en.casefold():\n128\t            raise Refused(f\"官方英文名 {clash['name_en']} 已被{KINDS[kind]}\"\n129\t                          f\" {clash['name_zh']} 使用。\")\n130\t\n131\t\n132\tdef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n133\t                            name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n134\t    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n135\t    either name is missing or another Hero already has that English name or\n136\t    slug.\"\"\"\n137\t    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n138\t    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, \"hero\", name_en)\n139\t    slug = slugify(name_en)\n140\t    if not slug:\n141\t        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n142\t    clash = conn.execute(\n143\t        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ?\",\n144\t        (slug,)).fetchone()\n145\t    if clash:\n146\t        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被英雄\"\n147\t                      f\" {clash['name_zh']}（{clash['name_en']}）使用。\")\n148\t    return name_zh, name_en, slug\n149\t\n150\t\n151\tdef add_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, name_zh: str, name_en: str,\n152\t             nicknames: str = \"\") -> Hero:\n153\t    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the English name\n154\t    or slug is taken. `nicknames` is as parse_nicknames reads it.\"\"\"\n155\t    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)\n156\t    cur = conn.execute(\n157\t        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, slug, nicknames)\"\n158\t        \" VALUES ('hero', ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n159\t        (name_zh, name_en, slug, _to_store(nicknames)))\n160\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n161\t                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n162\t    return _hero_from_row(row)\n163\t\n164\t\n165\tdef hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int) -> Hero | None:\n166\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\",\n167\t                       (hero_id,)).fetchone()\n168\t    return _hero_from_row(row) if row else None\n169\t\n170\t\n171\tdef edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n172\t              name_en: str, nicknames: str) -> None:\n173\t    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names and nicknames; its slug stays the one\n174\t    it was given when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move.\"\"\"\n175\t    if hero(conn, hero_id) is None:\n176\t        raise Refused(\"找不到这个英雄。\")\n177\t    edit_term(conn, hero_id, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en, nicknames=nicknames)\n178\t\n179\t\n180\tdef heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:\n181\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero'\"\n182\t                        \" ORDER BY name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n183\t    return [_hero_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n184\t\n185\t\n186\tdef add_term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, kind: str, name_zh: str,\n187\t             name_en: str, nicknames: str = \"\") -> Term:\n188\t    \"\"\"Add a Game Term of a kind other than Hero (Heroes need a slug: see\n189\t    add_hero). Raises Refused if the kind is unknown, either Official name\n190\t    is missing, or another term of the kind has the English name.\"\"\"\n191\t    if kind not in KINDS or kind == \"hero\":\n192\t        raise Refused(\"请选择术语种类。\")\n193\t    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n194\t    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, kind, name_en)\n195\t    cur = conn.execute(\n196\t        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, nicknames)\"\n197\t        \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n198\t        (kind, name_zh, name_en, _to_store(nicknames)))\n199\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n200\t                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n201\t    return _term_from_row(row)\n202\t\n203\t\n204\tdef term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term_id: int) -> Term | None:\n205\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n206\t                       (term_id,)).fetchone()\n207\t    return _term_from_row(row) if row else None\n208\t\n209\t\n210\tdef edit_term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n211\t              name_en: str, nicknames: str) -> None:\n212\t    \"\"\"Change a Game Term's Official names and nicknames (never its kind, nor\n213\t    a Hero's slug). Raises Refused if either name is missing or another term\n214\t    of its kind has the English name.\"\"\"\n215\t    current = term(conn, term_id)\n216\t    if current is None:\n217\t        raise Refused(\"找不到这个游戏术语。\")\n218\t    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n219\t    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, current.kind, name_en, term_id)\n220\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, nicknames = ?\"\n221\t                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en,\n222\t                                   _to_store(nicknames), term_id))\n223\t\n224\t\n225\t# Sorts Game Terms in KINDS order.\n226\t_BY_KIND = (\"CASE kind \" + \" \".join(f\"WHEN '{kind}' THEN {i}\"\n227\t                                    for i, kind in enumerate(KINDS)) + \" END\")\n228\t\n229\t\n230\tclass Glossary:\n231\t    \"\"\"Every Game Term, Heroes included, looked up by either Official name\n232\t    (trimmed, ignoring case). Where several terms share a name, they come in\n233\t    KINDS order (Heroes first), then in the order they were added.\"\"\"\n234\t\n235\t    def __init__(self, terms: Iterable[Term]) -> None:\n236\t        self.terms = list(terms)\n237\t        self._by_name: dict[str, list[Term]] = {}\n238\t        for term in self.terms:\n239\t            for name in {term.name_zh.casefold(), term.name_en.casefold()}:\n240\t                self._by_name.setdefault(name, []).append(term)\n241\t\n242\t    def matching(self, name: str) -> list[Term]:\n243\t        return self._by_name.get(name.strip().casefold(), [])\n244\t\n245\t    def nicknames_in(self, text: str) -> list[tuple[str, Term, int]]:\n246\t        \"\"\"Each known nickname found in `text`, with its Game Term and how\n247\t        many times it is there. Case is ignored, and a nickname starting or\n248\t        ending in a Latin letter or digit must be a whole word at that end\n249\t        (`Van` is not found in `Vanguard`), while Chinese has no spaces to\n250\t        mark words, so 瓦姐 is found anywhere (see nickname_notices).\"\"\"\n251\t        found = [(nickname, term,\n252\t                  len(re.findall(_whole_word(nickname), text, re.IGNORECASE)))\n253\t                 for term in self.terms for nickname in term.nicknames]\n254\t        return [(nickname, term, count) for nickname, term, count in found if count]\n255\t\n256\t\n257\tdef _whole_word(nickname: str) -> str:\n258\t    pattern = re.escape(nickname)\n259\t    if re.match(r\"[A-Za-z0-9]\", nickname):\n260\t        pattern = r\"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])\" + pattern\n261\t    if re.search(r\"[A-Za-z0-9]$\", nickname):\n262\t        pattern += r\"(?![A-Za-z0-9])\"\n263\t    return pattern\n264\t\n265\t\n266\tdef glossary(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> Glossary:\n267\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT * FROM game_terms ORDER BY {_BY_KIND}, id\")\n268\t    return Glossary(_term_from_row(row) for row in rows)\n269\t\n270\t\n271\tdef terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Term]:\n272\t    \"\"\"Every Game Term but the Heroes, by kind, then English name.\"\"\"\n273\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind != 'hero'\"\n274\t                        f\" ORDER BY {_BY_KIND}, name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n275\t    return [_term_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n276\t\n277\t\n278\tdef add_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Patch:\n279\t    \"\"\"Add a Patch, which becomes the Current Patch.\n280\t    Raises Refused if the name is blank or the Patch already exists.\"\"\"\n281\t    name = name.strip()\n282\t    if not name:\n283\t        raise Refused(\"请填写版本号，例如 6.7。\")\n284\t    try:\n285\t        cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO patches (name) VALUES (?)\", (name,))\n286\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n287\t        raise Refused(f\"版本 {name} 已存在。\") from None\n288\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches WHERE id = ?\",\n289\t                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n290\t    return Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=True)\n291\t\n292\t\n293\tdef patches(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Patch]:\n294\t    \"\"\"Every Patch, newest first; the first is the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n295\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches ORDER BY id DESC\").fetchall()\n296\t    return [Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=(i == 0))\n297\t            for i, row in enumerate(rows)]\n298\t\n299\t\n300\t# CSV import. The file's first row names its columns: kind, name_zh, name_en,\n301\t# and optionally nicknames. A row whose kind and English Official name\n302\t# (ignoring case) match an existing Game Term changes that term; any other\n303\t# row adds one. Bad rows are rejected one by one, so the good ones can still\n304\t# be imported.\n305\t\n306\tCSV_COLUMNS = (\"kind\", \"name_zh\", \"name_en\")\n307\t\n308\t\n309\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n310\tclass CsvRow:\n311\t    number: int  # the row number a spreadsheet shows, the header being row 1\n312\t    kind: str\n313\t    name_zh: str\n314\t    name_en: str\n315\t    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n316\t\n317\t\n318\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n319\tclass ImportPlan:\n320\t    added: list[CsvRow]\n321\t    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]]  # the term as it is, and its row\n322\t    unchanged: int\n323\t    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]]  # (row number, reason)\n324\t\n325\t\n326\tdef _kind_of(written: str) -> str | None:\n327\t    \"\"\"The kind a CSV cell names, by its English key or its Chinese name.\"\"\"\n328\t    written = written.strip()\n329\t    return next((kind for kind, label in KINDS.items()\n330\t                 if written.casefold() == kind or written == label), None)\n331\t\n332\t\n333\tdef _csv_rows(csv_bytes: bytes) -> Iterator[tuple[int, dict[str, str]]]:\n334\t    \"\"\"The file's rows after the header, numbered, with their cells trimmed;\n335\t    wholly blank rows are skipped. Raises Refused if the file isn't UTF-8 or\n336\t    lacks the header, or once a row can't be read as CSV.\"\"\"\n337\t    try:\n338\t        text = csv_bytes.decode(\"utf-8-sig\")  # Excel starts its UTF-8 with a BOM\n339\t    except UnicodeDecodeError:\n340\t        raise Refused(\"读不出这个文件。请把 CSV 存成 UTF-8 编码后再上传。\") from None\n341\t    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))\n342\t    try:\n343\t        header = [cell.strip().lower() for cell in next(reader, [])]\n344\t    except csv.Error:\n345\t        header = []\n346\t    if not set(CSV_COLUMNS) <= set(header):\n347\t        raise Refused(\"CSV 第一行必须是表头：kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames\"\n348\t                      \"（nicknames 一列可以省略）。\")\n349\t    try:\n350\t        for number, cells in enumerate(reader, start=2):\n351\t            row = {column: cell.strip() for column, cell in zip(header, cells)}\n352\t            if any(row.values()):\n353\t                yield number, row\n354\t    except csv.Error as error:\n355\t        raise Refused(f\"读不出这个 CSV 文件（第 {reader.line_num} 行附近：{error}）。\"\n356\t                      \"请检查引号是否成对。\") from None\n357\t\n358\t\n359\tdef plan_import(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes) -> ImportPlan:\n360\t    \"\"\"What importing the CSV file would add and change, and the rows it\n361\t    would reject with the reason for each. Nothing is saved. An empty\n362\t    nicknames cell keeps the nicknames a term already has.\"\"\"\n363\t    existing = {(term.kind, term.name_en.casefold()): term\n364\t                for term in glossary(conn).terms}\n365\t    added: list[CsvRow] = []\n366\t    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]] = []\n367\t    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]] = []\n368\t    unchanged = 0\n369\t    row_of_term: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}  # each term's first row\n370\t    row_of_new_slug: dict[str, int] = {}\n371\t    for number, cells in _csv_rows(csv_bytes):\n372\t        kind = _kind_of(cells.get(\"kind\", \"\"))\n373\t        name_zh, name_en = cells.get(\"name_zh\", \"\"), cells.get(\"name_en\", \"\")\n374\t        if kind is None:\n375\t            rejected.append((number, f\"未知的种类“{cells.get('kind', '')}”。种类须是\"\n376\t                             f\"{'、'.join(KINDS.values())}之一，\"\n377\t                             f\"或其英文（{', '.join(KINDS)}）。\"))\n378\t            continue\n379\t        if not name_zh or not name_en:\n380\t            rejected.append((number, f\"缺少官方{'中' if not name_zh else '英'}文名。\"))\n381\t            continue\n382\t        key = (kind, name_en.casefold())\n383\t        if key in row_of_term:\n384\t            rejected.append((number, f\"和第 {row_of_term[key]} 行是同一个游戏术语\"\n385\t                             \"（种类和官方英文名都相同）。\"))\n386\t            continue\n387\t        row_of_term[key] = number\n388\t        row = CsvRow(number, kind, name_zh, name_en,\n389\t                     parse_nicknames(cells.get(\"nicknames\", \"\")))\n390\t        term = existing.get(key)\n391\t        if term is None and kind == \"hero\":\n392\t            try:\n393\t                slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)[2]\n394\t            except Refused as refused:\n395\t                rejected.append((number, refused.message))\n396\t                continue\n397\t            if slug in row_of_new_slug:\n398\t                rejected.append((number, f\"网址名 {slug} 已被第\"\n399\t                                 f\" {row_of_new_slug[slug]} 行的英雄使用。\"))\n400\t                continue\n401\t            row_of_new_slug[slug] = number\n402\t        if term is None:\n403\t            added.append(row)\n404\t        elif (term.name_zh, term.name_en) != (name_zh, name_en) or (\n405\t                row.nicknames and row.nicknames != term.nicknames):\n406\t            changed.append((term, row))\n407\t        else:\n408\t            unchanged += 1\n409\t    return ImportPlan(added, changed, unchanged, rejected)\n410\t\n411\t\n412\tdef import_terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes, *,\n413\t                 only_new: bool = False) -> ImportPlan:\n414\t    \"\"\"Import the CSV file's good rows, as plan_import plans, and say what\n415\t    was done. With `only_new`, Game Terms that already exist are left as\n416\t    they are, and the plan says nothing changed.\"\"\"\n417\t    plan = plan_import(conn, csv_bytes)\n418\t    if only_new:\n419\t        plan = ImportPlan(plan.added, [], plan.unchanged + len(plan.changed),\n420\t                          plan.rejected)\n421\t    for row in plan.added:\n422\t        add = add_hero if row.kind == \"hero\" else partial(add_term, kind=row.kind)\n423\t        add(conn, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n424\t            nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames))\n425\t    for term, row in plan.changed:\n426\t        edit_term(conn, term.id, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n427\t                  nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames or term.nicknames))\n428\t    return redirect(\"/admin/patches\")\n694\t\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n695\t\n696\tPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\n697\ta random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\n698\tcookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\n699\teven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n700\t\n701\tAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n702\t\"\"\"\n703\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n704\t\n705\timport re\n706\timport secrets\n707\timport sqlite3\n708\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n709\t\n710\tfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\n711\tfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n712\t\n713\tfrom app import db\n714\t\n715\t_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n716\t# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n717\t# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n718\t_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n719\t\n720\tBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\n721\tDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n722\t\n723\t\n724\tclass Refused(Exception):\n725\t    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n726\t\n727\t    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n728\t        super().__init__(message)\n729\t        self.message = message\n730\t\n731\t\n732\tclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n733\t    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this action.\"\"\"\n734\t\n735\t\n736\tclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n737\t    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n738\t\n739\t    def __init__(self) -> None:\n740\t        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n741\t\n742\t\n743\t# A role is a bundle of capabilities. Code asks `user.can(...)`, never which\n744\t# role someone has, so a rule can move between roles without touching callers.\n745\tCAPABILITIES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n746\t    \"admin\": frozenset({\n747\t        \"publish_guides\",      # Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts;\n748\t                               # Return and Unpublish Guides\n749\t        \"manage_all_guides\",   # see and edit everyone's Guides, any Hero\n750\t        \"edit_guide_slugs\",\n751\t        \"manage_trash\",        # see the Trash, restore from it, delete for good\n752\t        \"manage_game\",         # Heroes and Patches\n753\t        \"build_site\",          # 更新网站: the Site build and deploy\n754\t        \"manage_users\",        # the Users page and everything on it\n755\t    }),\n756\t    \"editor\": frozenset(),\n757\t}\n758\t\n759\t# Shown on every console page to a banned Editor, and as the reason Submit and\n760\t# opening a Revision are refused.\n761\tSUBMISSION_BANNED = (\"你的账号已被禁止投稿：可以继续编辑草稿，但不能提交审核，\"\n762\t                     \"也不能修订已发布的攻略。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n763\t\n764\tROLE_LABELS = {\"admin\": \"管理员\", \"editor\": \"编辑\"}\n765\tSTATE_LABELS = {\"active\": \"正常\", \"submission_ban\": \"禁止投稿\",\n766\t                \"deactivated\": \"已停用\"}\n767\t\n768\t\n769\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n770\tclass User:\n771\t    id: int\n772\t    email: str\n773\t    role: str\n774\t    display_name: str | None\n775\t    state: str\n776\t    needs_setup: bool\n777\t    last_login_at: str | None = None\n778\t\n779\t    def can(self, capability: str) -> bool:\n780\t        return capability in CAPABILITIES[self.role]\n781\t\n782\t\n783\tdef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n784\t    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n785\t                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n786\t                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]),\n787\t                last_login_at=row[\"last_login_at\"])\n788\t\n789\t\n790\tdef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n791\t    try:\n792\t        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n793\t    except VerifyMismatchError:\n794\t        return False\n795\t\n796\t\n797\tdef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n798\t    return email.strip().lower()\n799\t\n800\t\n801\tdef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n802\t                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n803\t                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n804\t    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n805\t    try:\n806\t        cur = conn.execute(\n807\t            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n808\t            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n809\t            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n810\t             int(needs_setup), state),\n811\t        )\n812\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n813\t        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n814\t            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n815\t        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n816\t            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n817\t        raise\n818\t    row = None\n826\t\n827\t\n828\tdef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n829\t    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n830\t    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n831\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n832\t                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n833\t    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n834\t    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n835\t    if row is None or not password_ok:\n836\t        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n837\t    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n838\t    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n839\t        raise AccountDeactivated\n840\t    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n841\t    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n842\t                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n843\t    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE users SET last_login_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\",\n844\t                 (row[\"id\"],))\n845\t    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n846\t\n847\t\n848\tdef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n849\t    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n850\t\n851\t\n852\tMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\n853\tMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n854\t\n855\t\n856\tdef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n857\t                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n858\t    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n859\t    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n860\t    display_name = display_name.strip()\n861\t    if not display_name:\n862\t        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n863\t    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n864\t        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n865\t    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n866\t        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n867\t    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n868\t        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n869\t    if password != password_confirm:\n870\t        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n871\t    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n872\t                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n873\t    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n874\t        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n875\t    try:\n876\t        conn.execute(\n877\t            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n878\t            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n879\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n880\t        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n881\t\n882\t\n883\tdef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n884\t    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n885\t    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n886\t    if not session_id:\n887\t        return None\n888\t    row = conn.execute(\n889\t        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n890\t        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n891\t        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n892\t    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n893\t\n894\t\n895\t# User management (the Users page). Only users who can manage_users may call\n896\t# these; each refuses anyone else, whatever the route in front of it checked.\n897\t\n898\tdef _check_manages_users(actor: User) -> None:\n899\t    if not actor.can(\"manage_users\"):\n900\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以管理用户。\")\n901\t\n902\t\n903\tdef users(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[User]:\n904\t    \"\"\"Every account, Admins first, then by when it was created.\"\"\"\n905\t    _check_manages_users(actor)\n906\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'editor', id\").fetchall()\n907\t    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n908\t\n909\t\n910\t_EMAIL = re.compile(r\"[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+\")\n911\t\n912\t\n913\tdef _check_temporary_password(password: str) -> None:\n914\t    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n915\t        raise Refused(f\"临时密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n916\t\n917\t\n918\tdef create_account(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, *, email: str,\n919\t                   role: str, temporary_password: str) -> User:\n920\t    \"\"\"A new account with a temporary password. Its owner chooses their own\n921\t    password and Display name at first-login setup.\"\"\"\n922\t    _check_manages_users(actor)\n923\t    if not _EMAIL.fullmatch(email.strip()):\n924\t        raise Refused(\"请填写正确的邮箱地址。\")\n925\t    if role not in CAPABILITIES:\n926\t        raise Refused(\"请选择角色：管理员或编辑。\")\n927\t    _check_temporary_password(temporary_password)\n928\t    return create_user(conn, email=email, password=temporary_password, role=role,\n929\t                       needs_setup=True)\n930\t\n931\t\n932\t# The site must always keep an active Admin. Part of the UPDATE that would\n933\t# remove one, so the check and the change happen at once: two Admins removing\n934\t# each other at the same moment can't both succeed.\n935\t_KEEPS_AN_ADMIN = \"\"\"(users.role != 'admin' OR EXISTS (\n936\t    SELECT 1 FROM users AS other WHERE other.id != users.id\n937\t    AND other.role = 'admin' AND other.state != 'deactivated'))\"\"\"\n938\tLAST_ADMIN = \"至少要保留一位正常状态的管理员，不能停用或降级最后一位管理员。\"\n939\t\n940\t\n941\tclass AccountNotFound(Refused):\n942\t    def __init__(self) -> None:\n943\t        super().__init__(\"找不到这个账号。\")\n944\t\n945\t\n946\tdef account(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> User:\n947\t    \"\"\"The account with `user_id`. Raises AccountNotFound if there is none.\"\"\"\n948\t    _check_manages_users(actor)\n949\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n950\t    if row is None:\n951\t        raise AccountNotFound\n952\t    return _user_from_row(row)\n953\t\n954\t\n955\t# Each change below repeats its precondition in its UPDATE, so a change\n956\t# another Admin made in between (say, a Deactivation) is never overwritten.\n957\tCHANGED_MEANWHILE = \"这个账号刚被另一位管理员改过，请看看现在的状态再试。\"\n958\t\n959\t\n960\tdef _update(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: tuple[object, ...],\n961\t            refusal: str) -> None:\n962\t    if conn.execute(sql, params).rowcount == 0:\n963\t        raise Refused(refusal)\n964\t\n965\t\n966\tdef change_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int, role: str) -> None:\n967\t    \"\"\"Make the account an Admin or an Editor. It takes effect on the user's\n968\t    next request, since every request reads the role afresh.\"\"\"\n969\t    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n970\t    if role not in CAPABILITIES:\n971\t        raise Refused(\"请选择角色：管理员或编辑。\")\n972\t    if target.id == actor.id and role != target.role:\n973\t        raise Refused(\"不能修改自己的角色，请让另一位管理员来改。\")\n974\t    if role == \"admin\":\n975\t        if target.state == \"submission_ban\":\n976\t            raise Refused(\"这个账号被禁止投稿，请先解除禁止投稿，再改为管理员。\")\n977\t        _update(conn, \"UPDATE users SET role = 'admin' WHERE id = ?\"\n978\t                \" AND state != 'submission_ban'\", (target.id,), CHANGED_MEANWHILE)\n979\t    else:\n980\t        _update(conn, f\"UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ? AND {_KEEPS_AN_ADMIN}\",\n981\t                (role, target.id), LAST_ADMIN)\n982\t\n983\t\n984\tdef ban_submissions(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> None:\n985\t    \"\"\"Submission ban (禁止投稿): the Editor can still log in and work on\n986\t    Drafts, but can't Submit or open a Revision. Their Published Guides stay.\"\"\"\n987\t    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n988\t    if target.role != \"editor\":\n989\t        raise Refused(\"禁止投稿只适用于编辑；管理员发布攻略不需要投稿。\")\n990\t    if target.state != \"active\":\n991\t        raise Refused(\"这个账号已经被禁止投稿了。\" if target.state == \"submission_ban\"\n992\t                      else \"这个账号已停用，请先重新启用。\")\n993\t    _update(conn, \"UPDATE users SET state = 'submission_ban' WHERE id = ?\"\n994\t            \" AND role = 'editor' AND state = 'active'\", (target.id,), CHANGED_MEANWHILE)\n995\t\n996\t\n997\tdef lift_submission_ban(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> None:\n998\t    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n999\t    if target.state != \"submission_ban\":\n1000\t        raise Refused(\"这个账号没有被禁止投稿。\")\n1001\t"}]}}

{"parentUuid":"45f6aa67-d04c-49b0-a4dc-2719e801199a","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"c1eb83c5-b84d-415d-ac9b-da0cc5184931","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017UuSSDgjUKS11ZRmA4usY2","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The game: Game Terms and Patches.\n2\t\n3\tA Game Term is a named thing in the game, of one of seven kinds, with an\n4\tofficial Chinese and an official English name. A Hero is the kind of Game\n5\tTerm every Guide is about. A Game Term may also have nicknames, the names\n6\tplayers use for it that the game doesn't (瓦姐 for 瓦妮莎), so the editor\n7\tpreview can point them out. A Hero's URL slug is derived from the English Official name once, when the Hero\n8\tis added, and never changes after that.\n9\t\n10\tA Patch is a game version such as `6.7`. Adding one makes it the Current\n11\tPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n12\t\n13\tAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n14\t\"\"\"\n15\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n16\t\n17\timport csv\n18\timport io\n19\timport re\n20\timport sqlite3\n21\tfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator\n22\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n23\tfrom functools import partial\n24\t\n25\t\n26\tclass Refused(Exception):\n27\t    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n28\t\n29\t    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n30\t        super().__init__(message)\n31\t        self.message = message\n32\t\n33\t\n34\t# The seven kinds of Game Term, with the console's name for each.\n35\tKINDS = {\"hero\": \"英雄\", \"item\": \"物品\", \"skill\": \"技能\", \"enchantment\": \"附魔\",\n36\t         \"monster\": \"怪物\", \"merchant\": \"商人\", \"event\": \"事件\"}\n37\t\n38\t\n39\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n40\tclass Term:\n41\t    id: int\n42\t    kind: str\n43\t    name_zh: str\n44\t    name_en: str\n45\t    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n46\t\n47\t    @property\n48\t    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n49\t        return KINDS[self.kind]\n50\t\n51\t\n52\tdef _term_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Term:\n53\t    return Term(id=row[\"id\"], kind=row[\"kind\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"],\n54\t                name_en=row[\"name_en\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n55\t\n56\t\n57\tdef _stored_nicknames(row: sqlite3.Row) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n58\t    return tuple(row[\"nicknames\"].splitlines())\n59\t\n60\t\n61\tdef _to_store(nicknames: str) -> str:\n62\t    \"\"\"Nicknames as parse_nicknames reads them, stored one per line.\"\"\"\n63\t    return \"\\n\".join(parse_nicknames(nicknames))\n64\t\n65\t\n66\tdef nickname_notices(nicknames: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:\n67\t    \"\"\"A notice for each nickname that is a single Chinese character. It is\n68\t    allowed, but it matches that character anywhere, so the preview may warn\n69\t    about it often.\"\"\"\n70\t    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”只有一个汉字：预览会把正文里每一个“{nickname}”\"\n71\t            \"都当作这个外号，可能出现很多提醒。\"\n72\t            for nickname in nicknames\n73\t            if re.fullmatch(r\"[\\u3400-\\u4dbf\\u4e00-\\u9fff\\uf900-\\ufaff]\", nickname)]\n74\t\n75\t\n76\tdef parse_nicknames(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n77\t    \"\"\"The nicknames in `text`, separated by 、 or | (or one per line),\n78\t    trimmed, without blanks or repeats.\"\"\"\n79\t    names = (name.strip() for name in re.split(r\"[、|\\n]\", text))\n80\t    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(name for name in names if name))\n81\t\n82\t\n83\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n84\tclass Patch:\n85\t    id: int\n86\t    name: str\n87\t    is_current: bool\n88\t\n89\t\n90\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n91\tclass Hero:\n92\t    id: int\n93\t    name_zh: str\n94\t    name_en: str\n95\t    slug: str\n96\t    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n97\t\n98\t\n99\tdef _hero_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Hero:\n100\t    return Hero(id=row[\"id\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"], name_en=row[\"name_en\"],\n101\t                slug=row[\"slug\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n102\t\n103\t\n104\tdef slugify(name_en: str) -> str:\n105\t    \"\"\"`Vanessa` -> `vanessa`, `Black Knight` -> `black-knight`.\"\"\"\n106\t    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n107\t\n108\t\n109\tdef _checked_names(name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n110\t    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed. Raises Refused if either is missing.\"\"\"\n111\t    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n112\t    if not name_zh:\n113\t        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n114\t    if not name_en:\n115\t        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n116\t    return name_zh, name_en\n117\t\n118\t\n119\tdef _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn: sqlite3.Connection, kind: str,\n120\t                                 name_en: str, term_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n121\t    \"\"\"Raises Refused if another Game Term of this kind already has this\n122\t    English Official name, ignoring case. Compared in Python, as SQLite's\n123\t    lower() folds only ASCII.\"\"\"\n124\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n125\t                        (kind, term_id))\n126\t    for clash in rows:\n127\t        if clash[\"name_en\"].casefold() == name_en.casefold():\n128\t            raise Refused(f\"官方英文名 {clash['name_en']} 已被{KINDS[kind]}\"\n129\t                          f\" {clash['name_zh']} 使用。\")\n130\t\n131\t\n132\tdef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n133\t                            name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n134\t    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n135\t    either name is missing or another Hero already has that English name or\n136\t    slug.\"\"\"\n137\t    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n138\t    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, \"hero\", name_en)\n139\t    slug = slugify(name_en)\n140\t    if not slug:\n141\t        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n142\t    clash = conn.execute(\n143\t        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ?\",\n144\t        (slug,)).fetchone()\n145\t    if clash:\n146\t        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被英雄\"\n147\t                      f\" {clash['name_zh']}（{clash['name_en']}）使用。\")\n148\t    return name_zh, name_en, slug\n149\t\n150\t\n151\tdef add_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, name_zh: str, name_en: str,\n152\t             nicknames: str = \"\") -> Hero:\n153\t    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the English name\n154\t    or slug is taken. `nicknames` is as parse_nicknames reads it.\"\"\"\n155\t    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)\n156\t    cur = conn.execute(\n157\t        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, slug, nicknames)\"\n158\t        \" VALUES ('hero', ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n159\t        (name_zh, name_en, slug, _to_store(nicknames)))\n160\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n161\t                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n162\t    return _hero_from_row(row)\n163\t\n164\t\n165\tdef hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int) -> Hero | None:\n166\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\",\n167\t                       (hero_id,)).fetchone()\n168\t    return _hero_from_row(row) if row else None\n169\t\n170\t\n171\tdef edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n172\t              name_en: str, nicknames: str) -> None:\n173\t    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names and nicknames; its slug stays the one\n174\t    it was given when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move.\"\"\"\n175\t    if hero(conn, hero_id) is None:\n176\t        raise Refused(\"找不到这个英雄。\")\n177\t    edit_term(conn, hero_id, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en, nicknames=nicknames)\n178\t\n179\t\n180\tdef heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:\n181\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero'\"\n182\t                        \" ORDER BY name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n183\t    return [_hero_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n184\t\n185\t\n186\tdef add_term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, kind: str, name_zh: str,\n187\t             name_en: str, nicknames: str = \"\") -> Term:\n188\t    \"\"\"Add a Game Term of a kind other than Hero (Heroes need a slug: see\n189\t    add_hero). Raises Refused if the kind is unknown, either Official name\n190\t    is missing, or another term of the kind has the English name.\"\"\"\n191\t    if kind not in KINDS or kind == \"hero\":\n192\t        raise Refused(\"请选择术语种类。\")\n193\t    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n194\t    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, kind, name_en)\n195\t    cur = conn.execute(\n196\t        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, nicknames)\"\n197\t        \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n198\t        (kind, name_zh, name_en, _to_store(nicknames)))\n199\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n200\t                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n201\t    return _term_from_row(row)\n202\t\n203\t\n204\tdef term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term_id: int) -> Term | None:\n205\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n206\t                       (term_id,)).fetchone()\n207\t    return _term_from_row(row) if row else None\n208\t\n209\t\n210\tdef edit_term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n211\t              name_en: str, nicknames: str) -> None:\n212\t    \"\"\"Change a Game Term's Official names and nicknames (never its kind, nor\n213\t    a Hero's slug). Raises Refused if either name is missing or another term\n214\t    of its kind has the English name.\"\"\"\n215\t    current = term(conn, term_id)\n216\t    if current is None:\n217\t        raise Refused(\"找不到这个游戏术语。\")\n218\t    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n219\t    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, current.kind, name_en, term_id)\n220\t    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, nicknames = ?\"\n221\t                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en,\n222\t                                   _to_store(nicknames), term_id))\n223\t\n224\t\n225\t# Sorts Game Terms in KINDS order.\n226\t_BY_KIND = (\"CASE kind \" + \" \".join(f\"WHEN '{kind}' THEN {i}\"\n227\t                                    for i, kind in enumerate(KINDS)) + \" END\")\n228\t\n229\t\n230\tclass Glossary:\n231\t    \"\"\"Every Game Term, Heroes included, looked up by either Official name\n232\t    (trimmed, ignoring case). Where several terms share a name, they come in\n233\t    KINDS order (Heroes first), then in the order they were added.\"\"\"\n234\t\n235\t    def __init__(self, terms: Iterable[Term]) -> None:\n236\t        self.terms = list(terms)\n237\t        self._by_name: dict[str, list[Term]] = {}\n238\t        for term in self.terms:\n239\t            for name in {term.name_zh.casefold(), term.name_en.casefold()}:\n240\t                self._by_name.setdefault(name, []).append(term)\n241\t\n242\t    def matching(self, name: str) -> list[Term]:\n243\t        return self._by_name.get(name.strip().casefold(), [])\n244\t\n245\t    def nicknames_in(self, text: str) -> list[tuple[str, Term, int]]:\n246\t        \"\"\"Each known nickname found in `text`, with its Game Term and how\n247\t        many times it is there. Case is ignored, and a nickname starting or\n248\t        ending in a Latin letter or digit must be a whole word at that end\n249\t        (`Van` is not found in `Vanguard`), while Chinese has no spaces to\n250\t        mark words, so 瓦姐 is found anywhere (see nickname_notices).\"\"\"\n251\t        found = [(nickname, term,\n252\t                  len(re.findall(_whole_word(nickname), text, re.IGNORECASE)))\n253\t                 for term in self.terms for nickname in term.nicknames]\n254\t        return [(nickname, term, count) for nickname, term, count in found if count]\n255\t\n256\t\n257\tdef _whole_word(nickname: str) -> str:\n258\t    pattern = re.escape(nickname)\n259\t    if re.match(r\"[A-Za-z0-9]\", nickname):\n260\t        pattern = r\"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])\" + pattern\n261\t    if re.search(r\"[A-Za-z0-9]$\", nickname):\n262\t        pattern += r\"(?![A-Za-z0-9])\"\n263\t    return pattern\n264\t\n265\t\n266\tdef glossary(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> Glossary:\n267\t    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT * FROM game_terms ORDER BY {_BY_KIND}, id\")\n268\t    return Glossary(_term_from_row(row) for row in rows)\n269\t\n270\t\n271\tdef terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Term]:\n272\t    \"\"\"Every Game Term but the Heroes, by kind, then English name.\"\"\"\n273\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind != 'hero'\"\n274\t                        f\" ORDER BY {_BY_KIND}, name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n275\t    return [_term_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n276\t\n277\t\n278\tdef add_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Patch:\n279\t    \"\"\"Add a Patch, which becomes the Current Patch.\n280\t    Raises Refused if the name is blank or the Patch already exists.\"\"\"\n281\t    name = name.strip()\n282\t    if not name:\n283\t        raise Refused(\"请填写版本号，例如 6.7。\")\n284\t    try:\n285\t        cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO patches (name) VALUES (?)\", (name,))\n286\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n287\t        raise Refused(f\"版本 {name} 已存在。\") from None\n288\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches WHERE id = ?\",\n289\t                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n290\t    return Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=True)\n291\t\n292\t\n293\tdef patches(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Patch]:\n294\t    \"\"\"Every Patch, newest first; the first is the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n295\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches ORDER BY id DESC\").fetchall()\n296\t    return [Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=(i == 0))\n297\t            for i, row in enumerate(rows)]\n298\t\n299\t\n300\t# CSV import. The file's first row names its columns: kind, name_zh, name_en,\n301\t# and optionally nicknames. A row whose kind and English Official name\n302\t# (ignoring case) match an existing Game Term changes that term; any other\n303\t# row adds one. Bad rows are rejected one by one, so the good ones can still\n304\t# be imported.\n305\t\n306\tCSV_COLUMNS = (\"kind\", \"name_zh\", \"name_en\")\n307\t\n308\t\n309\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n310\tclass CsvRow:\n311\t    number: int  # the row number a spreadsheet shows, the header being row 1\n312\t    kind: str\n313\t    name_zh: str\n314\t    name_en: str\n315\t    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n316\t\n317\t\n318\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n319\tclass ImportPlan:\n320\t    added: list[CsvRow]\n321\t    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]]  # the term as it is, and its row\n322\t    unchanged: int\n323\t    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]]  # (row number, reason)\n324\t\n325\t\n326\tdef _kind_of(written: str) -> str | None:\n327\t    \"\"\"The kind a CSV cell names, by its English key or its Chinese name.\"\"\"\n328\t    written = written.strip()\n329\t    return next((kind for kind, label in KINDS.items()\n330\t                 if written.casefold() == kind or written == label), None)\n331\t\n332\t\n333\tdef _csv_rows(csv_bytes: bytes) -> Iterator[tuple[int, dict[str, str]]]:\n334\t    \"\"\"The file's rows after the header, numbered, with their cells trimmed;\n335\t    wholly blank rows are skipped. Raises Refused if the file isn't UTF-8 or\n336\t    lacks the header, or once a row can't be read as CSV.\"\"\"\n337\t    try:\n338\t        text = csv_bytes.decode(\"utf-8-sig\")  # Excel starts its UTF-8 with a BOM\n339\t    except UnicodeDecodeError:\n340\t        raise Refused(\"读不出这个文件。请把 CSV 存成 UTF-8 编码后再上传。\") from None\n341\t    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))\n342\t    try:\n343\t        header = [cell.strip().lower() for cell in next(reader, [])]\n344\t    except csv.Error:\n345\t        header = []\n346\t    if not set(CSV_COLUMNS) <= set(header):\n347\t        raise Refused(\"CSV 第一行必须是表头：kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames\"\n348\t                      \"（nicknames 一列可以省略）。\")\n349\t    try:\n350\t        for number, cells in enumerate(reader, start=2):\n351\t            row = {column: cell.strip() for column, cell in zip(header, cells)}\n352\t            if any(row.values()):\n353\t                yield number, row\n354\t    except csv.Error as error:\n355\t        raise Refused(f\"读不出这个 CSV 文件（第 {reader.line_num} 行附近：{error}）。\"\n356\t                      \"请检查引号是否成对。\") from None\n357\t\n358\t\n359\tdef plan_import(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes) -> ImportPlan:\n360\t    \"\"\"What importing the CSV file would add and change, and the rows it\n361\t    would reject with the reason for each. Nothing is saved. An empty\n362\t    nicknames cell keeps the nicknames a term already has.\"\"\"\n363\t    existing = {(term.kind, term.name_en.casefold()): term\n364\t                for term in glossary(conn).terms}\n365\t    added: list[CsvRow] = []\n366\t    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]] = []\n367\t    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]] = []\n368\t    unchanged = 0\n369\t    row_of_term: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}  # each term's first row\n370\t    row_of_new_slug: dict[str, int] = {}\n371\t    for number, cells in _csv_rows(csv_bytes):\n372\t        kind = _kind_of(cells.get(\"kind\", \"\"))\n373\t        name_zh, name_en = cells.get(\"name_zh\", \"\"), cells.get(\"name_en\", \"\")\n374\t        if kind is None:\n375\t            rejected.append((number, f\"未知的种类“{cells.get('kind', '')}”。种类须是\"\n376\t                             f\"{'、'.join(KINDS.values())}之一，\"\n377\t                             f\"或其英文（{', '.join(KINDS)}）。\"))\n378\t            continue\n379\t        if not name_zh or not name_en:\n380\t            rejected.append((number, f\"缺少官方{'中' if not name_zh else '英'}文名。\"))\n381\t            continue\n382\t        key = (kind, name_en.casefold())\n383\t        if key in row_of_term:\n384\t            rejected.append((number, f\"和第 {row_of_term[key]} 行是同一个游戏术语\"\n385\t                             \"（种类和官方英文名都相同）。\"))\n386\t            continue\n387\t        row_of_term[key] = number\n388\t        row = CsvRow(number, kind, name_zh, name_en,\n389\t                     parse_nicknames(cells.get(\"nicknames\", \"\")))\n390\t        term = existing.get(key)\n391\t        if term is None and kind == \"hero\":\n392\t            try:\n393\t                slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)[2]\n394\t            except Refused as refused:\n395\t                rejected.append((number, refused.message))\n396\t                continue\n397\t            if slug in row_of_new_slug:\n398\t                rejected.append((number, f\"网址名 {slug} 已被第\"\n399\t                                 f\" {row_of_new_slug[slug]} 行的英雄使用。\"))\n400\t                continue\n401\t            row_of_new_slug[slug] = number\n402\t        if term is None:\n403\t            added.append(row)\n404\t        elif (term.name_zh, term.name_en) != (name_zh, name_en) or (\n405\t                row.nicknames and row.nicknames != term.nicknames):\n406\t            changed.append((term, row))\n407\t        else:\n408\t            unchanged += 1\n409\t    return ImportPlan(added, changed, unchanged, rejected)\n410\t\n411\t\n412\tdef import_terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes, *,\n413\t                 only_new: bool = False) -> ImportPlan:\n414\t    \"\"\"Import the CSV file's good rows, as plan_import plans, and say what\n415\t    was done. With `only_new`, Game Terms that already exist are left as\n416\t    they are, and the plan says nothing changed.\"\"\"\n417\t    plan = plan_import(conn, csv_bytes)\n418\t    if only_new:\n419\t        plan = ImportPlan(plan.added, [], plan.unchanged + len(plan.changed),\n420\t                          plan.rejected)\n421\t    for row in plan.added:\n422\t        add = add_hero if row.kind == \"hero\" else partial(add_term, kind=row.kind)\n423\t        add(conn, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n424\t            nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames))\n425\t    for term, row in plan.changed:\n426\t        edit_term(conn, term.id, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n427\t                  nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames or term.nicknames))\n428\t    return
