redirect(\"/admin/patches\")\n694\t\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n695\t\n696\tPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\n697\ta random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\n698\tcookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\n699\teven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n700\t\n701\tAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n702\t\"\"\"\n703\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n704\t\n705\timport re\n706\timport secrets\n707\timport sqlite3\n708\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n709\t\n710\tfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\n711\tfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n712\t\n713\tfrom app import db\n714\t\n715\t_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n716\t# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n717\t# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n718\t_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n719\t\n720\tBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\n721\tDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n722\t\n723\t\n724\tclass Refused(Exception):\n725\t    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n726\t\n727\t    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n728\t        super().__init__(message)\n729\t        self.message = message\n730\t\n731\t\n732\tclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n733\t    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this action.\"\"\"\n734\t\n735\t\n736\tclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n737\t    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n738\t\n739\t    def __init__(self) -> None:\n740\t        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n741\t\n742\t\n743\t# A role is a bundle of capabilities. Code asks `user.can(...)`, never which\n744\t# role someone has, so a rule can move between roles without touching callers.\n745\tCAPABILITIES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n746\t    \"admin\": frozenset({\n747\t        \"publish_guides\",      # Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts;\n748\t                               # Return and Unpublish Guides\n749\t        \"manage_all_guides\",   # see and edit everyone's Guides, any Hero\n750\t        \"edit_guide_slugs\",\n751\t        \"manage_trash\",        # see the Trash, restore from it, delete for good\n752\t        \"manage_game\",         # Heroes and Patches\n753\t        \"build_site\",          # 更新网站: the Site build and deploy\n754\t        \"manage_users\",        # the Users page and everything on it\n755\t    }),\n756\t    \"editor\": frozenset(),\n757\t}\n758\t\n759\t# Shown on every console page to a banned Editor, and as the reason Submit and\n760\t# opening a Revision are      last_login_at=row[\"last_login_at\"])\n788\t\n789\t\n790\tdef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n791\t    try:\n792\t        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, None\n826\t\n827\t\n828\tdef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n829\t    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n830\t    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n831\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n832\t                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n833\t    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n834\t    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n835\t    if row is None or not password_ok:\n836\t        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n837\t    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n838\t    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n839\t        raise row[\"id\"]))\n843\t    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE users SET last_login_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\",\n844\t                 (row[\"id\"],))\n845\t    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n846\t\n847\t\n848\tdef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n849\t    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n850\t\n851\t\n852\tMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\n853\tMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n854\t\n855\t\n856\tdef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n857\t                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n858\t    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n859\t    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n860\t    display_name = display_name.strip()\n861\t    if not display_name:\n862\t        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n863\t    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n864\t        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n865\t    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n866\t        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n867\t    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n868\t        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n869\t    if password != password_confirm:\n870\t        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n871\t    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n872\t                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n873\t    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n874\t        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n875\t    try:\n876\t        conn.execute(\n877\t            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n878\t            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n879\t    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n880\t        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n881\t\n882\t\n883\tdef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n884\t    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n885\t    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n886\t    if not session_id:\n887\t        return None\n888\t    row = conn.execute(\n889\t        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n890\t        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n891\t        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n892\t    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n893\t\n894\t\n895\t# User management (the Users page). Only users who can manage_users may call\n896\t# these; each refuses anyone else, whatever the route in front of it checked.\n897\t\n898\tdef _check_manages_users(actor: User) -> None:\n899\t    if not actor.can(\"manage_users\"):\n900\t        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以管理用户。\")\n901\t\n902\t\n903\tdef users(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[User]:\n904\t    \"\"\"Every account, Admins first, then by when it was created.\"\"\"\n905\t    _check_manages_users(actor)\n906\t    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'editor', id\").fetchall()\n907\t    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n908\t\n909\t\n910\t_EMAIL = re.compile(r\"[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+\")\n911\t\n912\t\n913\tdef _check_temporary_password(password: str) -> None:\n914\t    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n915\t        raise Refused(f\"临时密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n916\t\n917\t\n918\tdef create_account(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, *, email: str,\n919\t                   role: str, temporary_password: str) -> User:\n920\t    \"\"\"A new account with a temporary password. Its owner chooses their own\n921\t    password and Display name at first-login setup.\"\"\"\n922\t    _check_manages_users(actor)\n923\t    if not _EMAIL.fullmatch(email.strip()):\n924\t        raise Refused(\"请填写正确的邮箱地址。\")\n925\t    if role not in CAPABILITIES:\n926\t        raise Refused(\"请选择角色：管理员或编辑。\")\n927\t    _check_temporary_password(temporary_password)\n928\t    return create_user(conn, email=email, password=temporary_password, role=role,\n929\t                       needs_setup=True)\n930\t\n931\t\n932\t# The site must always keep an active Admin. Part of the UPDATE that would\n933\t# remove one, so the check and the change happen at once: two Admins removing\n934\t# each other at the same moment can't both succeed.\n935\t_KEEPS_AN_ADMIN = \"\"\"(users.role != 'admin' OR EXISTS (\n936\t    SELECT 1 FROM users AS other WHERE other.id != users.id\n937\t    AND other.role = 'admin' AND other.state != 'deactivated'))\"\"\"\n938\tLAST_ADMIN = \"至少要保留一位正常状态的管理员，不能停用或降级最后一位管理员。\"\n939\t\n940\t\n941\tclass AccountNotFound(Refused):\n942\t    def __init__(self) -> None:\n943\t        super().__init__(\"找不到这个账号。\")\n944\t\n945\t\n946\tdef account(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> User:\n947\t    \"\"\"The account with `user_id`. Raises AccountNotFound if there is none.\"\"\"\n948\t    _check_manages_users(actor)\n949\t    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n950\t    if row is None:\n951\t        raise AccountNotFound\n952\t    return _user_from_row(row)\n953\t\n954\t\n955\t# Each change below repeats its precondition in its UPDATE, so a change\n956\t# another Admin made in between (say, a Deactivation) is never overwritten.\n957\tCHANGED_MEANWHILE = \"这个账号刚被另一位管理员改过，请看看现在的状态再试。\"\n958\t\n959\t\n960\tdef _update(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: tuple[object, ...],\n961\t            refusal: str) -> None:\n962\t    if conn.execute(sql, params).rowcount == 0:\n963\t        raise Refused(refusal)\n964\t\n965\t\n966\tdef change_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int, role: str) -> None:\n967\t    \"\"\"Make the account an Admin or an Editor. It takes effect on the user's\n968\t    next request, since every request reads the role afresh.\"\"\"\n969\t    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n970\t    if role not in CAPABILITIES:\n971\t        raise Refused(\"请选择角色：管理员或编辑。\")\n972\t    if target.id == actor.id and role != target.role:\n973\t        raise Refused(\"不能修改自己的角色，请让另一位管理员来改。\")\n974\t    if role == \"admin\":\n975\t        if target.state == \"submission_ban\":\n976\t            raise Refused(\"这个账号被禁止投稿，请先解除禁止投稿，再改为管理员。\")\n977\t        _update(conn, \"UPDATE users SET role = 'admin' WHERE id = ?\"\n978\t                \" AND state != 'submission_ban'\", (target.id,), CHANGED_MEANWHILE)\n979\t    else:\n980\t        _update(conn, f\"UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ? AND {_KEEPS_AN_ADMIN}\",\n981\t                (role, target.id), LAST_ADMIN)\n982\t\n983\t\n984\tdef ban_submissions(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> None:\n985\t    \"\"\"Submission ban (禁止投稿): the Editor can still log in and work on\n986\t    Drafts, but can't Submit or open a Revision. Their Published Guides stay.\"\"\"\n987\t    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n988\t    if target.role != \"editor\":\n989\t        raise Refused(\"禁止投稿只适用于编辑；管理员发布攻略不需要投稿。\")\n990\t    if target.state != \"active\":\n991\t        raise Refused(\"这个账号已经被禁止投稿了。\" if target.state == \"submission_ban\"\n992\t                      else \"这个账号已停用，请先重新启用。\")\n993\t    _update(conn, \"UPDATE users SET state = 'submission_ban' WHERE id = ?\"\n994\t            \" AND role = 'editor' AND state = 'active'\", (target.id,), CHANGED_MEANWHILE)\n995\t\n996\t\n997\tdef lift_submission_ban(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> None:\n998\t    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n999\t    if target.state != \"submission_ban\":\n1000\t        raise Refused(\"这个账号没有被禁止投稿。\")\n1001\t"}]},"uuid":"48d89a7f-e9b0-4e5c-8bd9-eb63e7628178","timestamp":"2026-10-18T02:28:55.198Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/.claude/projects/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5/tool-results/bd4jjxq21.txt","content":"\"\"\"The game: Game Terms and Patches.\n\nA Game Term is a named thing in the game, of one of seven kinds, with an\nofficial Chinese and an official English name. A Hero is the kind of Game\nTerm every Guide is about. A Game Term may also have nicknames, the names\nplayers use for it that the game doesn't (瓦姐 for 瓦妮莎), so the editor\npreview can point them out. A Hero's URL slug is derived from the English Official name once, when the Hero\nis added, and never changes after that.\n\nA Patch is a game version such as `6.7`. Adding one makes it the Current\nPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom functools import partial\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\n# The seven kinds of Game Term, with the console's name for each.\nKINDS = {\"hero\": \"英雄\", \"item\": \"物品\", \"skill\": \"技能\", \"enchantment\": \"附魔\",\n         \"monster\": \"怪物\", \"merchant\": \"商人\", \"event\": \"事件\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Term:\n    id: int\n    kind: str\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n\n    @property\n    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n        return KINDS[self.kind]\n\n\ndef _term_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Term:\n    return Term(id=row[\"id\"], kind=row[\"kind\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"],\n                name_en=row[\"name_en\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n\n\ndef _stored_nicknames(row: sqlite3.Row) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n    return tuple(row[\"nicknames\"].splitlines())\n\n\ndef _to_store(nicknames: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Nicknames as parse_nicknames reads them, stored one per line.\"\"\"\n    return \"\\n\".join(parse_nicknames(nicknames))\n\n\ndef nickname_notices(nicknames: Iterable[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"A notice for each nickname that is a single Chinese character. It is\n    allowed, but it matches that character anywhere, so the preview may warn\n    about it often.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”只有一个汉字：预览会把正文里每一个“{nickname}”\"\n            \"都当作这个外号，可能出现很多提醒。\"\n            for nickname in nicknames\n            if re.fullmatch(r\"[\\u3400-\\u4dbf\\u4e00-\\u9fff\\uf900-\\ufaff]\", nickname)]\n\n\ndef parse_nicknames(text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:\n    \"\"\"The nicknames in `text`, separated by 、 or | (or one per line),\n    trimmed, without blanks or repeats.\"\"\"\n    names = (name.strip() for name in re.split(r\"[、|\\n]\", text))\n    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(name for name in names if name))\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Patch:\n    id: int\n    name: str\n    is_current: bool\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Hero:\n    id: int\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    slug: str\n    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\ndef _hero_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Hero:\n    return Hero(id=row[\"id\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"], name_en=row[\"name_en\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"], nicknames=_stored_nicknames(row))\n\n\ndef slugify(name_en: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`Vanessa` -> `vanessa`, `Black Knight` -> `black-knight`.\"\"\"\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _checked_names(name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed. Raises Refused if either is missing.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n    if not name_zh:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n    if not name_en:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n    return name_zh, name_en\n\n\ndef _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn: sqlite3.Connection, kind: str,\n                                 name_en: str, term_id: int | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if another Game Term of this kind already has this\n    English Official name, ignoring case. Compared in Python, as SQLite's\n    lower() folds only ASCII.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                        (kind, term_id))\n    for clash in rows:\n        if clash[\"name_en\"].casefold() == name_en.casefold():\n            raise Refused(f\"官方英文名 {clash['name_en']} 已被{KINDS[kind]}\"\n                          f\" {clash['name_zh']} 使用。\")\n\n\ndef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n                            name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n    either name is missing or another Hero already has that English name or\n    slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, \"hero\", name_en)\n    slug = slugify(name_en)\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n    clash = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ?\",\n        (slug,)).fetchone()\n    if clash:\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被英雄\"\n                      f\" {clash['name_zh']}（{clash['name_en']}）使用。\")\n    return name_zh, name_en, slug\n\n\ndef add_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, name_zh: str, name_en: str,\n             nicknames: str = \"\") -> Hero:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the English name\n    or slug is taken. `nicknames` is as parse_nicknames reads it.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, slug, nicknames)\"\n        \" VALUES ('hero', ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (name_zh, name_en, slug, _to_store(nicknames)))\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int) -> Hero | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\",\n                       (hero_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n              name_en: str, nicknames: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names and nicknames; its slug stays the one\n    it was given when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move.\"\"\"\n    if hero(conn, hero_id) is None:\n        raise Refused(\"找不到这个英雄。\")\n    edit_term(conn, hero_id, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en, nicknames=nicknames)\n\n\ndef heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n    return [_hero_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add_term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, kind: str, name_zh: str,\n             name_en: str, nicknames: str = \"\") -> Term:\n    \"\"\"Add a Game Term of a kind other than Hero (Heroes need a slug: see\n    add_hero). Raises Refused if the kind is unknown, either Official name\n    is missing, or another term of the kind has the English name.\"\"\"\n    if kind not in KINDS or kind == \"hero\":\n        raise Refused(\"请选择术语种类。\")\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, kind, name_en)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, nicknames)\"\n        \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (kind, name_zh, name_en, _to_store(nicknames)))\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _term_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term_id: int) -> Term | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (term_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _term_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef edit_term(conn: sqlite3.Connection, term_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n              name_en: str, nicknames: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change a Game Term's Official names and nicknames (never its kind, nor\n    a Hero's slug). Raises Refused if either name is missing or another term\n    of its kind has the English name.\"\"\"\n    current = term(conn, term_id)\n    if current is None:\n        raise Refused(\"找不到这个游戏术语。\")\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, current.kind, name_en, term_id)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, nicknames = ?\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en,\n                                   _to_store(nicknames), term_id))\n\n\n# Sorts Game Terms in KINDS order.\n_BY_KIND = (\"CASE kind \" + \" \".join(f\"WHEN '{kind}' THEN {i}\"\n                                    for i, kind in enumerate(KINDS)) + \" END\")\n\n\nclass Glossary:\n    \"\"\"Every Game Term, Heroes included, looked up by either Official name\n    (trimmed, ignoring case). Where several terms share a name, they come in\n    KINDS order (Heroes first), then in the order they were added.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, terms: Iterable[Term]) -> None:\n        self.terms = list(terms)\n        self._by_name: dict[str, list[Term]] = {}\n        for term in self.terms:\n            for name in {term.name_zh.casefold(), term.name_en.casefold()}:\n                self._by_name.setdefault(name, []).append(term)\n\n    def matching(self, name: str) -> list[Term]:\n        return self._by_name.get(name.strip().casefold(), [])\n\n    def nicknames_in(self, text: str) -> list[tuple[str, Term, int]]:\n        \"\"\"Each known nickname found in `text`, with its Game Term and how\n        many times it is there. Case is ignored, and a nickname starting or\n        ending in a Latin letter or digit must be a whole word at that end\n        (`Van` is not found in `Vanguard`), while Chinese has no spaces to\n        mark words, so 瓦姐 is found anywhere (see nickname_notices).\"\"\"\n        found = [(nickname, term,\n                  len(re.findall(_whole_word(nickname), text, re.IGNORECASE)))\n                 for term in self.terms for nickname in term.nicknames]\n        return [(nickname, term, count) for nickname, term, count in found if count]\n\n\ndef _whole_word(nickname: str) -> str:\n    pattern = re.escape(nickname)\n    if re.match(r\"[A-Za-z0-9]\", nickname):\n        pattern = r\"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])\" + pattern\n    if re.search(r\"[A-Za-z0-9]$\", nickname):\n        pattern += r\"(?![A-Za-z0-9])\"\n    return pattern\n\n\ndef glossary(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> Glossary:\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"SELECT * FROM game_terms ORDER BY {_BY_KIND}, id\")\n    return Glossary(_term_from_row(row) for row in rows)\n\n\ndef terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Term]:\n    \"\"\"Every Game Term but the Heroes, by kind, then English name.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind != 'hero'\"\n                        f\" ORDER BY {_BY_KIND}, name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n    return [_term_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Patch:\n    \"\"\"Add a Patch, which becomes the Current Patch.\n    Raises Refused if the name is blank or the Patch already exists.\"\"\"\n    name = name.strip()\n    if not name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写版本号，例如 6.7。\")\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO patches (name) VALUES (?)\", (name,))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(f\"版本 {name} 已存在。\") from None\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=True)\n\n\ndef patches(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Patch]:\n    \"\"\"Every Patch, newest first; the first is the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches ORDER BY id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=(i == 0))\n            for i, row in enumerate(rows)]\n\n\n# CSV import. The file's first row names its columns: kind, name_zh, name_en,\n# and optionally nicknames. A row whose kind and English Official name\n# (ignoring case) match an existing Game Term changes that term; any other\n# row adds one. Bad rows are rejected one by one, so the good ones can still\n# be imported.\n\nCSV_COLUMNS = (\"kind\", \"name_zh\", \"name_en\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass CsvRow:\n    number: int  # the row number a spreadsheet shows, the header being row 1\n    kind: str\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    nicknames: tuple[str, ...]\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass ImportPlan:\n    added: list[CsvRow]\n    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]]  # the term as it is, and its row\n    unchanged: int\n    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]]  # (row number, reason)\n\n\ndef _kind_of(written: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The kind a CSV cell names, by its English key or its Chinese name.\"\"\"\n    written = written.strip()\n    return next((kind for kind, label in KINDS.items()\n                 if written.casefold() == kind or written == label), None)\n\n\ndef _csv_rows(csv_bytes: bytes) -> Iterator[tuple[int, dict[str, str]]]:\n    \"\"\"The file's rows after the header, numbered, with their cells trimmed;\n    wholly blank rows are skipped. Raises Refused if the file isn't UTF-8 or\n    lacks the header, or once a row can't be read as CSV.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        text = csv_bytes.decode(\"utf-8-sig\")  # Excel starts its UTF-8 with a BOM\n    except UnicodeDecodeError:\n        raise Refused(\"读不出这个文件。请把 CSV 存成 UTF-8 编码后再上传。\") from None\n    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(text))\n    try:\n        header = [cell.strip().lower() for cell in next(reader, [])]\n    except csv.Error:\n        header = []\n    if not set(CSV_COLUMNS) <= set(header):\n        raise Refused(\"CSV 第一行必须是表头：kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames\"\n                      \"（nicknames 一列可以省略）。\")\n    try:\n        for number, cells in enumerate(reader, start=2):\n            row = {column: cell.strip() for column, cell in zip(header, cells)}\n            if any(row.values()):\n                yield number, row\n    except csv.Error as error:\n        raise Refused(f\"读不出这个 CSV 文件（第 {reader.line_num} 行附近：{error}）。\"\n                      \"请检查引号是否成对。\") from None\n\n\ndef plan_import(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes) -> ImportPlan:\n    \"\"\"What importing the CSV file would add and change, and the rows it\n    would reject with the reason for each. Nothing is saved. An empty\n    nicknames cell keeps the nicknames a term already has.\"\"\"\n    existing = {(term.kind, term.name_en.casefold()): term\n                for term in glossary(conn).terms}\n    added: list[CsvRow] = []\n    changed: list[tuple[Term, CsvRow]] = []\n    rejected: list[tuple[int, str]] = []\n    unchanged = 0\n    row_of_term: dict[tuple[str, str], int] = {}  # each term's first row\n    row_of_new_slug: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for number, cells in _csv_rows(csv_bytes):\n        kind = _kind_of(cells.get(\"kind\", \"\"))\n        name_zh, name_en = cells.get(\"name_zh\", \"\"), cells.get(\"name_en\", \"\")\n        if kind is None:\n            rejected.append((number, f\"未知的种类“{cells.get('kind', '')}”。种类须是\"\n                             f\"{'、'.join(KINDS.values())}之一，\"\n                             f\"或其英文（{', '.join(KINDS)}）。\"))\n            continue\n        if not name_zh or not name_en:\n            rejected.append((number, f\"缺少官方{'中' if not name_zh else '英'}文名。\"))\n            continue\n        key = (kind, name_en.casefold())\n        if key in row_of_term:\n            rejected.append((number, f\"和第 {row_of_term[key]} 行是同一个游戏术语\"\n                             \"（种类和官方英文名都相同）。\"))\n            continue\n        row_of_term[key] = number\n        row = CsvRow(number, kind, name_zh, name_en,\n                     parse_nicknames(cells.get(\"nicknames\", \"\")))\n        term = existing.get(key)\n        if term is None and kind == \"hero\":\n            try:\n                slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)[2]\n            except Refused as refused:\n                rejected.append((number, refused.message))\n                continue\n            if slug in row_of_new_slug:\n                rejected.append((number, f\"网址名 {slug} 已被第\"\n                                 f\" {row_of_new_slug[slug]} 行的英雄使用。\"))\n                continue\n            row_of_new_slug[slug] = number\n        if term is None:\n            added.append(row)\n        elif (term.name_zh, term.name_en) != (name_zh, name_en) or (\n                row.nicknames and row.nicknames != term.nicknames):\n            changed.append((term, row))\n        else:\n            unchanged += 1\n    return ImportPlan(added, changed, unchanged, rejected)\n\n\ndef import_terms(conn: sqlite3.Connection, csv_bytes: bytes, *,\n                 only_new: bool = False) -> ImportPlan:\n    \"\"\"Import the CSV file's good rows, as plan_import plans, and say what\n    was done. With `only_new`, Game Terms that already exist are left as\n    they are, and the plan says nothing changed.\"\"\"\n    plan = plan_import(conn, csv_bytes)\n    if only_new:\n        plan = ImportPlan(plan.added, [], plan.unchanged + len(plan.changed),\n                          plan.rejected)\n    for row in plan.added:\n        add = add_hero if row.kind == \"hero\" else partial(add_term, kind=row.kind)\n        add(conn, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n            nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames))\n    for term, row in plan.changed:\n        edit_term(conn, term.id, name_zh=row.name_zh, name_en=row.name_en,\n                  nicknames=\"\\n\".join(row.nicknames or term.nicknames))\n    return plan\n\"\"\"Game Terms (Heroes on their own page) and Patches, managed by Admins only.\n\nThe router itself requires an Admin, so no route here can forget to; each\nroute's own `admin_user` is the same (cached) check, there to get the user.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport base64\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, terms, \"kinds\": game.KINDS,\n         \"kind\": kind, \"name_zh\": name_zh, \"name_en\": name_en,\n         \"nicknames\": nicknames, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=400 if error else Nothing is\n    saved until the Admin confirms; the file comes back with that form.\"\"\"\n    csv_bytes = file.file.read() if file else b\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            plan = game.plan_import(conn, csv_bytes)\n    except game.Refused as refused:\n        return import_page(request, user, error=refused.message)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n base64.b64encode(csv_bytes).decode()})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/terms/import/confirm\")\ndef confirm_term_import(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(admin_user)],\n int) -> game.Term:\n    \"\"\"A Game Term other than a Hero (whose edit page is on the Hero list).\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        term = game.term(conn, term_id)\n    if term is None redirect(\"/admin/patches\")\n\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\nfrom app import db\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this action.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n# A role is a bundle of capabilities. Code asks `user.can(...)`, never which\n# role someone has, so a rule can move between roles without touching callers.\nCAPABILITIES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"admin\": frozenset({\n        \"publish_guides\",      # Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts;\n                               # Return and Unpublish Guides\n        \"manage_all_guides\",   # see and edit everyone's Guides, any Hero\n        \"edit_guide_slugs\",\n        \"manage_trash\",        # see the Trash, restore from it, delete for good\n        \"manage_game\",         # Heroes and Patches\n        \"build_site\",          # 更新网站: the Site build and deploy\n        \"manage_users\",        # the Users page and everything on it\n    }),\n    \"editor\": frozenset(),\n}\n\n# Shown on every console page to a banned Editor, and as the reason Submit and\n# opening a Revision are refused.\nSUBMISSION_BANNED = (\"你的账号已被禁止投稿：可以继续编辑草稿，但不能提交审核，\"\n                     \"也不能修订已发布的攻略。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\nROLE_LABELS = {\"admin\": \"管理员\", \"editor\": \"编辑\"}\nSTATE_LABELS = {\"active\": \"正常\", \"submission_ban\": \"禁止投稿\",\n                \"deactivated\": \"已停用\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n    last_login_at: str | None = None\n\n    def can(self, capability: str) -> bool:\n        return capability in CAPABILITIES[self.role]\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]),\n                last_login_at=row[\"last_login_at\"])\n\n\ndef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n    except VerifyMismatchError:\n        return False\n\n\ndef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n             int(needs_setup), state),\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n        raise\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef user_with_email(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    if row is None or not password_ok:\n        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n        raise AccountDeactivated\n    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE users SET last_login_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\",\n                 (row[\"id\"],))\n    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n\n\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\nMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n\n\ndef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if password != password_confirm:\n        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n\n\ndef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n    if not session_id:\n        return None\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\n# User management (the Users page). Only users who can manage_users may call\n# these; each refuses anyone else, whatever the route in front of it checked.\n\ndef _check_manages_users(actor: User) -> None:\n    if not actor.can(\"manage_users\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以管理用户。\")\n\n\ndef users(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[User]:\n    \"\"\"Every account, Admins first, then by when it was created.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_users(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY role = 'editor', id\").fetchall()\n    return [_user_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\n_EMAIL = re.compile(r\"[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+\")\n\n\ndef _check_temporary_password(password: str) -> None:\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"临时密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n\n\ndef create_account(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, *, email: str,\n                   role: str, temporary_password: str) -> User:\n    \"\"\"A new account with a temporary password. Its owner chooses their own\n    password and Display name at first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_users(actor)\n    if not _EMAIL.fullmatch(email.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"请填写正确的邮箱地址。\")\n    if role not in CAPABILITIES:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择角色：管理员或编辑。\")\n    _check_temporary_password(temporary_password)\n    return create_user(conn, email=email, password=temporary_password, role=role,\n                       needs_setup=True)\n\n\n# The site must always keep an active Admin. Part of the UPDATE that would\n# remove one, so the check and the change happen at once: two Admins removing\n# each other at the same moment can't both succeed.\n_KEEPS_AN_ADMIN = \"\"\"(users.role != 'admin' OR EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1 FROM users AS other WHERE other.id != users.id\n    AND other.role = 'admin' AND other.state != 'deactivated'))\"\"\"\nLAST_ADMIN = \"至少要保留一位正常状态的管理员，不能停用或降级最后一位管理员。\"\n\n\nclass AccountNotFound(Refused):\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"找不到这个账号。\")\n\n\ndef account(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> User:\n    \"\"\"The account with `user_id`. Raises AccountNotFound if there is none.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_users(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise AccountNotFound\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\n# Each change below repeats its precondition in its UPDATE, so a change\n# another Admin made in between (say, a Deactivation) is never overwritten.\nCHANGED_MEANWHILE = \"这个账号刚被另一位管理员改过，请看看现在的状态再试。\"\n\n\ndef _update(conn: sqlite3.Connection, sql: str, params: tuple[object, ...],\n            refusal: str) -> None:\n    if conn.execute(sql, params).rowcount == 0:\n        raise Refused(refusal)\n\n\ndef change_role(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int, role: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Make the account an Admin or an Editor. It takes effect on the user's\n    next request, since every request reads the role afresh.\"\"\"\n    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n    if role not in CAPABILITIES:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择角色：管理员或编辑。\")\n    if target.id == actor.id and role != target.role:\n        raise Refused(\"不能修改自己的角色，请让另一位管理员来改。\")\n    if role == \"admin\":\n        if target.state == \"submission_ban\":\n            raise Refused(\"这个账号被禁止投稿，请先解除禁止投稿，再改为管理员。\")\n        _update(conn, \"UPDATE users SET role = 'admin' WHERE id = ?\"\n                \" AND state != 'submission_ban'\", (target.id,), CHANGED_MEANWHILE)\n    else:\n        _update(conn, f\"UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ? AND {_KEEPS_AN_ADMIN}\",\n                (role, target.id), LAST_ADMIN)\n\n\ndef ban_submissions(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Submission ban (禁止投稿): the Editor can still log in and work on\n    Drafts, but can't Submit or open a Revision. Their Published Guides stay.\"\"\"\n    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n    if target.role != \"editor\":\n        raise Refused(\"禁止投稿只适用于编辑；管理员发布攻略不需要投稿。\")\n    if target.state != \"active\":\n        raise Refused(\"这个账号已经被禁止投稿了。\" if target.state == \"submission_ban\"\n                      else \"这个账号已停用，请先重新启用。\")\n    _update(conn, \"UPDATE users SET state = 'submission_ban' WHERE id = ?\"\n            \" AND role = 'editor' AND state = 'active'\", (target.id,), CHANGED_MEANWHILE)\n\n\ndef lift_submission_ban(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, user_id: int) -> None:\n    target = account(conn, actor, user_id)\n    if target.state != \"submission_ban\":\n        raise Refused(\"这个账号没有被禁止投稿。\")\n","numLines":1001,"startLine":1,"totalLines":1001}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"45f6aa67-d04c-49b0-a4dc-2719e801199a","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","hash":"a504d4819e823b3d4d463c005b2cbb79f1ad1d7f9f04c4316e97d2b33ab639c7","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01H7kMNm8dwumx3cfyfiRdRd","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Markdown rendering: the one function that turns a writer's Markdown into\nthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview and the Site build both use it, so\nthe preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n\nA Game Term marker, `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]`, names a Game Term by either\nOfficial name and shows as its Official name in the language being rendered,\nin a <span class=\"term\">. A marker that names no Game Term shows its text as\nwritten, without the brackets. The same pass returns warnings for the\npreview: such unknown markers, markers naming several terms with different\nnames, and known nicknames written without a marker. Warnings never block\nanything.\n\nWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\nwith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\nhandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\nsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\nfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom html import escape\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markdown_it.renderer import RendererHTML\nfrom markdown_it.rules_inline import StateInline\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markdown_it.utils import EnvType, OptionsDict\n\nfrom app.game import KINDS, Glossary\n\n_MARKER = re.compile(r\"\\[\\[([^\\[\\]\\n]+)\\]\\]\")\n\n\ndef _shown_name(written: str, env: EnvType) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The Official name the marker `[[written]]` shows in env's language,\n    or None if it names no Game Term. Notes any warning in env.\"\"\"\n    matches = env[\"glossary\"].matching(written)\n    if not matches:\n        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 没有对应的游戏术语，\"\n                               \"网站上会显示为不带括号的原文。\")\n        return None\n    name = getattr(matches[0], f\"name_{env['lang']}\")\n    if len({getattr(term, f\"name_{env['lang']}\") for term in matches}) > 1:\n        listed = \"、\".join(f\"{KINDS[term.kind]} {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}）\"\n                          for term in matches)\n        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 对应多个游戏术语：{listed}。\"\n                               f\"网站上会显示为“{name}”。\")\n    return name\n\n\ndef _game_term(state: StateInline, silent: bool) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Inline rule: `[[name]]` becomes a game_term token holding the name it\n    shows, and whether it names a Game Term (meta[\"known\"]). Silent mode only\n    skips over text, as when a link label is scanned for its closing \"]\"; a\n    token found there would end the link, so the marker is left to be\n    skipped as plain brackets, which balance out.\"\"\"\n    match = None if silent else _MARKER.match(state.src, state.pos)\n    if not match:\n        return False\n    name = _shown_name(match.group(1), state.env)\n    token = state.push(\"game_term\", \"\", 0)\n    token.content = name or match.group(1)\n    token.meta[\"known\"] = name is not None\n    state.pos = match.end()\n    return True\n\n\nclass _Renderer(RendererHTML):\n    def game_term(self, tokens: Sequence[Token], idx: int, options: OptionsDict,\n                  env: EnvType) -> str:\n        token = tokens[idx]\n        if not token.meta[\"known\"]:\n            return escape(token.content)\n        return f'<span class=\"term\">{escape(token.content)}</span>'\n\n    def renderInlineAsText(self, tokens: Sequence[Token] | None,\n                           options: OptionsDict, env: EnvType) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Text for an image's alt, where a marker shows as its name too.\"\"\"\n        return super().renderInlineAsText(\n            [Token(\"text\", \"\", 0, content=token.content)\n             if token.type == \"game_term\" else token for token in tokens or []],\n            options, env)\n\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True},\n                       renderer_cls=_Renderer).enable(\"table\")\n_markdown.inline.ruler.before(\"link\", \"game_term\", _game_term)\n\n\ndef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Rendered:\n    html: str\n    warnings: list[str]\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> Rendered:\n    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out, with Game Term markers showing the\n    Official name in `lang` (\"zh\" or \"en\"), and the preview's warnings.\"\"\"\n    env = {\"lang\": lang, \"glossary\": glossary, \"warnings\": []}\n    html = nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text, env),\n                     attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls,\n                     allowed_classes={\"span\": {\"term\"}})\n    warnings = env[\"warnings\"] + nickname_warnings(_unmarked_text(html), lang, glossary)\n    return Rendered(html, list(dict.fromkeys(warnings)))\n\n\ndef nickname_warnings(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"One warning for each known nickname in `text`, plain text in `lang`,\n    saying how many times it is there.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n            f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n            f\"可以写成 [[{getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}]]。\"\n            for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(text)]\n\n\ndef title_warnings(title: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Warnings for a title in `lang`. A title is plain text, shown as written\n    (markers are not rendered there), so it needs the Official name itself.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"标题里的 [[{written}]] 会原样显示，请直接写官方名称。\"\n            for written in _MARKER.findall(title)] + [\n        f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n        f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n        f\"标题里请直接写 {getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}。\"\n        for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(title)]\n\n\ndef _unmarked_text(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The text Readers see in `html` (the output of render_markdown), less\n    Game Term markers and code, where a nickname may stand as written. Each\n    left-out stretch becomes a line break, so no nickname is found across it.\"\"\"\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    out, code, spans = [], 0, []  # spans: whether each open <span> is a term\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(\"\\n\" if code or any(spans) else piece)\n        elif re.match(r\"<(code|pre)\\b\", piece):\n            code += 1\n        elif piece in (\"</code>\", \"</pre>\"):\n            code -= 1\n        elif piece.startswith(\"<span\"):\n            spans.append('class=\"term\"' in piece)\n        elif piece == \"</span>\" and spans:\n            spans.pop()\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\nclass _Pieces(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Splits sanitized HTML into its tags, copied as they came (so attributes\n    are never touched), and its runs of text, with entities decoded.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.pieces: list[tuple[bool, str]] = []  # (is_text, tag or text)\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, self.get_starttag_text() or \"\"))\n\n    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, f\"</{tag}>\"))\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((True, data))\n\n\n# How strongly a character is highlighted: not at all, as part of a quote\n# from an earlier review round, or from the latest one. The strongest wins.\n_PLAIN, _EARLIER, _LATEST = 0, 1, 2\n_MARKS = {_EARLIER: '<mark class=\"earlier\">', _LATEST: \"<mark>\"}\n\n\ndef _marked(text: str, levels: bytearray) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text`, escaped, with each run of highlighted characters (one level\n    per character) in its <mark>. A run of whitespace only is left unmarked:\n    it may sit between block elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n    out, done = [], 0\n    for level, run in groupby(levels):\n        end = done + len(list(run))\n        piece = escape(text[done:end], quote=False)\n        out.append(f\"{_MARKS[level]}{piece}</mark>\" if level and piece.strip()\n                   else piece)\n        done = end\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str],\n              earlier: Iterable[str] = ()) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` (the latest review round's) and `earlier` (those\n    of rounds before it) where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. Earlier quotes get\n    <mark class=\"earlier\">; where the two overlap, the latest round's mark\n    wins. A quote is matched against the text as Readers see it, ignoring\n    whitespace and formatting, so a passage copied from the preview is found\n    even if it is part bold or runs through a link. Its <mark> is then split\n    at the tags it crosses.\"\"\"\n    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n    # characters of a quote.\n    patterns = [(quote, level,\n                 re.compile(r\"\\s*\".join(map(re.escape, \"\".join(quote.split())))))\n                for quote_list, level in [(earlier, _EARLIER), (quotes, _LATEST)]\n                for quote in quote_list if quote.split()]\n    if not patterns:\n        return html, set()\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    text = \"\".join(piece for is_text, piece in parser.pieces if is_text)\n    levels, found = bytearray(len(text)), set()\n    for quote, level, pattern in patterns:\n        for match in pattern.finditer(text):\n            found.add(quote)\n            for i in range(*match.span()):\n                levels[i] = max(levels[i], level)\n    out, offset = [], 0\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(_marked(piece, levels[offset:offset + len(piece)]))\n            offset += len(piece)\n        else:\n            out.append(piece)\n    return \"\".join(out), found\n\"\"\"The 更新网站 button: the Site build, which is the only step that changes what\nReaders see. Admins only.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app import publish\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, requires\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\nsite_builder = requires(\"build_site\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/site-build\", dependencies=[Depends(site_builder)])\ndef update_site(request: Request):\n    try:\n        publish.build_site()\n    except publish.DeployFailed as failed:\n        flash(request, f\"更新网站失败，读者看到的还是之前的网站。原因：{failed.message}\",\n              \"error\")\n    else:\n        flash(request, \"网站已更新。GitHub Pages 可能需要几分钟才会显示新内容。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n\"\"\"The Trash (回收站): deleted Guides, which only Admins see. They restore a\nGuide from it or delete it for good, through app/guides.py.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import db, guides\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.routes.guides import status_for\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, requires, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ntrash_manager = requires(\"manage_trash\")\n\n\ndef trash_page(request: Request, user: User, *, error: str | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = guides.trashed(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/trash.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"回收站\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/trash\")\ndef trash(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    return trash_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/restore\")\ndef restore(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n            user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.restore(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return trash_page(request, user, error=refused.message,\n                          status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已恢复，攻略原样回到了作者手里。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/trash\")\n\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_for_good(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                            user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.in_trash(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.GuideNotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/confirm_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"彻底删除攻略\", \"user\": user,\n         \"question\": f\"确定要彻底删除《{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}》吗？\",\n         \"consequences\": [\"彻底删除后无法恢复，攻略的正文、审核意见和修订都会一起删除。\"],\n         \"button\": \"彻底删除\", \"action\": f\"admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\",\n         \"cancel\": \"admin/trash\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\")\ndef delete_for_good(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                    user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.delete_for_good(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return trash_page(request, user, error=refused.message,\n                          status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已彻底删除。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/trash\")\n\"\"\"The console dashboard. /admin itself stays the T00 hello page.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app import db, guides, publish\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        counts = guides.counts(conn, user)\n        returned = guides.returned_to(conn, user)\n        queue = guides.review_queue(conn, user)\n        not_on_site = (publish.changes_not_on_site(conn)\n                       if user.can(\"build_site\") else None)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/dashboard.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"控制台\", \"user\": user, \"counts\": counts,\n         \"returned\": returned, \"queue\": queue,\n         \"statuses\": guides.STATUS_LABELS, \"not_on_site\": not_on_site})\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nCreates one Admin and one Editor, a few Heroes, a few Patches (the last\none, 6.7, becomes the Current Patch), demo Game Terms imported from\ndemo_game_terms.csv (which doubles as a sample file for the console's CSV\nimport), and demo Guides in Draft, Submitted and Published, made through the\nGuide workflow just as the console makes them. The passwords come from\nCMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD; there are no default passwords, so\nthe script refuses to run without both. Running it again leaves existing\naccounts, Heroes, Patches and Game Terms alone (even ones an Admin has edited\nsince), and adds no Guides once any exist.\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed. Later tickets add\na Page and Tournament items.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sqlite3\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, game, guides, settings\n\n# Matches DEMO_USERS in tests/conftest.py (which uses its own fixed passwords).\nDEMO_USERS = [\n    # role, email, Display name, environment variable holding the password\n    (\"admin\", \"admin@example.test\", \"演示管理员\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"editor@example.test\", \"演示编辑\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n]\n\n# Official Chinese name, official English name, nicknames.\nDEMO_HEROES = [\n    (\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\", \"瓦姐\"),\n    (\"皮格马利翁\", \"Pygmalien\", \"\"),\n    (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\", \"\"),\n    (\"马克\", \"Mak\", \"\"),\n]\n# Game Terms in the console's CSV import format.\nDEMO_GAME_TERMS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"demo_game_terms.csv\")\n# Oldest first, so the last one added is the Current Patch.\nDEMO_PATCHES = [\"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]\n\n# Author's role, Hero (English name), Patch, status reached, Chinese title,\n# Chinese body, English title, English body.\nDEMO_GUIDES = [\n    (\"editor\", \"Vanessa\", \"6.7\", \"draft\", \"瓦妮莎海盗船流（写作中）\",\n     \"## 思路\\n\\n瓦姐先拿船，再找 [[火药桶]]。终局阵容还在测试。\", \"\", \"\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"Dooley\", \"6.7\", \"submitted\", \"杜利核心流入门\",\n     \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n围绕核心，前期拿**能量**物品。\\n\\n## 运营\\n\\n第 5 天前定型。\",\n     \"Dooley core build for beginners\",\n     \"## Final lineup\\n\\nBuild around the core and take **energy** items early.\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"Pygmalien\", \"6.6\", \"published\", \"皮格马利翁经济流\",\n     \"## 思路\\n\\n前期攒钱，中期一次性升级。\", \"\", \"\"),\n    (\"admin\", \"Mak\", \"6.7\", \"published\", \"马克药水流（6.7）\",\n     \"## 终局阵容\\n\\n[[Mak]] 用药水叠毒，配合治疗。\\n\\n| 天数 | 目标 |\\n|---|---|\\n| 1–4 | 拿药水 |\\n| 5+ | 叠毒 |\",\n     \"Mak potion build (6.7)\",\n     \"## Final lineup\\n\\n[[马克]] stacks poison with potions and heals through the midgame.\"),\n]\n\n\ndef seed_guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    admin = _seed_user(conn, \"admin\")\n    if guides.guides(conn, admin):\n        print(\"guides: some already exist, none added.\")\n        return\n    heroes = {hero.name_en: hero.id for hero in game.heroes(conn)}\n    patches = {patch.name: patch.id for patch in game.patches(conn)}\n    for (role, hero, patch, status, title_zh, body_zh,\n         title_en, body_en) in DEMO_GUIDES:\n        author = _seed_user(conn, role)\n        guide = guides.create(conn, author, guides.GuideFields(\n            title_zh=title_zh, body_zh=body_zh, title_en=title_en,\n            body_en=body_en, hero_id=heroes[hero], patch_id=patches[patch]))\n        if status != \"draft\" and guides.can_submit(author, guide):\n            guides.submit(conn, author, guide.id)\n        if status == \"published\":\n            guides.publish(conn, admin, guide.id)\n        print(f\"guide: created {title_zh} ({guides.STATUS_LABELS[status]}).\")\n\n\ndef _seed_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, role: str) -> accounts.User:\n    email = next(email for r, email, *_ in DEMO_USERS if r == role)\n    user = accounts.user_with_email(conn, email)\n    assert user is not None, f\"{email} should have been created above\"\n    return user\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    missing = [var for *_, var in DEMO_USERS if not os.environ.get(var)]\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {' and '.join(missing)} in .env (copy .env.example), then run \"\n              \"`uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py`.\")\n        return 1\n\n    for *_, var in DEMO_USERS:\n        if os.environ[var].startswith(\"change-me\"):\n            print(f\"Warning: {var} is still the .env.example placeholder. \"\n                  \"Change it in .env before anyone else can reach this console.\")\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, email, display_name, var in DEMO_USERS:\n            try:\n                accounts.create_user(conn, email=email, password=os.environ[var],\n                                     role=role, display_name=display_name)\n            except accounts.Refused:\n                print(f\"{role}: {email} already exists, left unchanged.\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"{role}: created {email} (password from {var}).\")\n        for name_zh, name_en, nicknames in DEMO_HEROES:\n            try:\n                game.add_hero(conn, name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en,\n                              nicknames=nicknames)\n            except game.Refused as refused:\n                print(f\"hero: {name_en} left unchanged ({refused.message})\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"hero: created {name_zh} ({name_en}).\")\n        for name in DEMO_PATCHES:\n            try:\n                game.add_patch(conn, name)\n            except game.Refused as refused:\n                print(f\"patch: {name} left unchanged ({refused.message})\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"patch: created {name}.\")\n        plan = game.import_terms(conn, DEMO_GAME_TERMS.read_bytes(), only_new=True)\n        print(f\"game terms: {len(plan.added)} added, {plan.unchanged} already there,\"\n              f\" {len(plan.rejected)} rejected.\")\n        seed_guides(conn)\n    print(f\"Database: {settings.database_path()}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())","is_error":false}]}}
