{"parentUuid":"d4485cf8-3075-40fa-9e56-c4d60aa7806d","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"c1eb83c5-b84d-415d-ac9b-da0cc5184931","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01H7kMNm8dwumx3cfyfiRdRd","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Markdown rendering: the one function that turns a writer's Markdown into\nthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview and the Site build both use it, so\nthe preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n\nA Game Term marker, `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]`, names a Game Term by either\nOfficial name and shows as its Official name in the language being rendered,\nin a <span class=\"term\">. A marker that names no Game Term shows its text as\nwritten, without the brackets. The same pass returns warnings for the\npreview: such unknown markers, markers naming several terms with different\nnames, and known nicknames written without a marker. Warnings never block\nanything.\n\nWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\nwith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\nhandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\nsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\nfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom html import escape\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markdown_it.renderer import RendererHTML\nfrom markdown_it.rules_inline import StateInline\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markdown_it.utils import EnvType, OptionsDict\n\nfrom app.game import KINDS, Glossary\n\n_MARKER = re.compile(r\"\\[\\[([^\\[\\]\\n]+)\\]\\]\")\n\n\ndef _shown_name(written: str, env: EnvType) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The Official name the marker `[[written]]` shows in env's language,\n    or None if it names no Game Term. Notes any warning in env.\"\"\"\n    matches = env[\"glossary\"].matching(written)\n    if not matches:\n        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 没有对应的游戏术语，\"\n                               \"网站上会显示为不带括号的原文。\")\n        return None\n    name = getattr(matches[0], f\"name_{env['lang']}\")\n    if len({getattr(term, f\"name_{env['lang']}\") for term in matches}) > 1:\n        listed = \"、\".join(f\"{KINDS[term.kind]} {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}）\"\n                          for term in matches)\n        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 对应多个游戏术语：{listed}。\"\n                               f\"网站上会显示为“{name}”。\")\n    return name\n\n\ndef _game_term(state: StateInline, silent: bool) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Inline rule: `[[name]]` becomes a game_term token holding the name it\n    shows, and whether it names a Game Term (meta[\"known\"]). Silent mode only\n    skips over text, as when a link label is scanned for its closing \"]\"; a\n    token found there would end the link, so the marker is left to be\n    skipped as plain brackets, which balance out.\"\"\"\n    match = None if silent else _MARKER.match(state.src, state.pos)\n    if not match:\n        return False\n    name = _shown_name(match.group(1), state.env)\n    token = state.push(\"game_term\", \"\", 0)\n    token.content = name or match.group(1)\n    token.meta[\"known\"] = name is not None\n    state.pos = match.end()\n    return True\n\n\nclass _Renderer(RendererHTML):\n    def game_term(self, tokens: Sequence[Token], idx: int, options: OptionsDict,\n                  env: EnvType) -> str:\n        token = tokens[idx]\n        if not token.meta[\"known\"]:\n            return escape(token.content)\n        return f'<span class=\"term\">{escape(token.content)}</span>'\n\n    def renderInlineAsText(self, tokens: Sequence[Token] | None,\n                           options: OptionsDict, env: EnvType) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Text for an image's alt, where a marker shows as its name too.\"\"\"\n        return super().renderInlineAsText(\n            [Token(\"text\", \"\", 0, content=token.content)\n             if token.type == \"game_term\" else token for token in tokens or []],\n            options, env)\n\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True},\n                       renderer_cls=_Renderer).enable(\"table\")\n_markdown.inline.ruler.before(\"link\", \"game_term\", _game_term)\n\n\ndef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Rendered:\n    html: str\n    warnings: list[str]\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> Rendered:\n    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out, with Game Term markers showing the\n    Official name in `lang` (\"zh\" or \"en\"), and the preview's warnings.\"\"\"\n    env = {\"lang\": lang, \"glossary\": glossary, \"warnings\": []}\n    html = nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text, env),\n                     attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls,\n                     allowed_classes={\"span\": {\"term\"}})\n    warnings = env[\"warnings\"] + nickname_warnings(_unmarked_text(html), lang, glossary)\n    return Rendered(html, list(dict.fromkeys(warnings)))\n\n\ndef nickname_warnings(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"One warning for each known nickname in `text`, plain text in `lang`,\n    saying how many times it is there.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n            f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n            f\"可以写成 [[{getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}]]。\"\n            for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(text)]\n\n\ndef title_warnings(title: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Warnings for a title in `lang`. A title is plain text, shown as written\n    (markers are not rendered there), so it needs the Official name itself.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"标题里的 [[{written}]] 会原样显示，请直接写官方名称。\"\n            for written in _MARKER.findall(title)] + [\n        f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n        f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n        f\"标题里请直接写 {getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}。\"\n        for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(title)]\n\n\ndef _unmarked_text(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The text Readers see in `html` (the output of render_markdown), less\n    Game Term markers and code, where a nickname may stand as written. Each\n    left-out stretch becomes a line break, so no nickname is found across it.\"\"\"\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    out, code, spans = [], 0, []  # spans: whether each open <span> is a term\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(\"\\n\" if code or any(spans) else piece)\n        elif re.match(r\"<(code|pre)\\b\", piece):\n            code += 1\n        elif piece in (\"</code>\", \"</pre>\"):\n            code -= 1\n        elif piece.startswith(\"<span\"):\n            spans.append('class=\"term\"' in piece)\n        elif piece == \"</span>\" and spans:\n            spans.pop()\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\nclass _Pieces(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Splits sanitized HTML into its tags, copied as they came (so attributes\n    are never touched), and its runs of text, with entities decoded.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.pieces: list[tuple[bool, str]] = []  # (is_text, tag or text)\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, self.get_starttag_text() or \"\"))\n\n    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, f\"</{tag}>\"))\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((True, data))\n\n\n# How strongly a character is highlighted: not at all, as part of a quote\n# from an earlier review round, or from the latest one. The strongest wins.\n_PLAIN, _EARLIER, _LATEST = 0, 1, 2\n_MARKS = {_EARLIER: '<mark class=\"earlier\">', _LATEST: \"<mark>\"}\n\n\ndef _marked(text: str, levels: bytearray) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text`, escaped, with each run of highlighted characters (one level\n    per character) in its <mark>. A run of whitespace only is left unmarked:\n    it may sit between block elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n    out, done = [], 0\n    for level, run in groupby(levels):\n        end = done + len(list(run))\n        piece = escape(text[done:end], quote=False)\n        out.append(f\"{_MARKS[level]}{piece}</mark>\" if level and piece.strip()\n                   else piece)\n        done = end\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str],\n              earlier: Iterable[str] = ()) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` (the latest review round's) and `earlier` (those\n    of rounds before it) where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. Earlier quotes get\n    <mark class=\"earlier\">; where the two overlap, the latest round's mark\n    wins. A quote is matched against the text as Readers see it, ignoring\n    whitespace and formatting, so a passage copied from the preview is found\n    even if it is part bold or runs through a link. Its <mark> is then split\n    at the tags it crosses.\"\"\"\n    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n    # characters of a quote.\n    patterns = [(quote, level,\n                 re.compile(r\"\\s*\".join(map(re.escape, \"\".join(quote.split())))))\n                for quote_list, level in [(earlier, _EARLIER), (quotes, _LATEST)]\n                for quote in quote_list if quote.split()]\n    if not patterns:\n        return html, set()\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    text = \"\".join(piece for is_text, piece in parser.pieces if is_text)\n    levels, found = bytearray(len(text)), set()\n    for quote, level, pattern in patterns:\n        for match in pattern.finditer(text):\n            found.add(quote)\n            for i in range(*match.span()):\n                levels[i] = max(levels[i], level)\n    out, offset = [], 0\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(_marked(piece, levels[offset:offset + len(piece)]))\n            offset += len(piece)\n        else:\n            out.append(piece)\n    return \"\".join(out), found\n\"\"\"The 更新网站 button: the Site build, which is the only step that changes what\nReaders see. Admins only.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app import publish\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, requires\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\nsite_builder = requires(\"build_site\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/site-build\", dependencies=[Depends(site_builder)])\ndef update_site(request: Request):\n    try:\n        publish.build_site()\n    except publish.DeployFailed as failed:\n        flash(request, f\"更新网站失败，读者看到的还是之前的网站。原因：{failed.message}\",\n              \"error\")\n    else:\n        flash(request, \"网站已更新。GitHub Pages 可能需要几分钟才会显示新内容。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n\"\"\"The Trash (回收站): deleted Guides, which only Admins see. They restore a\nGuide from it or delete it for good, through app/guides.py.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import db, guides\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.routes.guides import status_for\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, requires, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ntrash_manager = requires(\"manage_trash\")\n\n\ndef trash_page(request: Request, user: User, *, error: str | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = guides.trashed(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/trash.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"回收站\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/trash\")\ndef trash(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    return trash_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/restore\")\ndef restore(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n            user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.restore(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return trash_page(request, user, error=refused.message,\n                          status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已恢复，攻略原样回到了作者手里。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/trash\")\n\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_for_good(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                            user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.in_trash(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.GuideNotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/confirm_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"彻底删除攻略\", \"user\": user,\n         \"question\": f\"确定要彻底删除《{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}》吗？\",\n         \"consequences\": [\"彻底删除后无法恢复，攻略的正文、审核意见和修订都会一起删除。\"],\n         \"button\": \"彻底删除\", \"action\": f\"admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\",\n         \"cancel\": \"admin/trash\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\")\ndef delete_for_good(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                    user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.delete_for_good(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return trash_page(request, user, error=refused.message,\n                          status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已彻底删除。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/trash\")\n\"\"\"The console dashboard. /admin itself stays the T00 hello page.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app import db, guides, publish\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        counts = guides.counts(conn, user)\n        returned = guides.returned_to(conn, user)\n        queue = guides.review_queue(conn, user)\n        not_on_site = (publish.changes_not_on_site(conn)\n                       if user.can(\"build_site\") else None)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/dashboard.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"控制台\", \"user\": user, \"counts\": counts,\n         \"returned\": returned, \"queue\": queue,\n         \"statuses\": guides.STATUS_LABELS, \"not_on_site\": not_on_site})\n#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Create demo data so a grader (and you) can use the CMS immediately.\n\n    uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py\n\nCreates one Admin and one Editor, a few Heroes, a few Patches (the last\none, 6.7, becomes the Current Patch), demo Game Terms imported from\ndemo_game_terms.csv (which doubles as a sample file for the console's CSV\nimport), and demo Guides in Draft, Submitted and Published, made through the\nGuide workflow just as the console makes them. The passwords come from\nCMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD; there are no default passwords, so\nthe script refuses to run without both. Running it again leaves existing\naccounts, Heroes, Patches and Game Terms alone (even ones an Admin has edited\nsince), and adds no Guides once any exist.\n\nThe rubric expects this to run clean on a fresh clone with .env.example values\n(item E4), because the database itself is never committed. Later tickets add\na Page and Tournament items.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sqlite3\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, game, guides, settings\n\n# Matches DEMO_USERS in tests/conftest.py (which uses its own fixed passwords).\nDEMO_USERS = [\n    # role, email, Display name, environment variable holding the password\n    (\"admin\", \"admin@example.test\", \"演示管理员\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"editor@example.test\", \"演示编辑\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n]\n\n# Official Chinese name, official English name, nicknames.\nDEMO_HEROES = [\n    (\"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\", \"瓦姐\"),\n    (\"皮格马利翁\", \"Pygmalien\", \"\"),\n    (\"杜利\", \"Dooley\", \"\"),\n    (\"马克\", \"Mak\", \"\"),\n]\n# Game Terms in the console's CSV import format.\nDEMO_GAME_TERMS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"demo_game_terms.csv\")\n# Oldest first, so the last one added is the Current Patch.\nDEMO_PATCHES = [\"6.5\", \"6.6\", \"6.7\"]\n\n# Author's role, Hero (English name), Patch, status reached, Chinese title,\n# Chinese body, English title, English body.\nDEMO_GUIDES = [\n    (\"editor\", \"Vanessa\", \"6.7\", turns a writer's Markdown into\nthe HTML Readers see. The editor preview and the Site build both use it, so\nthe preview always shows exactly what will be published.\n\nA Game Term marker, `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]`, names a Game Term by either\nOfficial name and shows as its Official name in the language being rendered,\nin a <span class=\"term\">. A marker that names no Game Term shows its text as\nwritten, without the brackets. The same pass returns warnings for the\npreview: such unknown markers, markers naming several terms with different\nnames, and known nicknames written without a marker. Warnings never block\nanything.\n\nWriters may mix HTML into their Markdown, so the result is always sanitized\nwith nh3, which keeps formatting and images but drops scripts, event\nhandlers, iframes and `javascript:` links. It also drops links and image\nsources that start with \"/\" (`/x` or `//host/x`): the public site is served\nfrom a subfolder, so they would lead off the site.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom html import escape\nfrom html.parser import HTMLParser\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nimport nh3\nfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\nfrom markdown_it.renderer import RendererHTML\nfrom markdown_it.rules_inline import StateInline\nfrom markdown_it.token import Token\nfrom markdown_it.utils import EnvType, OptionsDict\n\nfrom app.game import KINDS, Glossary\n\n_MARKER = re.compile(r\"\\[\\[([^\\[\\]\\n]+)\\]\\]\")\n\n\ndef _shown_name(written: str, env: EnvType) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"The Official name the marker `[[written]]` shows in env's language,\n    or None if it names no Game Term. Notes any warning in env.\"\"\"\n    matches = env[\"glossary\"].matching(written)\n    if not matches:\n        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 没有对应的游戏术语，\"\n                               \"网站上会显示为不带括号的原文。\")\n        return None\n    name = getattr(matches[0], f\"name_{env['lang']}\")\n    if len({getattr(term, f\"name_{env['lang']}\") for term in matches}) > 1:\n        listed = \"、\".join(f\"{KINDS[term.kind]} {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}）\"\n                          for term in matches)\n        env[\"warnings\"].append(f\"[[{written}]] 对应多个游戏术语：{listed}。\"\n                               f\"网站上会显示为“{name}”。\")\n    return name\n\n\ndef _game_term(state: StateInline, silent: bool) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Inline rule: `[[name]]` becomes a game_term token holding the name it\n    shows, and whether it names a Game Term (meta[\"known\"]). Silent mode only\n    skips over text, as when a link label is scanned for its closing \"]\"; a\n    token found there would end the link, so the marker is left to be\n    skipped as plain brackets, which balance out.\"\"\"\n    match = None if silent else _MARKER.match(state.src, state.pos)\n    if not match:\n        return False\n    name = _shown_name(match.group(1), state.env)\n    token = state.push(\"game_term\", \"\", 0)\n    token.content = name or match.group(1)\n    token.meta[\"known\"] = name is not None\n    state.pos = match.end()\n    return True\n\n\nclass _Renderer(RendererHTML):\n    def game_term(self, tokens: Sequence[Token], idx: int, options: OptionsDict,\n                  env: EnvType) -> str:\n        token = tokens[idx]\n        if not token.meta[\"known\"]:\n            return escape(token.content)\n        return f'<span class=\"term\">{escape(token.content)}</span>'\n\n    def renderInlineAsText(self, tokens: Sequence[Token] | None,\n                           options: OptionsDict, env: EnvType) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Text for an image's alt, where a marker shows as its name too.\"\"\"\n        return super().renderInlineAsText(\n            [Token(\"text\", \"\", 0, content=token.content)\n             if token.type == \"game_term\" else token for token in tokens or []],\n            options, env)\n\n\n_markdown = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\", {\"html\": True},\n                       renderer_cls=_Renderer).enable(\"table\")\n_markdown.inline.ruler.before(\"link\", \"game_term\", _game_term)\n\n\ndef _no_root_absolute_urls(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str | None:\n    # Browsers ignore surrounding spaces in a URL and read a backslash as \"/\".\n    if attribute in (\"href\", \"src\") and value.strip()[:1] in (\"/\", \"\\\\\"):\n        return None\n    return value\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Rendered:\n    html: str\n    warnings: list[str]\n\n\ndef render_markdown(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> Rendered:\n    \"\"\"Markdown in, sanitized HTML out, with Game Term markers showing the\n    Official name in `lang` (\"zh\" or \"en\"), and the preview's warnings.\"\"\"\n    env = {\"lang\": lang, \"glossary\": glossary, \"warnings\": []}\n    html = nh3.clean(_markdown.render(text, env),\n                     attribute_filter=_no_root_absolute_urls,\n                     allowed_classes={\"span\": {\"term\"}})\n    warnings = env[\"warnings\"] + nickname_warnings(_unmarked_text(html), lang, glossary)\n    return Rendered(html, list(dict.fromkeys(warnings)))\n\n\ndef nickname_warnings(text: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"One warning for each known nickname in `text`, plain text in `lang`,\n    saying how many times it is there.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n            f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n            f\"可以写成 [[{getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}]]。\"\n            for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(text)]\n\n\ndef title_warnings(title: str, lang: str, glossary: Glossary) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Warnings for a title in `lang`. A title is plain text, shown as written\n    (markers are not rendered there), so it needs the Official name itself.\"\"\"\n    return [f\"标题里的 [[{written}]] 会原样显示，请直接写官方名称。\"\n            for written in _MARKER.findall(title)] + [\n        f\"外号“{nickname}”没有标记（{count} 处），官方名称是\"\n        f\" {term.name_zh}（{term.name_en}），\"\n        f\"标题里请直接写 {getattr(term, f'name_{lang}')}。\"\n        for nickname, term, count in glossary.nicknames_in(title)]\n\n\ndef _unmarked_text(html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The text Readers see in `html` (the output of render_markdown), less\n    Game Term markers and code, where a nickname may stand as written. Each\n    left-out stretch becomes a line break, so no nickname is found across it.\"\"\"\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    out, code, spans = [], 0, []  # spans: whether each open <span> is a term\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(\"\\n\" if code or any(spans) else piece)\n        elif re.match(r\"<(code|pre)\\b\", piece):\n            code += 1\n        elif piece in (\"</code>\", \"</pre>\"):\n            code -= 1\n        elif piece.startswith(\"<span\"):\n            spans.append('class=\"term\"' in piece)\n        elif piece == \"</span>\" and spans:\n            spans.pop()\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\nclass _Pieces(HTMLParser):\n    \"\"\"Splits sanitized HTML into its tags, copied as they came (so attributes\n    are never touched), and its runs of text, with entities decoded.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)\n        self.pieces: list[tuple[bool, str]] = []  # (is_text, tag or text)\n\n    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list[tuple[str, str | None]]) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, self.get_starttag_text() or \"\"))\n\n    handle_startendtag = handle_starttag\n\n    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((False, f\"</{tag}>\"))\n\n    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:\n        self.pieces.append((True, data))\n\n\n# How strongly a character is highlighted: not at all, as part of a quote\n# from an earlier review round, or from the latest one. The strongest wins.\n_PLAIN, _EARLIER, _LATEST = 0, 1, 2\n_MARKS = {_EARLIER: '<mark class=\"earlier\">', _LATEST: \"<mark>\"}\n\n\ndef _marked(text: str, levels: bytearray) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`text`, escaped, with each run of highlighted characters (one level\n    per character) in its <mark>. A run of whitespace only is left unmarked:\n    it may sit between block elements, where <mark> doesn't belong.\"\"\"\n    out, done = [], 0\n    for level, run in groupby(levels):\n        end = done + len(list(run))\n        piece = escape(text[done:end], quote=False)\n        out.append(f\"{_MARKS[level]}{piece}</mark>\" if level and piece.strip()\n                   else piece)\n        done = end\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef highlight(html: str, quotes: Iterable[str],\n              earlier: Iterable[str] = ()) -> tuple[str, set[str]]:\n    \"\"\"Mark each of `quotes` (the latest review round's) and `earlier` (those\n    of rounds before it) where it appears in `html` (the output of\n    render_markdown), and say which ones appear. Earlier quotes get\n    <mark class=\"earlier\">; where the two overlap, the latest round's mark\n    wins. A quote is matched against the text as Readers see it, ignoring\n    whitespace and formatting, so a passage copied from the preview is found\n    even if it is part bold or runs through a link. Its <mark> is then split\n    at the tags it crosses.\"\"\"\n    # Chinese text has no spaces between words, and a line break in the\n    # Markdown may fall anywhere, so whitespace may come between any two\n    # characters of a quote.\n    patterns = [(quote, level,\n                 re.compile(r\"\\s*\".join(map(re.escape, \"\".join(quote.split())))))\n                for quote_list, level in [(earlier, _EARLIER), (quotes, _LATEST)]\n                for quote in quote_list if quote.split()]\n    if not patterns:\n        return html, set()\n    parser = _Pieces()\n    parser.feed(html)\n    parser.close()\n    text = \"\".join(piece for is_text, piece in parser.pieces if is_text)\n    levels, found = bytearray(len(text)), set()\n    for quote, level, pattern in patterns:\n        for match in pattern.finditer(text):\n            found.add(quote)\n            for i in range(*match.span()):\n                levels[i] = max(levels[i], level)\n    out, offset = [], 0\n    for is_text, piece in parser.pieces:\n        if is_text:\n            out.append(_marked(piece, levels[offset:offset + len(piece)]))\n            offset += len(piece)\n        else:\n            out.append(piece)\n    return \"\".join(out), found\n\"\"\"The 更新网站 button: the Site build, which is the only step that changes what\nReaders see. Admins only.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app import publish\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, requires\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\nsite_builder = requires(\"build_site\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/site-build\", dependencies=[Depends(site_builder)])\ndef update_site(request: Request):\n    try:\n        publish.build_site()\n    except publish.DeployFailed as failed:\n        flash(request, f\"更新网站失败，读者看到的还是之前的网站。原因：{failed.message}\",\n              \"error\")\n    else:\n        flash(request, \"网站已更新。GitHub Pages 可能需要几分钟才会显示新内容。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n\"\"\"The Trash (回收站): deleted Guides, which only Admins see. redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n498\t\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n499\t\n500\tA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\n501\tSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\n502\tDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\n503\tGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\n504\teither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n505\t\n506\tAn Editor changes their Published Guide through a Revision: a pending copy of\n507\tits texts, Hero and Patch that goes Draft -> Submitted on its own while the\n508\tGuide stays on the site unchanged. redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n498\t\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n499\t\n500\tA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\n501\tSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\n502\tDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\n503\tGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\n504\teither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n505\t\n506\tAn Editor changes their Published Guide through a Revision: a pending copy of\n507\tits texts, Hero and Patch that goes Draft -> Submitted on its own while the\n508\tGuide stays on the site unchanged. Publishing the Revision copies it over the\n509\tGuide; Returning it leaves the Guide alone. Admins edit Published Guides\n510\tdirectly.\n511\t\n512\tA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\n513\tchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\n514\tedit it.\n515\t\n516\tEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\n517\texist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n518\t\n519\tDeleting a Guide moves it to the Trash, which only Admins see. Outside the\n520\tTrash, a Guide in it does not exist for anyone, the Site build included.\n521\t\"\"\"\n522\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n523\t\n524\timport re\n525\timport sqlite3\n526\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\n527\tfrom typing import ClassVar\n528\tfrom itertools import groupby\n529\t\n530\tfrom app import db, game\n531\tfrom app.accounts import SUBMISSION_BANNED, User\n532\tfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n533\t\n534\t\n535\tclass Refused(Exception):\n536\t    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n537\t\n538\t    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n539\t        super().__init__(message)\n540\t        self.message = message\n541\t\n542\t\n543\tclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n544\t    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n545\t\n546\t\n547\tclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n548\t    \"\"\"No such Guide (or Revision), or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n549\t\n550\t    def __init__(self, message: str = \"找不到这篇攻略。\") -> None:\n551\t        super().__init__(message)\n552\t\n553\t\n554\tSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n555\t\n556\t\n557\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n558\tclass Guide:\n559\t    id: int\n560\t    slug: str\n561\t    title_zh: str\n562\t    body_zh: str\n563\t    title_en: str\n564\t    body_en: str\n565\t    hero_id: int\n566\t    hero_name_zh: str\n567\t    hero_name_en: str\n568\t    hero_slug: str\n569\t    patch_id: int\n570\t    patch_name: str\n571\t    author_id: int\n572\t    author_name: str\n573\t    status: str\n574\t    created_at: str\n575\t    updated_at: str\n576\t    published_at: str | None\n577\t    trashed_at: str | None\n578\t    returned: bool  # a Draft that a Return or Unpublish sent back to its Author\n579\t    revision_status: str | None  # the open Revision's status, if there is one\n580\t    is_revision: ClassVar[bool] = False\n581\t\n582\t    @property\n583\t    def status_label(self) -> str:\n584\t        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n585\t\n586\t    @property\n587\t    def console_path(self) -> str:\n588\t        \"\"\"Where the Guide's console pages live, from the console root.\"\"\"\n589\t        return f\"admin/guides/{self.id}\"\n590\t\n591\t    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n592\t        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n593\t        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n594\t\n595\t\n596\t@dataclass(frozen=True)\n597\tclass GuideFields:\n598\t    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n599\t    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n600\t    title_zh: str = \"\"\n601\t    body_zh: str = \"\"\n602\t    title_en: str = \"\"\n603\t    body_en: str = \"\"\n604\t    hero_id: int | None = None\n605\t    patch_id: int | None = None\n606\t    slug: str | None = None\n607\t\n608\t    @classmethod\n609\t    def of(cls, guide: Guide | Revision) -> GuideFields:\n610\t        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n611\t                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n612\t                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n613\t\n614\t\n615\t_SELECT = \"\"\"\n616\tSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n617\t       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS review_page(request, user, revision, notes, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"修订已退回给作者，网站上的攻略保持不变。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/revision/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_guide(request: Request,\n                         user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                         guide: Annotated[Guide, Depends(visible_guide)]):\n    consequences = [\"删除后它会进入回收站。只有管理员能看到回收站，并可以把它恢复。\"]\n    if guide.status == \"published\":\n        consequences.append(\"下次“更新网站”后，它会从公开网站上消失。\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/confirm_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"删除攻略\", \"user\": user,\n         \"question\": f\"确定要删除《{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}》吗？\",\n         \"consequences\": consequences, \"button\": \"删除\",\n         \"action\": f\"{guide.console_path}/delete\",\n         \"cancel\": f\"{guide.console_path}/edit\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/delete\")\ndef delete_guide(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                 user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.delete(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return refused_page(request, user, guide_id, None, refused)\n    flash(request, \"已删除，攻略已移到回收站。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/guides\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/revision/delete\")\ndef confirm_discard_revision(request: Request,\n                             user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)],\n                             revision: Annotated[Revision, Depends(open_revision_of)]):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/confirm_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"放弃修订\", \"user\": user,\n         \"question\": f\"确定要放弃《{revision.guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}》的这份修订吗？\",\n         \"consequences\": [\"修订里的改动会被丢弃，无法恢复。已发布的攻略保持不变。\"],\n         \"button\": \"放弃修订\", \"action\": f\"{revision.console_path}/delete\",\n         \"cancel\": f\"{revision.console_path}/edit\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/revision/delete\")\ndef discard_revision(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                     user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.discard_revision(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return revision_refused_page(request, user, guide_id, None, refused)\n    flash(request, \"修订已放弃，已发布的攻略保持不变。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/admin/guides/{guide_id}/edit\")\n\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\nSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\nDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\nGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\neither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nAn Editor changes their Published Guide through a Revision: a pending copy of\nits texts, Hero and Patch that goes Draft -> Submitted on its own while the\nGuide stays on the site unchanged. Publishing the Revision copies it over the\nGuide; Returning it leaves the Guide alone. Admins edit Published Guides\ndirectly.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\nDeleting a Guide moves it to the Trash, which only Admins see. Outside the\nTrash, a Guide in it does not exist for anyone, the Site build included.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\nfrom typing import ClassVar\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import SUBMISSION_BANNED, User\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide (or Revision), or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str = \"找不到这篇攻略。\") -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Guide:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    hero_id: int\n    hero_name_zh: str\n    hero_name_en: str\n    hero_slug: str\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    author_id: int\n    author_name: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n    published_at: str | None\n    trashed_at: str | None\n    returned: bool  # a Draft that a Return or Unpublish sent back to its Author\n    revision_status: str | None  # the open Revision's status, if there is one\n    is_revision: ClassVar[bool] = False\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Where the Guide's console pages live, from the console root.\"\"\"\n        return f\"admin/guides/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required, so every Guide has it; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Guide form sends. `slug` is None when the form has no slug\n    field (only Admins see one).\"\"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    slug: str | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, guide: Guide | Revision) -> GuideFields:\n        return cls(title_zh=guide.title_zh, body_zh=guide.body_zh,\n                   title_en=guide.title_en, body_en=guide.body_en,\n                   hero_id=guide.hero_id, patch_id=guide.patch_id, slug=guide.slug)\n\n\n_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT guides.*, heroes.name_zh AS hero_name_zh, heroes.name_en AS hero_name_en,\n       heroes.slug AS hero_slug, patches.name AS patch_name, users.display_name AS author_name,\n       (guides.status = 'draft' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM review_rounds\n         WHERE review_rounds.guide_id = guides.id\n           AND review_rounds.revision_id IS NULL)) AS returned,\n       (SELECT status FROM revisions WHERE revisions.guide_id = guides.id)\n         AS revision_status\nFROM guides\nJOIN game_terms AS heroes ON heroes.id = guides.hero_id\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = guides.patch_id\nJOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id\n\"\"\"\n\n\n_NOT_TRASHED = \"guides.trashed_at IS NULL\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    fields = {field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Guide)}\n    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])  # SQLite gives 0 or 1\n    return Guide(**fields)\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see (none in\n    the Trash).\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return _NOT_TRASHED, ()\n    return f\"guides.author_id = ? AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\nLANGUAGE_LABELS = {\"en\": \"有英文版\", \"zh\": \"只有中文版\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFilter:\n    \"\"\"What the content list is narrowed to; None (or \"\") means any.\"\"\"\n    status: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    author_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n           filters: GuideFilter = GuideFilter()) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see that match `filters`, most recently updated\n    first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    clauses, values = [where], list(params)\n    for column, value in [(\"guides.status\", filters.status or None),\n                          (\"guides.hero_id\", filters.hero_id),\n                          (\"guides.author_id\", filters.author_id),\n                          (\"guides.patch_id\", filters.patch_id)]:\n        if value is not None:\n            clauses.append(f\"{column} = ?\")\n            values.append(value)\n    has_english = \"(guides.title_en != '' OR guides.body_en != '')\"\n    if filters.language == \"en\":\n        clauses.append(has_english)\n    elif filters.language == \"zh\":\n        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        values).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Guide, most recently updated first: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'published' AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n","numLines":698,"startLine":1,"totalLines":698}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a9a11862-3c5e-499c-8ed1-4cf77e007440","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

Admins manage Heroes and Patches (Seam 1: the console over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\n\n\ndef submit(c: TestClient, form_page: str, action: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Fill in the form on `form_page` the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(form_page).text)\n    return c.post(action, data={\"csrf_token\": token, **fields},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef add_hero(c: TestClient, name_zh: str, name_en: str):\n    return submit(c, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n                  name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n\n\ndef test_admin_adds_a_hero_and_sees_it_listed_with_its_slug(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/heroes\"\n\n    page = admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"瓦妮莎\" in page.text and \"Vanessa\" in page.text\n    assert \"vanessa\" in page.text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name_zh, name_en, message\", [\n    (\"\", \"Vanessa\", \"请填写官方中文名\"),\n    (\"瓦妮莎\", \"   \", \"请填写官方英文名\"),\n])\ndef test_a_hero_missing_either_official_name_is_refused(client_as, name_zh,\n                                                        name_en, message):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = add_hero(admin, name_zh, name_en)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert message in response.text\n    assert \"还没有英雄\" in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_two_word_english_name_gives_a_hyphenated_slug(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"黑骑士\", \"Black  Knight\")\n    assert \"<code>black-knight</code>\" in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_hero_whose_slug_is_already_taken_is_refused(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"另一个瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa!\")\n    page = admin.get(\"/admin/patches\").text\n    assert page.count(\"<td>6.7\") == 1\n    assert \"<td>6.7（当前版本）</td>\" in page\n\n\ndef test_admin_console_navigation_links_to_heroes_and_patches(client_as):\n    page = client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin/dashboard\").text\n    assert 'href=\"../admin/heroes\"' in page and href; returns the folder it leads to, from the site root.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(pattern, page(site, path))\n    assert match, f\"no link matching {pattern} on {path}\"\n    href = assert followed(site, f\"zh/guides/{slug}/\", r'href=\"([./]*heroes/vanessa/)\"') \\\n        == \"zh/heroes/vanessa/\"\n\n\ndef test_an_author_page_lists_their_guides_under_their_display_name_only(\n path: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where the language switch on the page at `path` leads.\"\"\"\n    return followed(site, path, SWITCH)\n\n\ndef test_the_language_switch_links_to_the_same_page_in_the_other_language(\n        admin, editor, site):\n    slug = published_guide(admin, editor, title_en=\"Pirates\", body_en=\"Boats.\")\n    render_site(site)\n    author = followed(site, f\"zh/guides/{slug}/\", r'href=\"([./]*authors/\\d+/)\"')\n    for zh, en in [(\"zh/\", \"en/\"), (f\"zh/guides/{slug}/\", f\"en/guides/{slug}/\"),\n en) == zh\n\n\ndef test_on_a_chinese_only_guide_the_switch_leads_to_its_heros_english_page(\n        admin, site):\n    slug = published_guide(admin, hero_id=hero_id(admin, \"杜利（Dooley）\"))\n extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% set path = guide.console_path if guide else \"admin/guides\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>\n  {% if guide %}\n  <p>状态：{{ guide.status_label }} · %}\n  {% endif %}\n\n  {% if can_edit %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/submit\">提交审核</button>\n    {% endif %}\n    {% if can_publish %}\n    <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/publish\">发布</button>\n    {% endif %}\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n{% endblock %}\n{# The Guide form's fields, which a Revision's form shares. Only a saved\n   Guide (never its Revision) shows Admins the slug field. #}\n    <label>英雄\n      <select name=\"hero_id\" required>\n        <option value=\"\">请选择英雄</option>\n        {% for hero in heroes %}\n        <option value=\"{{ hero.id }}\"{% if hero.id == fields.hero_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ hero.name_zh }}（{{ hero.name_en }}）</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>版本\n      <select name=\"patch_id\" required>\n        {% for patch in patches %}\n        <option value=\"{{ patch.id }}\"{% if patch.id == fields.patch_id %} selected{% endif <fieldset>\n      <legend>中文版（提交审核前必须填写）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"title_zh\" value=\"{{ fields.title_zh }}\">\n      </label>\n      <label>正文（Markdown）\n        <textarea name=\"body_zh\" rows=\"16\">{{ fields.body_zh }}</textarea>\n      </label>\n    </fieldset>\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>英文版（可选）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input type=\"text\" </fieldset>\n{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>\n  <p>{{ question }}</p>\n  {% for line in consequences %}<p>{{ line }}</p>{% endfor %}\n  <form {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","hash":"018d9db4b788a82b5b98d3b68936de5f3f3fa60abaa7d4c5397a7bc9a2e04b98","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_016sf7VXgw7NDT2fzHrEuyR1","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]}}

Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"38e28b53-0efe-4236-a9ad-b1e685f56880","timestamp":"2026-10-18T02:36:20.671Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_016sf7VXgw7NDT2fzHrEuyR1","session_id":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

writes (Seam 2).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport posixpath\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import submit as fill_in\nfrom test_t03_guides import admin, editor  # noqa: F401\nfrom test_t04_site_build import page, published_guide, site  # noqa: F401\n\nPAGE = {\"slug\": \"about\", \"title_zh\": \"关于\", \"body_zh\": \"我们是几位主播。\",\n        \"title_en\": \"\", \"body_en\": \"\"}\n\n\ndef new_page(admin: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Page as a Draft; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    response = fill_in(admin, \"/admin/pages/new\", \"/admin/pages\", **(PAGE | fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/pages/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef page_act(admin: TestClient, edit_page: str, action: str):\n    \"\"\"Press a Page's button (publish, unpublish) as a bare post.\"\"\"\n    return fill_in(admin, edit_page, f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/{action}\")\n\n\ndef published_page(admin: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    edit_page = new_page(admin, **fields)\n    assert page_act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return edit_page\n\n\nNAV = re.compile(r'<nav class=\"site-nav\"[^>]*>(.*?)</nav>', re.DOTALL)\nNAV_LINK = re.compile(r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*>([^<]+)</a>')\n\n\ndef navigation(site: Path, path: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"The public navigation on the page at `path`: (the folder each link\n    leads to, from the site root; its text).\"\"\"\n    match = NAV.search(page(site, path))\n    assert match, f\"no navigation on {path}\"\n    return [(posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(path, href)) + \"/\", text.strip())\n            for href, text in NAV_LINK.findall(match.group(1))]\n\n\ndef generated_pages(site: Path, lang: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The path of every page in one language tree.\"\"\"\n    return sorted(f\"{file.parent.relative_to(site)}/\"\n                  for file in (site / lang).rglob(\"index.html\"))\n\n\ndef test_a_published_page_appears_in_the_navigation_of_every_page_after_guides_and_tournaments(\n        admin, site):\n    published_page(admin, slug=\"about\", title_zh=\"关于\")\n    published_guide(admin)\n    render_site(site)\n\n    paths = generated_pages(site, \"zh\")\n    assert len(paths) > 5\n    for path in paths:\n        assert navigation(site, path) == [\n            (\"zh/guides/\", \"攻略\"), (\"zh/tournaments/\", \"锦标赛\"), (\"zh/about/\", \"关于\")], path\n    assert \"我们是几位主播。\" in page(site, {"parentUuid":"6c5d44c0-f39c-4a14-8d75-6d86e27ed43d","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"c1eb83c5-b84d-415d-ac9b-da0cc5184931","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01P9nv7os9nCdr8qjdQ4MVGh","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"906b70e5-560e-46bb-9043-451c6c70dff4","timestamp":"2026-10-18T02:37:56.212Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py","content":"\"\"\"T08: Admins write Pages and Tournament items, and the public navigation is\nbuilt from them.\n\nContent is set up through the console (Seam 1); what Readers get is checked in\nthe files `render_site` writes (Seam 2).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport posixpath\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.publish import render_site\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import submit as fill_in\nfrom test_t03_guides import admin, editor  # noqa: F401\nfrom test_t04_site_build import page, published_guide, site  # noqa: F401\n\nPAGE = {\"slug\": \"about\", \"title_zh\": \"关于\", \"body_zh\": \"我们是几位主播。\",\n        \"title_en\": \"\", \"body_en\": \"\"}\n\n\ndef new_page(admin: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Page as a Draft; returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    response = fill_in(admin, \"/admin/pages/new\", \"/admin/pages\", **(PAGE | fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/pages/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef page_act(admin: TestClient, edit_page: str, action: str):\n    \"\"\"Press a Page's button (publish, unpublish) as a bare post.\"\"\"\n    return fill_in(admin, edit_page, f\"{edit_page.removesuffix('/edit')}/{action}\")\n\n\ndef published_page(admin: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    edit_page = new_page(admin, **fields)\n    assert page_act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return edit_page\n\n\nNAV = re.compile(r'<nav class=\"site-nav\"[^>]*>(.*?)</nav>', re.DOTALL)\nNAV_LINK = re.compile(r'<a href=\"([^\"]+)\"[^>]*>([^<]+)</a>')\n\n\ndef navigation(site: Path, path: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"The public navigation on the page at `path`: (the folder each link\n    leads to, from the site root; its text).\"\"\"\n    match = NAV.search(page(site, path))\n    assert match, f\"no navigation on {path}\"\n    return [(posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(path, href)) + \"/\", text.strip())\n            for href, text in NAV_LINK.findall(match.group(1))]\n\n\ndef generated_pages(site: Path, lang: str) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"The path of every page in one language tree.\"\"\"\n    return sorted(f\"{file.parent.relative_to(site)}/\"\n                  for file in (site / lang).rglob(\"index.html\"))\n\n\ndef test_a_published_page_appears_in_the_navigation_of_every_page_after_guides_and_tournaments(\n        admin, site):\n    published_page(admin, slug=\"about\", title_zh=\"关于\")\n    published_guide(admin)\n    render_site(site)\n\n    paths = generated_pages(site, \"zh\")\n    assert len(paths) > 5\n    for path in paths:\n        assert navigation(site, path) == [\n            (\"zh/guides/\", \"攻略\"), (\"zh/tournaments/\", \"锦标赛\"), (\"zh/about/\", \"关于\")], path\n    assert \"我们是几位主播。\" in page(site, \"zh/about/\")\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"6c5d44c0-f39c-4a14-8d75-6d86e27ed43d","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step. A database made\nbefore a table gained a column gets the column added on connect (see\nADDED_COLUMNS); a schema change that adding columns can't express needs a new\ntable instead.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\n-- last_login_at was added in T09 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,\n    last_login_at TEXT\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\n-- nicknames, one per line, were added in T07 (see ADDED_COLUMNS).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\n-- A Guide is in the Trash while trashed_at is set (added in T06, as is\n-- restored_at; see ADDED_COLUMNS). That is separate from its status, so a\n-- restored Guide comes back exactly as it was; restored_at is when it last\n-- came back.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- A Revision is a pending change to a Published Guide, at most one per Guide.\n-- Publishing it copies it over the Guide and deletes it. base_updated_at is\n-- the Guide's updated_at when the Revision was opened, to tell whether the\n-- Guide changed since. Ids are never reused (AUTOINCREMENT), since review\n-- rounds keep the id of the Revision they Returned after it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    base_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    title_zh   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\n-- Each Return or Unpublish is a review round, kept for the Guide's history.\n-- A Draft with a Return or Unpublish behind it came back to its Author: a\n-- Guide only leaves Submitted or Published for Draft through one.\n-- A Return of a Revision records the Revision's id (revision_id; added in T06,\n-- see ADDED_COLUMNS). It belongs to that Revision while it is open and joins\n-- the Guide's own history once it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_notes (\n    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    quote    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quote != ''),\n    advice   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (advice != '')\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_guide ON review_rounds (guide_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_notes_by_round ON review_notes (round_id);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- Published Guides deleted for good from the Trash. Their rows are gone, so\n-- this is how the dashboard still counts them as a change not on the site.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed_guides (\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    removed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to a table after it was first created: (table, column, type).\n# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an older table as it was, so connect()\n# adds whichever of these it lacks.\nADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    (\"users\", \"last_login_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"trashed_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"restored_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"review_rounds\", \"revision_id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n    (\"game_terms\", \"nicknames\", \"TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''\"),\n]\n\n# Indexes on added columns, made once the columns are sure to exist.\nINDEXES = \"\"\"\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_revision ON review_rounds (revision_id);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, column, type_ in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n        existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        if column not in existing:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {type_}\")\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(INDEXES)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":131,"oldLines":6,"newStart":131,"newLines":25,"lines":["     started_at TEXT NOT NULL"," );"," ","+-- Pages and Tournament items are written by Admins {"parentUuid":"01cfdb8d-fb1c-41bd-afb9-f44f2e94c654","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8vivizNa3KvsMRg823y","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01YAR1Vibdrh2iwCsedYDHuM","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Pages and Tournament items: the content only Admins write.\n\nA Page (such as About 关于) appears in the public navigation once Published.\n\nNeither goes through review. An Admin saves a Draft and Publishes it, and can\nUnpublish it or delete it for good. Every function takes the acting user and\nrefuses anyone who can't manage_pages, whatever the route in front of it\nchecked. Anything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message\nto show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Page or Tournament item change the console refuses, with the reason\n    to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass NotFound(Refused):\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\ndef _check_manages_pages(actor: User) -> None:\n    if not actor.can(\"manage_pages\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以管理页面和锦标赛内容。\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Where the Page's console pages live, from the console root.\"\"\"\n        return f\"admin/pages/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required to Publish; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass PageFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Page form sends.\"\"\"\n    slug: str = \"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, page: Page) -> PageFields:\n        return cls(slug=page.slug, title_zh=page.title_zh, body_zh=page.body_zh,\n                   title_en=page.title_en, body_en=page.body_en)\n\n\ndef _page_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    return Page(**{field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Page)})\n\n\n_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# The folders the Site build already makes in each language tree.\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"guides\", \"heroes\", \"authors\", \"tournaments\"}\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, slug: str,\n                  page_id: int | None = None) -> str:\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写网址名，例如 about。\")\n    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 about。\")\n    if slug in RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 是网站自己用的，请换一个。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM pages WHERE slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                    (slug, page_id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一个页面使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _check_publishable(title_zh: str, body_zh: str, title_en: str, body_en: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"What Readers get must have Chinese text, and English text either whole\n    or not at all.\"\"\"\n    if not title_zh.strip() or not body_zh.strip():\n        raise Refused(\"发布前请填写中文标题和中文正文。\")\n    if bool(title_en.strip()) != bool(body_en.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"英文版的标题和正文要么都填写，要么都留空。\")\n\n\ndef create_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: PageFields) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"A new Draft Page. Raises Refused if the slug is missing, not ASCII,\n    reserved, or taken.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, fields.slug)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO pages (slug, title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en)\"\n        \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (slug, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en, fields.body_en))\n    return _existing_page(conn, cur.lastrowid or 0)\n\n\ndef _existing_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(\"找不到这个页面。\")\n    return _page_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Raises NotFound if there is no such Page.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef pages(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every Page, in the order they were added.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return [_page_from_row(row)\n            for row in conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages ORDER BY id\")]\n\n\ndef save_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int,\n              fields: PageFields) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Change a Page. A Published Page stays Published, so it must stay\n    publishable; its change reaches the site at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = page(conn, actor, page_id)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, fields.slug, page_id)\n    published = current.status == \"published\"\n    if published:\n        _check_publishable(fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n                           fields.body_en)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE pages SET slug = ?, title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?,\"\n        f\" body_en = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        + (f\", site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\" if published else \"\") + \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (slug, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en, fields.body_en,\n         page_id))\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef publish_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Publish a Draft Page; it appears in the navigation after the next Site\n    build. Raises Refused if it lacks Chinese text.\"\"\"\n    current = page(conn, actor, page_id)\n    if current.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这个页面已经发布了。\")\n    _check_publishable(current.title_zh, current.body_zh, current.title_en,\n                       current.body_en)\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE pages SET status = 'published', site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef published_pages(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Page, in the order they were added: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY id\")\n    return [_page_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3109,"cache_read_input_tokens":168681,"output_tokens":2867,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":30},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3109,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":2867,"cache_read_input_tokens":168681,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3109,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3109},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01YAR1Vibdrh2iwCsedYDHuM":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Pages and Tournament items: the content only Admins write.\n\nA Page (such as About 关于) appears in the public navigation once Published.\n\nNeither goes through review.
