{"parentUuid":"84c7639b-a7b9-410b-9d18-a756bd118529","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"c1eb83c5-b84d-415d-ac9b-da0cc5184931","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01YAR1Vibdrh2iwCsedYDHuM","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/content.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"0f93c1c9-5cee-43f8-bf50-de31ad10266b","timestamp":"2026-10-18T02:38:55.979Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/content.py","content":"\"\"\"Pages and Tournament items: the content only Admins write.\n\nA Page (such as About 关于) appears in the public navigation once Published.\n\nNeither goes through review. An Admin saves a Draft and Publishes it, and can\nUnpublish it or delete it for good. Every function takes the acting user and\nrefuses anyone who can't manage_pages, whatever the route in front of it\nchecked. Anything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message\nto show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\n\nfrom app import db\nfrom app.accounts import User\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Page or Tournament item change the console refuses, with the reason\n    to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass NotFound(Refused):\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\ndef _check_manages_pages(actor: User) -> None:\n    if not actor.can(\"manage_pages\"):\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有管理员可以管理页面和锦标赛内容。\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Page:\n    id: int\n    slug: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Where the Page's console pages live, from the console root.\"\"\"\n        return f\"admin/pages/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"Chinese text is required to Publish; English is optional.\"\"\"\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass PageFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Page form sends.\"\"\"\n    slug: str = \"\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, page: Page) -> PageFields:\n        return cls(slug=page.slug, title_zh=page.title_zh, body_zh=page.body_zh,\n                   title_en=page.title_en, body_en=page.body_en)\n\n\ndef _page_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Page:\n    return Page(**{field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Page)})\n\n\n_SLUG = re.compile(r\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\")\n# The folders the Site build already makes in each language tree.\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"guides\", \"heroes\", \"authors\", \"tournaments\"}\n\n\ndef _checked_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, slug: str,\n                  page_id: int | None = None) -> str:\n    slug = slug.strip()\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写网址名，例如 about。\")\n    if not _SLUG.fullmatch(slug):\n        raise Refused(\"网址名只能包含小写英文字母、数字和连字符，例如 about。\")\n    if slug in RESERVED_SLUGS:\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 是网站自己用的，请换一个。\")\n    if conn.execute(\"SELECT 1 FROM pages WHERE slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n                    (slug, page_id)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被另一个页面使用。\")\n    return slug\n\n\ndef _check_publishable(title_zh: str, body_zh: str, title_en: str, body_en: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"What Readers get must have Chinese text, and English text either whole\n    or not at all.\"\"\"\n    if not title_zh.strip() or not body_zh.strip():\n        raise Refused(\"发布前请填写中文标题和中文正文。\")\n    if bool(title_en.strip()) != bool(body_en.strip()):\n        raise Refused(\"英文版的标题和正文要么都填写，要么都留空。\")\n\n\ndef create_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, fields: PageFields) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"A new Draft Page. Raises Refused if the slug is missing, not ASCII,\n    reserved, or taken.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, fields.slug)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO pages (slug, title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en)\"\n        \" VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (slug, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en, fields.body_en))\n    return _existing_page(conn, cur.lastrowid or 0)\n\n\ndef _existing_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(\"找不到这个页面。\")\n    return _page_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Raises NotFound if there is no such Page.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef pages(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every Page, in the order they were added.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return [_page_from_row(row)\n            for row in conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages ORDER BY id\")]\n\n\ndef save_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int,\n              fields: PageFields) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Change a Page. A Published Page stays Published, so it must stay\n    publishable; its change reaches the site at the next Site build.\"\"\"\n    current = page(conn, actor, page_id)\n    slug = _checked_slug(conn, fields.slug, page_id)\n    published = current.status == \"published\"\n    if published:\n        _check_publishable(fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n                           fields.body_en)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE pages SET slug = ?, title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?, title_en = ?,\"\n        f\" body_en = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        + (f\", site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\" if published else \"\") + \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (slug, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en, fields.body_en,\n         page_id))\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef publish_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Publish a Draft Page; it appears in the navigation after the next Site\n    build. Raises Refused if it lacks Chinese text.\"\"\"\n    current = page(conn, actor, page_id)\n    if current.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这个页面已经发布了。\")\n    _check_publishable(current.title_zh, current.body_zh, current.title_en,\n                       current.body_en)\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE pages SET status = 'published', site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef published_pages(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Page, in the order they were added: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY id\")\n    return [_page_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"84c7639b-a7b9-410b-9d18-a756bd118529","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"b9673522-4224-4d68-aade-86a8e1ac9c67","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8vkeF6QVvxZbMBnQNnC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CTfM34iQhGm5cpVBBHbdRb","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/routes/pages.py","content":"\"\"\"Pages (such as About 关于) in the console, managed by Admins only.\n\nThe router itself requires an Admin, so no route here can forget to. Every\nchange goes through app/content.py; these routes only turn its answers into\npages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import content, db\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Page, PageFields\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, requires, templates\n\npage_manager = requires(\"manage_pages\")\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(page_manager)])\n\n\ndef form_text(form: FormData, name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form field as text; a missing one (or a file) counts as blank, so it\n    gets our message rather than a 422.\"\"\"\n    value = form.get(name)\n    return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n\n\nasync def page_fields(request: Request) -> PageFields:\n    form = await request.form()\n    return PageFields(**{name: form_text(form, name) for name in\n                         (\"slug\", \"title_zh\", \"body_zh\", \"title_en\", \"body_en\")})\n\n\nasync def sent_page_fields(request: Request) -> PageFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a button inside it sent them along, or\n    None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    return await page_fields(request) if \"slug\" in await request.form() else None\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: content.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, content.NotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, content.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef existing_page(page_id: int, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]) -> Page:\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return content.page(conn, user, page_id)\n    except content.NotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, page: Page | None, fields: PageFields,\n                *, error: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    title = f\"编辑页面：{page.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if page else \"新建页面\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/page_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"page\": page, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pages\")\ndef page_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = content.pages(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages.html\", {\"title\": \"页面\", \"user\": user, \"pages\": listed})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pages/new\")\ndef new_page_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, PageFields())\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/pages\")\ndef create_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                fields: Annotated[PageFields, Depends(page_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            page = content.create_page(conn, user, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{page.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_page_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                   page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, page, PageFields.of(page))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}\")\ndef save_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n              page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)],\n              fields: Annotated[PageFields, Depends(page_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            content.save_page(conn, user, page.id, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, page, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\" if page.status == \"draft\"\n          else \"已保存。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会看到改动。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{page.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                 page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)],\n                 fields: Annotated[PageFields | None, Depends(sent_page_fields)]):\n    \"\"\"Publish, saving the editor's fields first when they came along; if\n    either is refused, neither is saved.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if fields:\n                content.save_page(conn, user, page.id, fields)\n            content.publish_page(conn, user, page.id)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, page, fields or PageFields.of(page),\n                           error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，它会出现在公开网站的导航里。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{page.console_path}/edit\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2967,"cache_read_input_tokens":171790,"output_tokens":3429,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":63},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2967,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":3429,"cache_read_input_tokens":171790,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2967,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2967},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01CTfM34iQhGm5cpVBBHbdRb":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/routes/pages.py","content":"\"\"\"Pages {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","hash":"9ad20738388802e4f1e5e5c3cd7ed7173832e3064895a6a25f73d299655c246c","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"text","text":"Now the Page routes and console templates."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01CTfM34iQhGm5cpVBBHbdRb","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/routes/pages.py","content":"\"\"\"Pages (such as About 关于) in the console, managed by Admins only.\n\nThe router itself requires an Admin, so no route here can forget to. Every\nchange goes through app/content.py; these routes only turn its answers into\npages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\nfrom starlette.datastructures import FormData\n\nfrom app import content, db\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import Page, PageFields\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, requires, templates\n\npage_manager = requires(\"manage_pages\")\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(page_manager)])\n\n\ndef form_text(form: FormData, name: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A form field as text; a missing one (or a file) counts as blank, so it\n    gets our message rather than a 422.\"\"\"\n    value = form.get(name)\n    return value if isinstance(value, str) else \"\"\n\n\nasync def page_fields(request: Request) -> PageFields:\n    form = await request.form()\n    return PageFields(**{name: form_text(form, name) for name in\n                         (\"slug\", \"title_zh\", \"body_zh\", \"title_en\", \"body_en\")})\n\n\nasync def sent_page_fields(request: Request) -> PageFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a button inside it sent them along, or\n    None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    return await page_fields(request) if \"slug\" in await request.form() else None\n\n\ndef status_for(refused: content.Refused) -> int:\n    if isinstance(refused, content.NotFound):\n        return 404\n    return 403 if isinstance(refused, content.NotAllowed) else 400\n\n\ndef existing_page(page_id: int, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]) -> Page:\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return content.page(conn, user, page_id)\n    except content.NotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, page: Page | None, fields: PageFields,\n                *, error: str | None = None, status_code: int = 200):\n    title = f\"编辑页面：{page.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if page else \"新建页面\"\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/page_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"page\": page, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pages\")\ndef page_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = content.pages(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/pages.html\", {\"title\": \"页面\", \"user\": user, \"pages\": listed})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pages/new\")\ndef new_page_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, PageFields())\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/pages\")\ndef create_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                fields: Annotated[PageFields, Depends(page_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            page = content.create_page(conn, user, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{page.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_page_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                   page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, page, PageFields.of(page))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}\")\ndef save_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n              page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)],\n              fields: Annotated[PageFields, Depends(page_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            content.save_page(conn, user, page.id, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, page, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\" if page.status == \"draft\"\n          else \"已保存。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会看到改动。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{page.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                 page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)],\n                 fields: Annotated[PageFields | None, Depends(sent_page_fields)]):\n    \"\"\"Publish, saving the editor's fields first when they came along; if\n    either is refused, neither is saved.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            if fields:\n                content.save_page(conn, user, page.id, fields)\n            content.publish_page(conn, user, page.id)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, page, fields or PageFields.of(page),\n                           error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，它会出现在公开网站的导航里。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{page.console_path}/edit\")\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01916PzMLfF8FkfjnNbXzxKd","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/templates/admin/pages.html","content":"{% Next slice: edit, Unpublish and delete for good, plus the Publish preconditions."},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Rtb9E4723tup4i3AnnAf9r","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2 && cat >> tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py <<'EOF'\n\n\ndef test_an_edit_to_a_published_page_reaches_the_site_at_the_next_build(admin, site):\n    about = published_page(admin, slug=\"about\", body_zh=\"旧的介绍。\")\n    assert save_page(admin, about, body_zh=\"新的介绍。\").status_code == 303\n    html = page(render_site(site), \"zh/about/\")\n    assert \"新的介绍。\" in html and \"旧的介绍。\" not in html\n\n\ndef test_an_unpublished_page_goes_back_to_draft_and_leaves_the_site(admin, site):\n    about = published_page(admin, slug=\"about\")\n    assert page_act(admin, about, \"unpublish\").status_code == 303\n    assert \"状态：草稿\" in admin.get(about).text\n    render_site(site)\n    assert not (site / \"zh/about\").exists()\n    assert (\"zh/about/\", \"关于\") not in navigation(site, \"zh/\")\n\n\ndef test_deleting_a_page_asks_first_then_removes_it_for_good(admin, site):\n    about = published_page(admin, slug=\"about\", title_zh=\"关于\")\n    confirm = admin.get(about.replace(\"/edit\", \"/delete\"))\n    assert confirm.status_code == 200\n    assert \"确定要彻底删除页面《关于》吗？\" in confirm.text and \"无法恢复\" in confirm.text\n    # Nothing is deleted until the confirmation is sent.\n    assert \"关于\" in admin.get(\"/admin/pages\").text\n\n    response = fill_in(admin, about.replace(\"/edit\", \"/delete\"),\n                       about.replace(\"/edit\", \"/delete\"))\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/pages\"\n    assert \"还没有页面\" in admin.get(\"/admin/pages\").text\n    assert admin.get(about).status_code == 404\n    render_site(site)\n    assert not (site / \"zh/about\").exists()\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"fields, message\", [\n    ({\"title_zh\": \"\"}, \"发布前请填写中文标题和中文正文\"),\n    ({\"body_zh\": \"  \"}, \"发布前请填写中文标题和中文正文\"),\n    ({\"title_en\": \"About\"}, \"英文版的标题和正文要么都填写，要么都留空\"),\n])\ndef test_a_page_needs_chinese_text_and_whole_english_text_to_be_published(\n        admin, fields, message):\n    edit_page = new_page(admin, **fields)\n    response = page_act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400 and message in response.text\n    assert \"状态：草稿\" in admin.get(edit_page).text\n\n\ndef test_a_published_page_cannot_be_saved_without_its_chinese_text(admin):\n    about = published_page(admin)\n    response = save_page(admin, about, body_zh=\"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400 and \"发布前请填写中文标题和中文正文\" in response.text\n    assert \"我们是几位主播。\" in admin.get(about).text\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py 2>&1 | grep -E \"passed|failed|^E \" | head","description":"Add edit, unpublish, delete and publish-rule tests"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

Implementing both:"},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014AamSi7UPTE5NYQMM6Pdyr","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2 && cat >> app/content.py <<'EOF'\n\n\ndef unpublish_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Make a Published Page a Draft again; the next Site build leaves it out.\"\"\"\n    if page(conn, actor, page_id).status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"只有已发布的页面才能撤下。\")\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE pages SET status = 'draft', site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef delete_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a Page for good. A Published one leaves the site at the next\n    Site build.\"\"\"\n    page(conn, actor, page_id)\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\nEOF\ncat >> app/routes/pages.py <<'EOF'\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/unpublish\")\ndef unpublish_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                   page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            content.unpublish_page(conn, user, page.id)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, page, PageFields.of(page),\n                           error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已撤下，页面回到了草稿。点击“更新网站”后，它才会从公开网站上消失。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{page.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                        page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)]):\n    consequences = [\"彻底删除后无法恢复。\"]\n    if page.status == \"published\":\n        consequences.append(\"下次“更新网站”后，它会从公开网站和导航里消失。\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/confirm_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"删除页面\", \"user\": user,\n         \"question\": f\"确定要彻底删除页面《{page.title_zh or '（无标题）'}》吗？\",\n         \"consequences\": consequences, \"button\": \"彻底删除\",\n         \"action\": f\"{page.console_path}/delete\",\n         \"cancel\": f\"{page.console_path}/edit\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/delete\")\ndef delete_page(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                page: Annotated[Page, Depends(existing_page)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        content.delete_page(conn, user, page.id)\n    flash(request, \"页面已彻底删除。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/pages\")\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np = Path(\"templates/admin/page_edit.html\"); s = p.read_text()\nold = '''  <p>状态：{{ page.status_label }} · 更新于 {{ page.updated_at }}</p>\n'''\nnew = '''  <p>状态：{{ page.status_label }} · 网址名：<code>{{ page.slug }}</code> · 更新于 {{ page.updated_at }}</p>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/preview\">预览</a>（显示已保存的内容，与读者看到的一致）\n    · <a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/delete\">删除…</a></p>\n  {% if page.status == \"published\" %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/unpublish\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p>已发布。“更新网站”后它会出现在公开网站的导航里。 <button type=\"submit\">撤下</button></p>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n'''\nassert old in s; p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py 2>&1 | grep -E \"passed|failed|^E \" | head","description":"Implement Page unpublish and delete for good"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

returns its edit page.\"\"\"\n    form = admin.get(\"/admin/tournaments/new\").text\n    response = fill_in(admin, \"/admin/tournaments/new\", \"/admin/tournaments\",\n                       **(TOURNAMENT_ITEM | {\"patch_id\": option_value(form, patch)}\n                          | fields))\n    assert response.status_code == 303, response.text\n    edit_page = response.headers[\"location\"]\n    assert re.fullmatch(r\"/admin/tournaments/\\d+/edit\", edit_page)\n    return edit_page\n\n\ndef published_tournament_item(admin: TestClient, **fields) -> str:\n    edit_page = new_tournament_item(admin, **fields)\n    assert page_act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\").status_code == 303\n    return edit_page\n\n\nTOURNAMENT_LIST_ITEM = re.compile(\n    r'<li><span class=\"badge\">([^<]+)</span>\\s*<a href=\"([^\"]+)\">([^<]+)</a>')\n\n\ndef tournament_list(site: Path, lang: str) -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:\n    \"\"\"The 锦标赛 list of one language tree: (badge, title, the folder its\n    link leads to, from the site root), in order.\"\"\"\n    path = f\"{lang}/tournaments/\"\n    return [(badge, title, posixpath.normpath(posixpath.join(path, href)) + \"/\")\n            for badge, href, title in TOURNAMENT_LIST_ITEM.findall(page(site, path))]\n\n\ndef test_a_published_announcement_is_listed_with_its_badge_and_has_its_own_page(\n        admin, site):\n    published_tournament_item(admin, title_zh=\"十月锦标赛\", tournament_date=\"2026-10-24\")\n    render_site(site)\n\n    [(badge, title, item_page)] = tournament_list(site, \"zh\")\n    assert (badge, title) == (\"预告\", \"十月锦标赛\")\n    html = page(site, item_page)\n    assert \"<h1>十月锦标赛</h1>\" in html and \"周六晚上八点开始。\" in html\n    assert \"2026-10-24\" in html and \"6.7\" in html and \"预告\" in html\nEOF\npython3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np = Path(\"tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py\"); {"parentUuid":"64406995-88ff-4926-a970-cd8cad116055","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8w3rRJsRHJvDmvQe1BL","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_015Fbt9LC4CkuzVfH4he5MGv","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"python3 - <<'EOF'\nfrom pathlib import Path\np = Path(\"app/content.py\"); s = p.read_text()\nstart = s.index(\"def publish_page(\")\ns = s[:start] + '''def _publish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, item: TextBearing,\n             what: str) -> None:\n    if item.status == \"published\":\n        raise Refused(f\"这个{what}已经发布了。\")\n    _check_publishable(item.title_zh, item.body_zh, item.title_en, item.body_en)\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET status = 'published', site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (item.id,))\n\n\ndef _unpublish(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, item: TextBearing,\n               what: str) -> None:\n    if item.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(f\"只有已发布的{what}才能撤下。\")\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE {table} SET status = 'draft', site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE id = ?\", (item.id,))\n\n\ndef publish_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Publish a Draft Page; it appears in the navigation after the next Site\n    build. Raises Refused if it lacks Chinese text.\"\"\"\n    _publish(conn, \"pages\", page(conn, actor, page_id), \"页面\")\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef unpublish_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> Page:\n    \"\"\"Make a Published Page a Draft again; the next Site build leaves it out.\"\"\"\n    _unpublish(conn, \"pages\", page(conn, actor, page_id), \"页面\")\n    return _existing_page(conn, page_id)\n\n\ndef delete_page(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, page_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a Page for good. A Published one leaves the site at the next\n    Site build.\"\"\"\n    page(conn, actor, page_id)\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n\n\ndef published_pages(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Page, in the order they were added: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY id\")\n    return [_page_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\n# Tournament items. An announcement (预告) tells Readers about an upcoming\n# Tournament; a recap (回顾) tells how one went, and may link to the\n# announcement it follows. Each has the Tournament's date and Patch.\n\nKIND_LABELS = {\"announcement\": \"预告\", \"recap\": \"回顾\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TournamentItem:\n    id: int\n    kind: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    tournament_date: str  # YYYY-MM-DD\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    announcement_id: int | None  # a recap's announcement, if it has one\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n        return KIND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        return f\"admin/tournaments/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TournamentFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Tournament item form sends.\"\"\"\n    kind: str = \"announcement\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    tournament_date: str = \"\"\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    announcement_id: int | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, item: TournamentItem) -> TournamentFields:\n        return cls(kind=item.kind, title_zh=item.title_zh, body_zh=item.body_zh,\n                   title_en=item.title_en, body_en=item.body_en,\n                   tournament_date=item.tournament_date, patch_id=item.patch_id,\n                   announcement_id=item.announcement_id)\n\n\n_TOURNAMENT_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT tournament_items.*, patches.name AS patch_name FROM tournament_items\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = tournament_items.patch_id\n\"\"\"\n# Newest first: the latest Tournament date, and the one added last on a day.\n_NEWEST_FIRST = \"ORDER BY tournament_date DESC, tournament_items.id DESC\"\n\n\ndef _item_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> TournamentItem:\n    return TournamentItem(**{field.name: row[field.name]\n                             for field in fields_of(TournamentItem)})\n\n\ndef _checked_tournament_fields(conn: sqlite3.Connection, fields: TournamentFields,\n                               item_id: int | None = None) -> TournamentFields:\n    \"\"\"The fields, with the date trimmed and an announcement's link dropped.\n    Raises Refused if the kind, date or Patch is missing, or a recap links\n    to anything but another announcement.\"\"\"\n    if fields.kind not in KIND_LABELS:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择预告或回顾。\")\n    day = fields.tournament_date.strip()\n    try:\n        valid = date.fromisoformat(day).isoformat() == day\n    except ValueError:\n        valid = False\n    if not valid:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写比赛日期，例如 2026-10-24。\")\n    if fields.patch_id is None or not conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM patches WHERE id = ?\", (fields.patch_id,)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    announcement_id = fields.announcement_id if fields.kind == \"recap\" else None\n    if announcement_id is not None and (announcement_id == item_id or not conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM tournament_items WHERE id = ? A Published one leaves the site at the next\n    Site build.\"\"\"\n    page(conn, actor, page_id)\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM pages WHERE id = ?\", (page_id,))\n\n\ndef published_pages(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Page]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Page, in the order they were added: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM pages WHERE status = 'published' ORDER BY id\")\n    return [_page_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\n# Tournament items. An announcement (预告) tells Readers about an upcoming\n# Tournament; a recap (回顾) tells how one went, and may link to the\n# announcement it follows. Each has the Tournament's date and Patch.\n\nKIND_LABELS = {\"announcement\": \"预告\", \"recap\": \"回顾\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TournamentItem:\n    id: int\n    kind: str\n    title_zh: str\n    body_zh: str\n    title_en: str\n    body_en: str\n    tournament_date: str  # YYYY-MM-DD\n    patch_id: int\n    patch_name: str\n    announcement_id: int | None  # a recap's announcement, if it has one\n    status: str\n    created_at: str\n    updated_at: str\n\n    @property\n    def kind_label(self) -> str:\n        return KIND_LABELS[self.kind]\n\n    @property\n    def status_label(self) -> str:\n        return STATUS_LABELS[self.status]\n\n    @property\n    def console_path(self) -> str:\n        return f\"admin/tournaments/{self.id}\"\n\n    def has_text_in(self, lang: str) -> bool:\n        return lang == \"zh\" or bool(self.title_en.strip() or self.body_en.strip())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass TournamentFields:\n    \"\"\"What the Tournament item form sends.\"\"\"\n    kind: str = \"announcement\"\n    title_zh: str = \"\"\n    body_zh: str = \"\"\n    title_en: str = \"\"\n    body_en: str = \"\"\n    tournament_date: str = \"\"\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    announcement_id: int | None = None\n\n    @classmethod\n    def of(cls, item: TournamentItem) -> TournamentFields:\n        return cls(kind=item.kind, title_zh=item.title_zh, body_zh=item.body_zh,\n                   title_en=item.title_en, body_en=item.body_en,\n                   tournament_date=item.tournament_date, patch_id=item.patch_id,\n                   announcement_id=item.announcement_id)\n\n\n_TOURNAMENT_SELECT = \"\"\"\nSELECT tournament_items.*, patches.name AS patch_name FROM tournament_items\nJOIN patches ON patches.id = tournament_items.patch_id\n\"\"\"\n# Newest first: the latest Tournament date, and the one added last on a day.\n_NEWEST_FIRST = \"ORDER BY tournament_date DESC, tournament_items.id DESC\"\n\n\ndef trimmed and an announcement's link dropped.\n    Raises Refused if the kind, date or Patch is missing, or a recap links\n    to anything but another announcement.\"\"\"\n    if fields.kind not in KIND_LABELS:\n        raise Refused(\"请选择预告或回顾。\")\n    day = fields.tournament_date.strip()\n    try:\n        valid = date.fromisoformat(day).isoformat() == day\n    except ValueError:\n        valid = False\n    if not valid:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写比赛日期，例如 2026-10-24。\")\n    if fields.patch_id is None or not conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM patches WHERE id = ?\", (fields.patch_id,)).fetchone():\n        raise Refused(\"请选择版本。\")\n    announcement_id = fields.announcement_id if fields.kind == \"recap\" else None\n    if announcement_id is not None and (announcement_id == item_id or not conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT 1 FROM tournament_items WHERE id = ? AND kind = 'announcement'\",\n            (announcement_id,)).fetchone()):\n        raise Refused(\"回顾只能关联一条锦标赛预告。\")\n    return replace(fields, tournament_date=day, announcement_id=announcement_id)\n\n\ndef _existing_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} WHERE tournament_items.id = ?\",\n                       (item_id,)).fetchone()\n    if row is None:\n        raise NotFound(\"找不到这条锦标赛内容。\")\n    return _item_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                    item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"Raises NotFound if there is no such Tournament item.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef tournament_items(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[TournamentItem]:\n    \"\"\"Every Tournament item, newest first.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    return [_item_from_row(row)\n            for row in conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} {_NEWEST_FIRST}\")]\n\n\ndef create_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                           fields: TournamentFields) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"A new Draft Tournament item.\"\"\"\n    _check_manages_pages(actor)\n    fields = _checked_tournament_fields(conn, fields)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO tournament_items (kind, title_zh, body_zh, title_en, body_en,\"\n        \" tournament_date, patch_id, announcement_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n        (fields.kind, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n         fields.body_en, fields.tournament_date, fields.patch_id,\n         fields.announcement_id))\n    return _existing_item(conn, cur.lastrowid or 0)\n\n\ndef save_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, item_id: int,\n                         fields: TournamentFields) -> TournamentItem:\n    \"\"\"Change a Tournament item. A Published one must stay publishable. An\n    announcement made a recap is no longer one, so recaps stop linking to it.\"\"\"\n    current = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    fields = _checked_tournament_fields(conn, fields, item_id)\n    published = current.status == \"published\"\n    if published:\n        _check_publishable(fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n                           fields.body_en)\n    conn.execute(\n        \"UPDATE tournament_items SET kind = ?, title_zh = ?, body_zh = ?,\"\n        \" title_en = ?, body_en = ?, tournament_date = ?, patch_id = ?,\"\n        f\" announcement_id = ?, updated_at = {db.NOW}\"\n        + (f\", site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\" if published else \"\") + \" WHERE id = ?\",\n        (fields.kind, fields.title_zh, fields.body_zh, fields.title_en,\n         fields.body_en, fields.tournament_date, fields.patch_id,\n         fields.announcement_id, item_id))\n    if fields.kind != \"announcement\":\n        _unlink_recaps_of(conn, item_id)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef _unlink_recaps_of(conn: sqlite3.Connection, announcement_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Recaps that linked to the announcement stop doing so. A Published one\n    changes on the site, since its link goes.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(f\"UPDATE tournament_items SET site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                 \" WHERE announcement_id = ? AND status = 'published'\",\n                 (announcement_id,))\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE tournament_items SET announcement_id = NULL\"\n                 \" WHERE announcement_id = ?\", (announcement_id,))\n\n\ndef publish_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                            item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    _publish(conn, \"tournament_items\", tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id),\n             \"锦标赛内容\")\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef unpublish_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n                              item_id: int) -> TournamentItem:\n    _unpublish(conn, \"tournament_items\", tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id),\n               \"锦标赛内容\")\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef delete_tournament_item(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, item_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Delete a Tournament item for good; recaps that linked to it stay, with\n    no link.\"\"\"\n    tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    _unlink_recaps_of(conn, item_id)\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM tournament_items WHERE id = ?\", (item_id,))\n\n\ndef published_tournament_items(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[TournamentItem]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Tournament item, newest first: all the Site build may\n    read.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_TOURNAMENT_SELECT} WHERE status = 'published' {_NEWEST_FIRST}\")\n    return [_item_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n'''\ns = s.replace(\"from dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\\n\", \"from dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of, replace\\nfrom datetime import date\\n\")\ns = s.replace('''    a status, and a place in the console. Read-only, as both are frozen.\"\"\"\n''', '''    a status, and a place in the console. Read-only, as both are frozen.\"\"\"\n    @property\n    def id(self) -> int: ...\n''')\ns = s.replace('''A Page (such as About 关于) appears in the public navigation once Published.\n''', '''A Page (such as About 关于) appears in the public navigation once Published.\nA Tournament item is an announcement (预告) of an upcoming Tournament or a\nrecap (回顾) of one that happened; the 锦标赛 section lists them.\n''')\np.write_text(s)\n\np = Path(\"app/db.py\"); s = p.read_text()\nold = \"-- Published Guides deleted for good from the Trash.\"\nnew = '''-- A Tournament item is an announcement or a recap; a recap may link to the\n-- announcement it follows (announcement_id), and loses the link if that is\n-- deleted. tournament_date is YYYY-MM-DD.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tournament_items (\n    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('announcement', 'recap')),\n    title_zh        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    tournament_date TEXT NOT NULL,\n    patch_id        INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    announcement_id INTEGER REFERENCES tournament_items (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                    CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')),\n    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    site_changed_at TEXT\n);\n\n''' + old\nassert old in s; p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))\nEOF","description":"Add Tournament items to content module and schema"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

Every\nchange goes through app/content.py; these routes only turn its answers into\npages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import content, db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import TournamentFields, TournamentItem\nfrom app.routes.pages import form_text, page_manager, preview_page, status_for\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(page_manager)])\n\n\ndef _id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    return int(value) if value.strip().isdigit() else None\n\n\nasync def tournament_fields(request: Request) -> TournamentFields:\n    form = await request.form()\n    texts = {name: form_text(form, name) for name in\n             (\"kind\", \"title_zh\", \"body_zh\", \"title_en\", \"body_en\", \"tournament_date\")}\n    return TournamentFields(**texts,\n                            patch_id=_id_or_none(form_text(form, \"patch_id\")),\n                            announcement_id=_id_or_none(form_text(form, \"announcement_id\")))\n\n\nasync def sent_tournament_fields(request: Request) -> TournamentFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a button inside it sent them along, or\n    None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return await tournament_fields(request) if \"kind\" in form else None\n\n\ndef existing_item(item_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]) -> TournamentItem:\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return content.tournament_item(conn, user, item_id)\n    except content.NotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, item: TournamentItem | None,\n                fields: TournamentFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n        announcements = [other for other in content.tournament_items(conn, user)\n                         if other.kind == \"announcement\"\n                         and (item is None or other.id != item.id)]\n    title = (f\"编辑锦标赛{item.kind_label}：{item.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if item\n             else \"新建锦标赛内容\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/tournament_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"item\": item, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"kinds\": content.KIND_LABELS, \"patches\": patches,\n         \"announcements\": announcements, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments\")\ndef tournament_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = content.tournament_items(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/tournaments.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"锦标赛\", \"user\": user, \"items\": listed})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments/new\")\ndef new_item_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n    current = patches[0].id if patches else None\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, TournamentFields(patch_id=current))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments\")\ndef create_item(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                fields: Annotated[TournamentFields, Depends(tournament_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            item = content.create_tournament_item(conn, user, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{item.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_item_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                   item: Annotated[TournamentItem, Depends(existing_item)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, item, TournamentFields.of(item))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}\")\ndef save_item(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n              item: Annotated[TournamentItem, Depends(existing_item)],\n              fields: Annotated[TournamentFields, Depends(tournament_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n \"已发布。点击“更新网站”后，它会出现在公开网站的锦标赛栏目里。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{item.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}/unpublish\")\ndef unpublish_item(request: Request, user: content.unpublish_tournament_item(conn, user, item.id)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, item, TournamentFields.of(item),\n                           error=refused.message, status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已撤下，回到了草稿。点击“更新网站”后，它才会从公开网站上消失。\")\n    return extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% set path = item.console_path if item else \"admin/tournaments\" %}\n{% block content %}\n  <h1>{{ title }}</h1>\n  {% if item %}\n  <p>状态：{{ item.status_label }} · 更新于 {{ item.updated_at }}</p>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/preview\">预览</a>（显示已保存的内容，与读者看到的一致）\n    · <a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/delete\">删除…</a></p>\n  {% if item.status == \"published\" %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/unpublish\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <p>已发布。“更新网站”后它会出现在公开网站的锦标赛栏目里。 <button type=\"submit\">撤下</button></p>\n  </form>\n  {% endif %}\n  {% endif %}\n\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>类型</legend>\n      {% for value, label in kinds.items() %}\n      <label><input type=\"radio\" name=\"kind\" value=\"{{ value }}\"{% if value == fields.kind %} checked{% endif %}> {{ label }}</label>\n      {% endfor %}\n    </fieldset>\n    <label>比赛日期\n      <input type=\"date\" name=\"tournament_date\" value=\"{{ fields.tournament_date }}\" required>\n    </label>\n    <label>版本\n      <select name=\"patch_id\" required>\n        {% for patch in patches %}\n        <option value=\"{{ patch.id }}\"{% if patch.id == fields.patch_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ patch.name }}{% if patch.is_current %}（当前版本）{% endif %}</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>回顾所对应的预告（可选，只用于回顾）\n      <select name=\"announcement_id\">\n        <option value=\"\">不关联</option>\n        {% for announcement in announcements %}\n        <option value=\"{{ announcement.id }}\"{% if announcement.id == fields.announcement_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ announcement.tournament_date }} {{ announcement.title_zh or \"（无标题）\" }}（{{ announcement.status_label }}）</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>中文版（发布前必须填写）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","hash":"ee15477f329d02ea5d571a372dd4231a64122257839352e921f884eea178ba91","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"text","text":"Now the Tournament routes and templates:"},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01KKXdmkE3RkCynUzC8qt7fK","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/routes/tournaments.py","content":"\"\"\"Tournament announcements (预告) and recaps (回顾) in the console, managed\nby Admins only.\n\nThe router itself requires an Admin, so no route here can forget to. Every\nchange goes through app/content.py; these routes only turn its answers into\npages.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import content, db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.content import TournamentFields, TournamentItem\nfrom app.routes.pages import form_text, page_manager, preview_page, status_for\nfrom app.web import flash, redirect, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter(dependencies=[Depends(page_manager)])\n\n\ndef _id_or_none(value: str) -> int | None:\n    return int(value) if value.strip().isdigit() else None\n\n\nasync def tournament_fields(request: Request) -> TournamentFields:\n    form = await request.form()\n    texts = {name: form_text(form, name) for name in\n             (\"kind\", \"title_zh\", \"body_zh\", \"title_en\", \"body_en\", \"tournament_date\")}\n    return TournamentFields(**texts,\n                            patch_id=_id_or_none(form_text(form, \"patch_id\")),\n                            announcement_id=_id_or_none(form_text(form, \"announcement_id\")))\n\n\nasync def sent_tournament_fields(request: Request) -> TournamentFields | None:\n    \"\"\"The editor form's fields when a button inside it sent them along, or\n    None for a bare post of the button alone.\"\"\"\n    form = await request.form()\n    return await tournament_fields(request) if \"kind\" in form else None\n\n\ndef existing_item(item_id: int,\n                  user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]) -> TournamentItem:\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            return content.tournament_item(conn, user, item_id)\n    except content.NotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n\n\ndef editor_page(request: Request, user: User, item: TournamentItem | None,\n                fields: TournamentFields, *, error: str | None = None,\n                status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n        announcements = [other for other in content.tournament_items(conn, user)\n                         if other.kind == \"announcement\"\n                         and (item is None or other.id != item.id)]\n    title = (f\"编辑锦标赛{item.kind_label}：{item.title_zh or '（无标题）'}\" if item\n             else \"新建锦标赛内容\")\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/tournament_edit.html\",\n        {\"title\": title, \"user\": user, \"item\": item, \"fields\": fields,\n         \"kinds\": content.KIND_LABELS, \"patches\": patches,\n         \"announcements\": announcements, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments\")\ndef tournament_list(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = content.tournament_items(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/tournaments.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"锦标赛\", \"user\": user, \"items\": listed})\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments/new\")\ndef new_item_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)]):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        patches = game.patches(conn)\n    current = patches[0].id if patches else None\n    return editor_page(request, user, None, TournamentFields(patch_id=current))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments\")\ndef create_item(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                fields: Annotated[TournamentFields, Depends(tournament_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            item = content.create_tournament_item(conn, user, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, None, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"草稿已保存。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{item.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}/edit\")\ndef edit_item_form(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                   item: Annotated[TournamentItem, Depends(existing_item)]):\n    return editor_page(request, user, item, TournamentFields.of(item))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}\")\ndef save_item(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n              item: Annotated[TournamentItem, Depends(existing_item)],\n              fields: Annotated[TournamentFields, Depends(tournament_fields)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            content.save_tournament_item(conn, user, item.id, fields)\n    except content.Refused as refused:\n        return editor_page(request, user, item, fields, error=refused.message,\n                           status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已保存。\" if item.status == \"draft\"\n          else \"已保存。点击“更新网站”后，读者才会看到改动。\")\n    return redirect(f\"/{item.console_path}/edit\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/tournaments/{item_id}/publish\")\ndef publish_item(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(page_manager)],\n                 item: Annotated[TournamentItem, Depends(existing_item)],\n                 fields: Annotated[TournamentFields | None,\n                                   Depends(sent_tournament_fields)]):\n </tr>\n    {% else %}\n      <tr><td colspan=\"6\">还没有锦标赛内容。</td></tr>\n    {% endfor %}\n    </tbody>\n  </table>\n  </div>\n{% endblock 更新于 {{ item.updated_at }}</p>\n  <p><a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/preview\">预览</a>（显示已保存的内容，与读者看到的一致）\n    · <a href=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/delete\">删除…</a></p>\n  {% if item.status == \"published\" %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ console_root(request) }}{{ path }}/unpublish\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ <label>比赛日期\n      <input type=\"date\" name=\"tournament_date\" value=\"{{ fields.tournament_date }}\" required>\n    </label>\n    <label>版本\n      <select name=\"patch_id\" required>\n        {% for patch in patches %}\n        <option value=\"{{ patch.id }}\"{% if patch.id == fields.patch_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ patch.name }}{% if patch.is_current %}（当前版本）{% endif %}</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>回顾所对应的预告（可选，只用于回顾）\n      <select name=\"announcement_id\">\n        <option value=\"\">不关联</option>\n        {% for announcement in </label>\n    </fieldset>\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>英文版（可选；没有英文版的内容不会出现在英文网站上）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"title_en\" value=\"{{ fields.title_en }}\">\n test_the_english_tournament_list_says_so_when_empty(admin, site):\n    published_tournament_item(admin)\n    render_site(site)\n    assert \"No English tournament posts yet.\" in page(site, AND status = 'published'\",\n                 (announcement_id,))\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE tournament_items SET announcement_id = NULL\"\n                 \" WHERE announcement_id = ?\", (announcement_id,))''', '''    if fields.kind != \"announcement\":\n        _unlink_recaps_of(conn, current)\n    return _existing_item(conn, item_id)\n\n\ndef _unlink_recaps_of(conn: sqlite3.Connection, announcement: TournamentItem) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Recaps that linked to the announcement stop doing so. If it was\n    Published, so the site showed those links, Published recaps change on\n    the site.\"\"\"\n    if announcement.status == \"published\":\n        conn.execute(f\"UPDATE tournament_items SET site_changed_at = {db.NOW}\"\n                     \" WHERE announcement_id = ? AND status = 'published'\",\n                     (announcement.id,))\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE tournament_items SET announcement_id = NULL\"\n                 \" WHERE announcement_id = ?\", (announcement.id,))'''),\n ('''    tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    _unlink_recaps_of(conn, item_id)\n    conn.execute(''', '''    item = tournament_item(conn, actor, item_id)\n    _unlink_recaps_of(conn, item)\n    _record_removal(conn, \"tournament_item\", \"tournament_items\", item)\n    conn.execute('''),\n])\nedit(\"app/publish.py\", [\n ('''def changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides changed since the last successful Site build started\n    (all of them, if there has never been one): Published Guides edited\n    since, Guides Unpublished since, which the next build leaves out, and\n    Published Guides moved to or restored from the Trash since.\"\"\"''', '''def changes_not_on_site(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> int:\n    \"\"\"How many Guides, Pages and Tournament items changed since the last\n    successful Site build started (all of them, if there has never been\n    one): Published Guides edited since, Guides Unpublished since, which the\n    next build leaves out, Published Guides moved to or restored from the\n    Trash since, and the Page and Tournament changes content.changes_since\n    counts.\"\"\"'''),\n ('''    return len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n               | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))''', '''    return (len(changed | guides.unpublished_since(conn, last)\n                | guides.trash_changes_since(conn, last))\n            + content.changes_since(conn, last))'''),\n])\nEOF\nuv run pytest -q tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py 2>&1 | grep -E \"^FAILED|passed|failed|^E \" | head -6","description":"Count Page and Tournament changes on the dashboard"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}
