{"type":"queue-operation","operation":"enqueue","timestamp":"2026-10-18T02:57:26.582Z","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","content":"<task-notification>\n<task-id>abc5428678dd21049</task-id>\n<tool-use-id>toolu_016iDZMkEJus9YDA5NHSH63t</tool-use-id>\n<output-file>/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5/tasks/abc5428678dd21049.output</output-file>\n<status>completed</status>\n<summary>Agent \"/code-review Review the T08 changes (ticket #9: P…\" finished</summary>\n<note>A task-notification fires each time this agent stops with no live background children of its own. The user can send it another message and resume it, so the same task-id may notify more than once.</note>\n<result>I found 10 issues in the T08 working-tree changes. Two are real but low-impact bugs; the rest are cleanup. None breaks a rule in CLAUDE.md, and the full suite passes (414 tests).\n\n- **Bugs:**\n  - The dashboard count of changes not yet on the site misses Published recaps whose announcement was published, unpublished or retitled. The docstring promises it \"never misses one\". The dashboard still never wrongly says \"网站已是最新\", because the announcement itself is always counted.\n  - Some malformed input crashes a route instead of showing a message: a tampered Patch or announcement id (e.g. \"²\", or a 25-digit number), or deleting an item that was deleted a moment earlier.\n- **Consistency:** Page and Tournament titles are saved without trimming whitespace, which Guides do, so stray spaces show up in the public navigation.\n- **Duplication:** several helpers and rules are copied from the Guide code, and the English labels are written out again in the preview. The list of reserved Page slugs is a hand-kept copy of the site's folder layout.\n- **Wasted work:** the new Tournament item form reads the Patches twice, and the site build re-filters the Pages for every page it writes.\n\n```json\n[\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/content.py\",\n    \"line\": 211,\n    \"summary\": \"Unpublishing, publishing or editing the title of a Published announcement changes every Published recap that links to it (the link appears, disappears or gets a new title on the site), but only the announcement's site_changed_at is bumped, so changes_since leaves those recaps out, despite its docstring saying it 'never misses one'.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Published recap R links to Published announcement A; the site is built; the Admin unpublishes A. The next build drops the 'follows' link from R's page, but changes_not_on_site reports 1 change (A), not 2. The same happens when A is first published after R (save_tournament_item/_publish only touch A's own row), or when A's title is edited (R's link text changes). _unlink_recaps_of handles this only for delete and kind-change, not for publish, unpublish or a title edit.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/tournaments.py\",\n    \"line\": 24,\n    \"summary\": \"_id_or_none uses str.isdigit(), which accepts characters int() rejects, and does no range check, so a tampered patch_id/announcement_id gives a 500 instead of the 'please choose' message.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"POST /admin/tournaments with patch_id='²' (isdigit() is True, int() raises ValueError) or patch_id='99999999999999999999999' (int is fine, but sqlite3 raises OverflowError on bind in _checked_tournament_fields). Both escape as unhandled exceptions, a 500, rather than Refused('请选择版本。'). Use a try/except int() with a bounds check, or value.isascii() and value.isdigit().\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/pages.py\",\n    \"line\": 163,\n    \"summary\": \"The delete POST routes (pages.delete_page and tournaments.delete_item, line 182) call content.delete_* without catching content.Refused/NotFound, unlike every other mutating route here.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Two Admin tabs both confirm deleting the same Page. The existing_page dependency succeeds in both, but the second request's content.delete_page -&gt; page() raises NotFound inside the route's own connection, which is not caught, so the second Admin gets a 500 page instead of a 404 or a flash message.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/content.py\",\n    \"line\": 153,\n    \"summary\": \"create_page/save_page (and the tournament insert/update at lines 391/410) store title_zh/title_en as typed, while Guides store title.strip(), so stray whitespace reaches the public navigation and titles.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"The Admin types ' 关于 ' as the Page title; _check_publishable strips before checking, so it publishes, but the nav link, &lt;title&gt; and &lt;h1&gt; on every site page render with the leading and trailing spaces. Guides (app/guides.py:243) strip on save, so the two kinds of content behave differently.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/pages.py\",\n    \"line\": 178,\n    \"summary\": \"The term_warnings list comprehension in preview_page is a verbatim copy of the one in app/routes/guides.py preview_page (lines 162-168).\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Any change to how Game Term warnings are labelled or collected (a new warning source, a reworded label) has to be made in two places, and the two previews will drift. Extract a shared helper (e.g. in app/rendering.py: term_warnings(item, rendered_zh, rendered_en, glossary)) and call it from both.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/content.py\",\n    \"line\": 118,\n    \"summary\": \"content.py re-implements helpers app/guides.py already has: the identical _SLUG regex (guides.py:265), the English 'both or neither' publishability rule (guides.py:313), and has_text_in (Guide.has_text_in, guides.py:94). routes/pages.form_text likewise duplicates the inner helper in routes/guides._fields_from.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Three copies of has_text_in (Guide, Page, TournamentItem) and two each of the slug regex, the English-completeness check and form-field coercion must stay in sync. Changing the slug rule or what counts as English text in one module silently diverges from the other. Move them to one shared module and import them. The NotFound.__init__ override (line 39) is also redundant and can go.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/tournaments.py\",\n    \"line\": 156,\n    \"summary\": \"The preview meta hard-codes 'Announcement'/'Recap' and '比赛日期' strings that already live in publish.LABELS, so the preview can drift from what Readers see.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"If publish.LABELS['en']['announcement'] is changed (say to 'Preview'), the console preview, which claims to show 'what Readers will see', keeps saying 'Announcement'. Build the meta from publish.LABELS[lang][item.kind] and LABELS[lang]['tournament_date'].\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/content.py\",\n    \"line\": 120,\n    \"summary\": \"RESERVED_SLUGS is a hand-kept copy of the folder layout that publish.render_site writes in each language tree, so a folder added to the build later will not be reserved automatically.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A later ticket adds write.page(f'{lang}/patches/...') to render_site but does not update content.RESERVED_SLUGS. An Admin can then create a Page with slug 'patches', and the build silently overwrites one with the other at {lang}/patches/index.html. Define the reserved top-level folders once in publish (or have render_site assert no Page slug collides) rather than in content.py.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/routes/tournaments.py\",\n    \"line\": 81,\n    \"summary\": \"new_item_form opens a database connection only to read the Patches, then editor_page opens another and reads the same Patches again.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Every GET /admin/tournaments/new runs db.connect() twice, each one re-running executescript(SCHEMA), _add_missing_columns and INDEXES, plus game.patches twice. Let editor_page pick the default patch_id (patches[0].id when fields.patch_id is None) from the list it already loads.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/publish.py\",\n    \"line\": 128,\n    \"summary\": \"_Writer.page rebuilds the nav_pages list (filtering every Published Page by has_text_in) for every single file written, although it only depends on lang.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"With H Heroes, A Authors, G Guides and T Tournament items, the build re-filters the Page list (H+A+G+T+N)*2 times instead of twice. Precompute {lang: [p for p in nav_pages if p.has_text_in(lang)]} once in __init__ and look it up.\"\n  }\n]\n```</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>104633</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>15</tool_uses><duration_ms>270795</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

A nickname in a title says \"标题里请直接写 瓦妮莎\", and a marker in a title is flagged as \"会原样显示\". Test: `test_a_title_is_plain_text_so_the_preview_asks_for_the_official_name`. |\n| 2 | A malformed CSV (e.g. an unclosed quote running into an overlong cell) raised `csv.Error`, which nothing caught: a 500. | **Fixed.** `_csv_rows` turns `csv.Error` into a refusal naming the line, shown on the import page (400). Test: `test_a_csv_file_that_is_not_a_valid_csv_is_refused_whole`. |\n| 3 | Review-note quotes are matched against rendered text, which now depends on the Game Terms, so a quote can stop highlighting after a term is renamed. | **Not changed.** The preview already lists every quote it no longer finds (\"已不在正文中的\"), so the Author still sees it. The local database has no Review notes quoting `[[…]]` text from before T07. |\n| 4 | Re-running the seed called the full import, which would overwrite names an Admin had since edited. That contradicted the docstring. | **Fixed.** The seed imports with `only_new=True`, so it only adds terms that don't exist yet. Vanessa's demo nickname moved to `DEMO_HEROES`. Test: `test_seeding_again_leaves_game_terms_an_admin_has_edited`. |\n| 5 | `edit_term` crashed on a missing id, and `edit_hero` lost its old `kind = 'hero'` guard, so it could rename any term. | **Fixed.** Both refuse with a reason: `edit_term` when the id is missing, `edit_hero` when the term is not a Hero. The routes already 404 before reaching them. |\n| 6 | Chinese nicknames match anywhere, so a one-character nickname would flag ordinary text. | **Not changed.** Chinese has no word boundaries to match on, Admins choose the nicknames, and warnings never block Submit. Latin nicknames already match whole words only (`Van` is not found in `Vanguard`). **Revisited after review (see the note below).** |\n| 7 | `preview_term_import` was `async def` but made blocking SQLite calls on the event loop. | **Fixed.** It is a plain `def` (run in the thread pool) and reads `file.file`. |\n| 8 | Nickname matching runs one regex per nickname per render. | **Not changed.** Admins record few nicknames, and a Site build renders tens of Guides, so this is cheap. A combined pattern would also need care with overlapping nicknames. |\n| 9 | The nickname storage format was written out in three places. | **Fixed.** One `_to_store` helper. |\n| 10 | `add_hero` and `add_term` repeat the insert-then-reselect pattern, and the import chooses between them with `partial`. | **Not changed.** Heroes differ in their slug and their clash rules, and the two functions are short. |\n\n## Decisions not spelled out in the ticket\n\nAsked and answered this session:\n- **CSV format:** a header row `kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames` (the nicknames column may be left out). `kind` may be written in English (`item`) or Chinese (`物品`). Several nicknames in one cell are separated by `、` or `|`. The file must be UTF-8, with or without Excel's BOM.\n- **A marker naming several Game Terms** that give different names in the target language gets a preview warning. The site shows the first match, in kind order (Hero, Item, Skill, Enchantment, Monster, Merchant, Event).\n- **A marker naming no Game Term** shows its text without the brackets on the site, unstyled.\n- **Nickname warnings** cover both languages' titles and bodies, as Readers see the text. Code and marked terms are skipped.\n\nMade while building:\n- **Where terms are managed:** Heroes stay on the 英雄 page, which gains nicknames. The new 游戏术语 page handles the other six kinds. The CSV import covers all seven.\n- **No two terms of one kind share an English Official name** (ignoring case), generalising the Hero rule. Different kinds may share names. That is why the ambiguity warning exists.\n- **CSV matching:** a row whose kind and English Official name match an existing term changes it; any other row adds a term. An **empty nicknames cell keeps** the term's nicknames, so a CSV without nicknames never wipes nicknames typed by hand.\n- **CSV rows are numbered as a spreadsheet shows them** (the header is row 1). Wholly blank rows are skipped. A repeat of an earlier row in the same file is rejected, and so is a new Hero whose slug is taken.\n- **The import preview is stateless.** The uploaded file travels back base64-encoded in the confirm form and is checked again when confirmed.\n- **Markers render inside link text and image alt text,** and stay literal inside code. A marker's name is HTML-escaped, then nh3 sanitizes the result, keeping only `class=\"term\"` on `<span>`.\n- **Schema:** `game_terms.nicknames` was added the additive way (`ADDED_COLUMNS`), one nickname per line.\n- **Demo data:** `scripts/demo_game_terms.csv` doubles as a sample import file. Its Item names (船锚/Anchor, 火药桶/Powder Keg, 弯刀/Cutlass) were checked against bazaardb.gg by the user.\n\n## Note: finding 6 revisited\n\nOne-character Chinese nicknames are rare, but some players do use them, so refusing them would be wrong. Silently letting them flood the preview was not good enough either. Two changes:\n- **The Admin is told when they save one.** Saving a nickname that is a single Chinese character still works. The term or Hero page then shows a notice that it will match every occurrence of that character, and may cause many warnings. The notice stays on the term's edit page while the nickname is recorded. The CSV import preview names the rows that have one.\n- **The preview groups repeats.** It shows each unmarked nickname once, with a count (`外号“瓦姐”没有标记（3 处）…`), instead of once per occurrence. A frequent nickname now costs one line in 游戏术语检查.\n\nTests: `test_a_one_character_chinese_nickname_is_saved_with_a_notice`, `test_a_one_character_chinese_nickname_on_a_hero_is_saved_with_a_notice`, `test_a_csv_import_preview_points_out_one_character_chinese_nicknames`, `test_each_unmarked_nickname_is_one_preview_warning_with_a_count`.\n\nVerification: `uv run pytest -q` gives 327 passed, and pyright reports 0 errors. The new console pages, the preview and both site Guide pages were checked with `/browse` at 1280px and 390px: `scrollWidth` is 390 on every page at 390px.\n\n\nT07: point out one-character Chinese nicknames; count nickname warnings\n\nFinding 6 of the T07 review, revisited. A nickname that is a single\nChinese character is still allowed, since some players use them, but\nsaving one shows a notice that it matches that character anywhere and\nmay cause many preview warnings. The notice stays on the term's edit\npage, and the CSV import preview names the rows with one.\n\nThe preview now gives each unmarked nickname one warning with a count\n(外号“瓦姐”没有标记（3 处）…) instead of one per occurrence.\n\nCloses #8\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n---\nT07: Game Terms with Official names in every Guide\n\nAdmins manage Game Terms of all seven kinds, each with both Official\nnames and optional nicknames: Heroes on the 英雄 page, the other six\nkinds on the new 游戏术语 page. A CSV import (kind,name_zh,name_en,\nnicknames) previews what it will add and change before saving, and\nrejects bad rows one by one with their row numbers.\n\n- `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]` in a Guide shows the term's Official\n  name in the language being rendered, in <span class=\"term\">, both in\n  the editor preview and in the Site build (one render_markdown pass).\n  A marker naming no term shows its text without brackets.\n- The preview's 游戏术语检查 warns about unknown markers, markers naming\n  several terms, and nicknames written without a marker (titles\n  included). Warnings never block Submit.\n- Term names are escaped and the HTML sanitized; nh3 keeps only\n  class=\"term\" on <span>.\n- Every Game Term and CSV route is behind requires(\"manage_game\"), so\n  the router walk covers it (Editors get 403).\n- game_terms.nicknames is added the additive way (ADDED_COLUMNS).\n- The seed imports scripts/demo_game_terms.csv (also a sample file),\n  adding only terms that don't exist yet.\n- CONTEXT.md gains Nickname (外号) and Game Term marker (术语标记).\n\nCloses #8","is_error":false}]}}

The routes already 404 before reaching them. |\n| 6 | Chinese nicknames match anywhere, so a one-character nickname would flag ordinary text. | **Not changed.** Chinese has no word boundaries to match on, Admins choose the nicknames, and warnings never block Submit. Latin nicknames already match whole words only (`Van` is not found in `Vanguard`). **Revisited after review (see the note below).** |\n| 7 | `preview_term_import` was `async def` but made blocking SQLite calls on the event loop. | **Fixed.** It is a plain `def` (run in the thread pool) and reads `file.file`. |\n| 8 | Nickname matching runs one regex per nickname per render. | **Not changed.** Admins record few nicknames, and a Site build renders tens of Guides, so this is cheap. A combined pattern would also need care with overlapping nicknames. |\n| 9 | The nickname storage format was written out in three places. | **Fixed.** One `_to_store` helper. |\n| 10 | `add_hero` and `add_term` repeat the insert-then-reselect pattern, and the import chooses between them with `partial`. | **Not changed.** Heroes differ in their slug and their clash rules, and the two functions are short. |\n\n## Decisions not spelled out in the ticket\n\nAsked and answered this session:\n- **CSV format:** a header row `kind,name_zh,name_en,nicknames` (the nicknames column may be left out). `kind` may be written in English (`item`) or Chinese (`物品`). Several nicknames in one cell are separated by `、` or `|`. The file must be UTF-8, with or without Excel's BOM.\n- **A marker naming several Game Terms** that give different names in the target language gets a preview warning. The site shows the first match, in kind order (Hero, Item, Skill, Enchantment, Monster, Merchant, Event).\n- **A marker naming no Game Term** shows its text without the brackets on the site, unstyled.\n- **Nickname warnings** cover both languages' titles and bodies, as Readers see the text. Code and marked terms are skipped.\n\nMade while building:\n- **Where terms are managed:** Heroes stay on the 英雄 page, which gains nicknames. The new 游戏术语 page handles the other six kinds. The CSV import covers all seven.\n- **No two terms of one kind share an English Official name** (ignoring case), generalising the Hero rule. Different kinds may share names. That is why the ambiguity warning exists.\n- **CSV matching:** a row whose kind and English Official name match an existing term changes it; any other row adds a term. An **empty nicknames cell keeps** the term's nicknames, so a CSV without nicknames never wipes nicknames typed by hand.\n- **CSV rows are numbered as a spreadsheet shows them** (the header is row 1). Wholly blank rows are skipped. A repeat of an earlier row in the same file is rejected, and so is a new Hero whose slug is taken.\n- **The import preview is stateless.** The uploaded file travels back base64-encoded in the confirm form and is checked again when confirmed.\n- **Markers render inside link text and image alt text,** and stay literal inside code. A marker's name is HTML-escaped, then nh3 sanitizes the result, keeping only `class=\"term\"` on `<span>`.\n- **Schema:** `game_terms.nicknames` was added the additive way (`ADDED_COLUMNS`), one nickname per line.\n- **Demo data:** `scripts/demo_game_terms.csv` doubles as a sample import file. Its Item names (船锚/Anchor, 火药桶/Powder Keg, 弯刀/Cutlass) were checked against bazaardb.gg by the user.\n\n## Note: finding 6 revisited\n\nOne-character Chinese nicknames are rare, but some players do use them, so refusing them would be wrong. Silently letting them flood the preview was not good enough either. Two changes:\n- **The Admin is told when they save one.** Saving a nickname that is a single Chinese character still works. The term or Hero page then shows a notice that it will match every occurrence of that character, and may cause many warnings. The notice stays on the term's edit page while the nickname is recorded. The CSV import preview names the rows that have one.\n- **The preview groups repeats.** It shows each unmarked nickname once, with a count (`外号“瓦姐”没有标记（3 处）…`), instead of once per occurrence. A frequent nickname now costs one line in 游戏术语检查.\n\nTests: `test_a_one_character_chinese_nickname_is_saved_with_a_notice`, `test_a_one_character_chinese_nickname_on_a_hero_is_saved_with_a_notice`, `test_a_csv_import_preview_points_out_one_character_chinese_nicknames`, `test_each_unmarked_nickname_is_one_preview_warning_with_a_count`.\n\nVerification: `uv run pytest -q` gives 327 passed, and pyright reports 0 errors. The new console pages, the preview and both site Guide pages were checked with `/browse` at 1280px and 390px: `scrollWidth` is 390 on every page at 390px.\n\n\nT07: point out one-character Chinese nicknames; count nickname warnings\n\nFinding 6 of the T07 review, revisited. A nickname that is a single\nChinese character is still allowed, since some players use them, but\nsaving one shows a notice that it matches that character anywhere and\nmay cause many preview warnings. The notice stays on the term's edit\npage, and the CSV import preview names the rows with one.\n\nThe preview now gives each unmarked nickname one warning with a count\n(外号“瓦姐”没有标记（3 处）…) instead of one per occurrence.\n\nCloses #8\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n---\nT07: Game Terms with Official names in every Guide\n\nAdmins manage Game Terms of all seven kinds, each with both Official\nnames and optional nicknames: Heroes on the 英雄 page, the other six\nkinds on the new 游戏术语 page. A CSV import (kind,name_zh,name_en,\nnicknames) previews what it will add and change before saving, and\nrejects bad rows one by one with their row numbers.\n\n- `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]` in a Guide shows the term's Official\n  name in the language being rendered, in <span class=\"term\">, both in\n  the editor preview and in the Site build (one render_markdown pass).\n  A marker naming no term shows its text without brackets.\n- The preview's 游戏术语检查 warns about unknown markers, markers naming\n  several terms, and nicknames written without a marker (titles\n  included). Warnings never block Submit.\n- Term names are escaped and the HTML sanitized; nh3 keeps only\n  class=\"term\" on <span>.\n- Every Game Term and CSV route is behind requires(\"manage_game\"), so\n  the router walk covers it (Editors get 403).\n- game_terms.nicknames is added the additive way (ADDED_COLUMNS).\n- The seed imports scripts/demo_game_terms.csv (also a sample file),\n  adding only terms that don't exist yet.\n- CONTEXT.md gains Nickname (外号) and Game Term marker (术语标记).\n\nCloses #8","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c48c9047-a1fc-4dc9-b52f-7c782e0220cf","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

The dashboard's \"changes not on the site\" count left those recaps out, although its docstring says it never misses one. | **Fixed.** `content._recaps_change_with` marks those recaps changed whenever their announcement is Published, Unpublished, edited while Published or deleted. The two-tab interleaving itself can't be driven through the test client. |\n| 4 | Page and Tournament titles were stored untrimmed, unlike Guides, so stray spaces reached the navigation. | **Fixed.** `content._trimmed` trims both titles on every save. Test: `test_page_and_tournament_titles_are_saved_without_surrounding_spaces`. |\n| 5 | The preview's Game Term warning list was copied from the Guide preview. | **Fixed.** One `rendering.preview_warnings`, used by both previews. |\n| 6 | Helpers duplicated from the Guide code: the slug pattern, `form_text`, the \"English text whole or not at all\" rule, `has_text_in`; also a redundant `NotFound.__init__`. | **Partly fixed.** The slug pattern is now `guides.SLUG`, used by both. `form_text` lives in `app/web.py`. The redundant `__init__` is gone. **Not changed:** the publishability check (its messages differ: Guides say 提交审核前, Pages and Tournament items 发布前) and the one-line `has_text_in`, which templates call as a method on each kind. |\n| 7 | The Tournament preview wrote out \"Announcement\"/\"Recap\"/比赛日期 again instead of using the site's words. | **Fixed.** The preview line is built from `publish.LABELS`. |\n| 8 | `RESERVED_SLUGS` is a hand-kept copy of the folders the Site build writes, so a later folder might not be reserved. | **Fixed with a test instead of moving the constant** (`publish` imports `content`, so the constant can't live in `publish`). `test_every_folder_the_site_build_makes_is_a_slug_no_page_can_take` builds a site with every kind of content and fails if any folder in a language tree is not in `RESERVED_SLUGS`. |\n| 9 | The new Tournament item form read the Patches twice. | **Fixed.** The editor picks the Current Patch from the list it already loads. |\n| 10 | The Site build filtered the navigation's Pages again for every file it wrote. | **Fixed.** `_Writer` works out each tree's navigation once. |\n\n## Decisions not spelled out in the ticket\n\nAsked and answered this session:\n- **Deleting** a Page or Tournament item is for good, after a confirmation page. The Trash stays for Guides only.\n- **攻略 in the navigation** leads to a new Guides index (`guides/`), listing every Published Guide in that tree, newest first. The spec's Site build lists it, but T04 had not built it.\n- **Pages appear in the navigation in the order they were added.**\n- **The dashboard count includes Pages and Tournament items:** Published, edited while Published, Unpublished, or deleted while on the site.\n\nMade while building:\n- **Who:** a new capability, `manage_pages`, held by Admins. Both route modules sit behind `requires(\"manage_pages\")`, so T09's router walk covers all 20 routes (Editors get 403), and `content.py` refuses anyone without it too.\n- **Page slugs** are lowercase ASCII letters, digits and hyphens (the Guide slug pattern), unique, and can't be `guides`, `heroes`, `authors` or `tournaments`. An Admin can change one later; the form says old links then break.\n- **To Publish** (and to save while Published), a Page or Tournament item needs a Chinese title and body, and English text either whole or not at all.\n- **The 锦标赛 list** is newest Tournament date first (on one day, the one added last first). Each item shows 预告/回顾 (Announcement/Recap in English), its date and Patch.\n- **A Tournament item** may use any Patch, with the Current Patch preselected. A recap may link to any announcement. The site shows that link only while the announcement is Published and on the same language tree. Deleting an announcement, or making it a recap, unlinks its recaps.\n- **Tournament ids are never reused** (AUTOINCREMENT), since an item's address is `tournaments/<id>/`.\n- **Language switch:** a Chinese-only Page's switch leads to the English home page, and a Chinese-only Tournament item's switch leads to the English 锦标赛 list. Use the user's domain language from `GLOSSARY.md`.\n\n### Summary\n\nPick the smallest view that makes the key point clear.\n\n- Show logic or an algorithm as pseudocode:\n\n```text\non(save)\n  if content is unchanged\n    return cached result\n  write new content\n  return fresh result\n```\n\n- Show runtime control flow as a call tree:\n\n```text\nsubmitForm\n  createSession\n    persistPrompt\n    launchAgent\n  navigateToSession\n```\n\n- Show UI structure as a component tree, including state and module boundaries that matter:\n\n```text\n<SessionPage> (apps/example/src/routes/session.tsx)\n  useSessionEvents()\n  <SessionToolbar>\n    <RunSkillButton> (packages/ui)\n```\n\n- Show file responsibility or a broad refactor as a shallow file tree:\n\n```text\nsrc/\n├── commands/       # parses user actions\n├── sessions/       # owns session state\n└── transport/      # sends API requests\n```\n\n- Show component interaction, control flow, or data flow with Mermaid:\n\n```mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    participant User\n    participant UI\n    participant Daemon\n    User->>UI: choose command\n    UI->>Daemon: send expanded prompt\n    Daemon-->>UI: stream result\n```\n\n- Use `diff` when the point is what changes and the surrounding shape already exists. Match the diff shape to the topic.\n\nFor a component change:\n\n```diff\n <SessionPage>\n   useSessionEvents()\n   <SessionToolbar>\n+    <RunSkillButton />\n   <SessionTimeline>\n+    <SkillResultCard />\n```\n\nFor a file-layout change:\n\n```diff\n src/\n ├── commands/\n+│   └── show-me.ts       # expands the slash command\n ├── sessions/\n-└── transport.ts\n+└── transport/\n+    ├── client.ts\n+    └── stream.ts\n```\n\nFor a call-tree or call-stack change:\n\n```diff\n submitForm\n   createSession\n     persistPrompt\n+    expandSkillMention\n     launchAgent\n-  navigateToSession\n+  navigateToSession\n+    subscribeToEvents\n```\n\nFor a state or control-flow change:\n\n```diff\n on(save)\n-  write content\n+  if content is unchanged\n+    return cached result\n+  write new content\n+  invalidate cache\n```\n\n- Show the whole block when most of it is new, when omitted context would hide ownership or order, or when the user needs a copyable target shape:\n\n```ts\nfunction expandSkill(command: string): string {\n  const skillName = command.slice(1);\n  return `use the ${skillName} skill`;\n}\n```\n\n#### Guidance\n\nPlace each visual next to the short text it supports. Keep only the calls, files, props, states, and boundaries needed to answer the user's current question or the options to resolve the current discussion point.\n\nYou may use one of these, you may use several, it is unlikely you will use all of them. Use your judgement and don't overwhelm the user.\n\n### Evidence\n\nConcrete evidence that the change works. Show a before and after.\n\nScreenshots are S-tier - when the environment is set up for it and the change is visual.\n\nExecution-based evidence is A-tier. Test results, console output. Show the exact test that now fails and passes, using pseudocode.\n\n### Merge Danger\n\nDescribe whether it's a one-way or two-way door. You can walk back through two-way doors, but not one-way doors. A PR that is cheap to roll back is lower risk. Changes that involve destructive actions or hard-to-reverse decisions are one-way doors.\n\nThe blast radius is the potential impact or scope of the changes introduced by this PR. Consider all possibilities. Examples are layout shift, breakages for consumers, mobile responsiveness, etc.\n"}]}}

{"parentUuid":"abfa4997-b4d0-42fc-9d2a-4971f32a5a8d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8yb2KxpSnnrDCTMNoej","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01EvKcEaLHpQm9ntFxtnqJb7","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5/scratchpad/t08_pr_body.md","content":"Closes #9\n\n## Summary\n\nAdmins write Pages and Tournament items (预告 / 回顾) with no review. The public navigation is built from them.\n\n```diff\n site/zh/                          (en/ the same, items with English text only)\n ├── index.html                    # home\n+├── guides/index.html             # 攻略: every Published Guide, newest first\n ├── guides/<slug>/  heroes/<slug>/  authors/<id>/\n+├── tournaments/index.html        # 锦标赛: newest Tournament date first, badged 预告/回顾\n+├── tournaments/<id>/             # a recap links to its Published announcement\n+└── <page-slug>/                  # each Published Page, e.g. about/\n```\n\nEvery page's header gains `<nav class=\"site-nav\">`: 攻略 · 锦标赛 · then the Published Pages, in the order added.\n\n```text\napp/\n├── content.py              # new: Pages + Tournament items, Draft/Published, delete for good\n├── routes/pages.py         # new: /admin/pages/...        (requires manage_pages)\n├── routes/tournaments.py   # new: /admin/tournaments/...  (requires manage_pages)\n├── publish.py              # nav, guides/, tournaments/, pages; dashboard count\n└── web.py                  # shared form_text + id_or_none (Guide forms use it too)\n```\n\n```text\nPage / Tournament item:  Draft --publish--> Published --unpublish--> Draft\n                         either --delete (after confirmation)--> gone for good\n```\n\n## Evidence\n\n- **Before:** `render_site` wrote no navigation, and no `guides/` or `tournaments/` pages. `/admin/pages` and `/admin/tournaments` were 404s.\n  **After:** `uv run pytest -q` gives **422 passed** (327 at T07's handoff), and pyright reports 0 errors. New tests:\n  - `tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py` (Seam 1 + Seam 2), for example:\n    - `test_a_published_page_appears_in_the_navigation_of_every_page_after_guides_and_tournaments`\n    - `test_the_tournament_list_is_newest_first_by_tournament_date_with_badges`\n    - `test_a_recap_links_to_its_announcement_on_its_public_page`\n    - `test_draft_tournament_items_and_chinese_only_ones_stay_off_the_trees`\n    - `test_every_page_and_tournament_route_is_behind_an_admin_only_guard` (20 routes; T09's router walk adds 40 Editor and signed-out checks on its own)\n  - `tests/test_t08_seed.py`: the seed builds an About Page, an announcement and its recap.\n  - `tests/test_console_links.py`: every new console page links relatively.\n- **Mutation check:** breaking the Tournament sort order, or dropping the recap link, turns the matching tests red.\n- **`/browse`:** new site and console pages at 1280 and 390 px; `scrollWidth` is 390 on every page at 390px.\n- **`/code-review`:** 10 findings and how each was resolved: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/9#issuecomment-6244981244\n\n## Merge Danger\n\n**Door:** two-way\n\nThe schema changes are additive: new tables `pages`, `tournament_items` and `removed_content`, created on connect. Reverting the code leaves those tables unused and harmless. Nothing existing is altered or deleted.\n\n**Blast Radius:** site-wide\n\n- Every generated public page gains the navigation bar, and `guides/` is new in both trees.\n- The Guide forms now parse ids through `web.id_or_none`. Odd input (`²`, an overlong number) now gets the form's message instead of a 500; normal ids behave as before.\n- The dashboard count can be higher than before, since it now includes Page and Tournament changes.\n- Re-running `scripts/seed_demo.py` on the real `cms.db` adds the demo About Page and Tournament items, but only if none exist yet.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":574,"cache_read_input_tokens":291159,"output_tokens":1581,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":24},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":574,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1581,"cache_read_input_tokens":291159,"cache_creation_input_tokens":574,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":574},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01EvKcEaLHpQm9ntFxtnqJb7":{"file_path":"/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5/scratchpad/t08_pr_body.md","content":"Closes #9\n\n## Summary\n\nAdmins write Pages and Tournament items (预告 / 回顾) with no review. (requires manage_pages)\n├── routes/tournaments.py   # new: /admin/tournaments/...  (requires manage_pages)\n├── publish.py              # nav, guides/, tournaments/, pages; dashboard count\n└── web.py                  # shared form_text + id_or_none (Guide forms use it too)\n```\n\n```text\nPage / Tournament item:  Draft --publish--> Published --unpublish--> Draft\n                         either --delete (after confirmation)--> gone for good\n```\n\n## Evidence\n\n- **Before:** `render_site` wrote no navigation, and no `guides/` or `tournaments/` pages. `/admin/pages` and `/admin/tournaments` were 404s.\n  **After:** `uv run pytest -q` gives **422 passed** (327 at T07's handoff), and pyright reports 0 errors. New tests:\n  - `tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py` (Seam 1 + Seam 2), for example:\n    - `test_a_published_page_appears_in_the_navigation_of_every_page_after_guides_and_tournaments`\n    - `test_the_tournament_list_is_newest_first_by_tournament_date_with_badges`\n    - `test_a_recap_links_to_its_announcement_on_its_public_page`\n    - `test_draft_tournament_items_and_chinese_only_ones_stay_off_the_trees`\n    - `test_every_page_and_tournament_route_is_behind_an_admin_only_guard` (20 routes; T09's router walk adds 40 Editor and signed-out checks on its own)\n  - `tests/test_t08_seed.py`: the seed builds an About Page, an announcement and its recap.\n  - `tests/test_console_links.py`: every new console page links relatively.\n- **Mutation check:** breaking the Tournament sort order, or dropping the recap link, turns the matching tests red.\n- **`/browse`:** new site and console pages at 1280 and 390 px; `scrollWidth` is 390 on every page at 390px.\n- **`/code-review`:** 10 findings and how each was resolved: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/9#issuecomment-6244981244\n\n## Merge Danger\n\n**Door:** two-way\n\nThe schema changes are additive: new tables `pages`, `tournament_items` and `removed_content`, created on connect. Reverting the code leaves those tables unused and harmless. Nothing existing is altered or deleted.\n\n**Blast Radius:** site-wide\n\n- Every generated public page gains the navigation bar, and `guides/` is new in both trees.\n- The Guide forms now parse ids through `web.id_or_none`. Odd input (`²`, an overlong number) now gets the form's message instead of a 500; normal ids behave as before.\n- The dashboard count can be higher than before, since it now includes Page and Tournament changes.\n- Re-running `scripts/seed_demo.py` on the real `cms.db` adds the demo About Page and Tournament items, but only if none exist yet.\n"}},"apiBlockIndex":2,"requestId":"req_011Cg8yb22rjehWhVKtxK9zF","requestRef":"a30ec221-7a73-43a0-abc1-35dd8d29f929","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:pr","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"11f0c489-f2d3-46d2-8a39-4a37369837c7","timestamp":"2026-10-18T03:16:20.945Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

The public navigation is built from them.\n\n```diff\n site/zh/                          (en/ the same, items with English text only)\n ├── index.html                    # home\n+├── guides/index.html             # 攻略: every Published Guide, newest first\n ├── guides/<slug>/  heroes/<slug>/  authors/<id>/\n+├── tournaments/index.html        # 锦标赛: newest Tournament date first, badged 预告/回顾\n+├── tournaments/<id>/             # a recap links to its Published announcement\n+└── <page-slug>/                  # each Published Page, e.g. about/\n```\n\nEvery page's header gains `<nav class=\"site-nav\">`: 攻略 · 锦标赛 · then the Published Pages, in the order added.\n\n```text\napp/\n├── content.py              # new: Pages + Tournament items, Draft/Published, delete for good\n├── routes/pages.py         # new: /admin/pages/...        (requires manage_pages)\n├── routes/tournaments.py   # new: /admin/tournaments/...  (requires manage_pages)\n├── publish.py              # nav, guides/, tournaments/, pages; dashboard count\n└── web.py                  # shared form_text + id_or_none (Guide forms use it too)\n```\n\n```text\nPage / Tournament item:  Draft --publish--> Published --unpublish--> Draft\n                         either --delete (after confirmation)--> gone for good\n```\n\n## Evidence\n\n- **Before:** `render_site` wrote no navigation, and no `guides/` or `tournaments/` pages. `/admin/pages` and `/admin/tournaments` were 404s.\n  **After:** `uv run pytest -q` gives **422 passed** (327 at T07's handoff), and pyright reports 0 errors. New tests:\n  - `tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py` (Seam 1 + Seam 2), for example:\n    - `test_a_published_page_appears_in_the_navigation_of_every_page_after_guides_and_tournaments`\n    - `test_the_tournament_list_is_newest_first_by_tournament_date_with_badges`\n    - `test_a_recap_links_to_its_announcement_on_its_public_page`\n    - `test_draft_tournament_items_and_chinese_only_ones_stay_off_the_trees`\n    - `test_every_page_and_tournament_route_is_behind_an_admin_only_guard` (20 routes; T09's router walk adds 40 Editor and signed-out checks on its own)\n  - `tests/test_t08_seed.py`: the seed builds an About Page, an announcement and its recap.\n  - `tests/test_console_links.py`: every new console page links relatively.\n- **Mutation check:** breaking the Tournament sort order, or dropping the recap link, turns the matching tests red.\n- **`/browse`:** new site and console pages at 1280 and 390 px; `scrollWidth` is 390 on every page at 390px.\n- **`/code-review`:** 10 findings and how each was resolved: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/9#issuecomment-6244981244\n\n## Merge Danger\n\n**Door:** two-way\n\nThe schema changes are additive: new tables `pages`, `tournament_items` and `removed_content`, created on connect. Reverting the code leaves those tables unused and harmless. Nothing existing is altered or deleted.\n\n**Blast Radius:** site-wide\n\n- Every generated public page gains the navigation bar, and `guides/` is new in both trees.\n- The Guide forms now parse ids through `web.id_or_none`. Odd input (`²`, an overlong number) now gets the form's message instead of a 500; normal ids behave as before.\n- The dashboard count can be higher than before, since it now includes Page and Tournament changes.\n- Re-running `scripts/seed_demo.py` on the real `cms.db` adds the demo About Page and Tournament items, but only if none exist yet.\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"11f0c489-f2d3-46d2-8a39-4a37369837c7","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"2c08b19a-332e-4500-99df-a017af7bdde5","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

The PR body has the site layout, file map, test evidence and\n  merge danger.\n- The `/code-review` findings, how each was resolved, the four product choices the user made (delete for good,\n  攻略 → new Guides index, Pages in the order added, dashboard counts Pages and Tournament items), and the\n  decisions made while building are in https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/9#issuecomment-6244981244\n- **All core tickets are now done.** At handoff, 422 tests passed and pyright reported 0 errors.\n- **Not committed yet:**\n  - `notes/usage-ledger.csv`;\n  - `docs/handoff/03_t09-to-next_20261017.md`, `docs/handoff/04_t07-to-next_20261017.md` and this file;\n  - transcripts 15 and 16 (`docs/transcripts/iphs400_mp2-cms_chat-session_1{5,6}_nick-chen_20261017.md`).\n\n  They go into the next \"Add transcript NN\" commit, with this session's transcript (17) and the ledger rows.\n  Run the credential scan first (see the conventions below).\n- `.claude/state/phase` says `T08`. Update it when the next stage starts.\n- **The real `cms.db` has not been re-seeded since T08.** Running `scripts/seed_demo.py` in the main checkout\n  would add the demo About Page and the September announcement and recap, but only if no Page or Tournament\n  item exists yet. Ask the user before running it.\n\n## Next tickets (open issues; ask the user which one to take)\n\n- **#25: Show console and site times in Beijing time, plus scrolling tables for the Guide list and the Trash.**\n  - No labels on purpose. Times stay stored in UTC.\n  - **T08 added time displays the issue doesn't list yet:**\n    - `templates/admin/page_edit.html` (更新于 `page.updated_at`, full timestamp);\n    - `templates/admin/pages.html` (`updated_at[:16]`);\n    - `templates/admin/tournament_edit.html` (更新于 `item.updated_at`).\n\n    The new site page `guides/` reuses `site/_guides.html`, so it is covered once that macro is.\n    `tournament_date` is a calendar date the Admin types, not a timestamp: don't convert it.\n  - The new console tables (`pages.html`, `tournaments.html`) are already wrapped in `<div class=\"scroll\">`.\n- #11 S1 images (stretch). The spec lets a Tournament item own images and have an optional cover. T08 left\n  covers out on purpose, for this ticket.\n- #12 S2 hosted console (stretch, last; ADR-003 supersedes ADR-001 then).\n\nRead the ticket, spec #1 (`gh issue view 1`), and `CONTEXT.md` before coding, as `CLAUDE.md` requires.\n\n## What the next tickets must fit around (from T08, not obvious from the spec)\n\n- **`app/content.py` owns Pages and Tournament items.** Every function takes the acting user and refuses anyone\n  without the new capability `manage_pages`. Both route modules (`app/routes/pages.py`, `app/routes/tournaments.py`)\n  sit behind `requires(\"manage_pages\")`.\n- **Shared helpers moved this session.** Use them rather than writing new ones:\n  - `web.form_text` and `web.id_or_none`: the latter rejects non-ASCII digits and ids above SQLite's maximum;\n    the Guide routes use both now;\n  - `guides.SLUG`: the slug pattern for Guides and Pages;\n  - `rendering.preview_warnings`: the labelled 游戏术语检查 list for any preview;\n  - `admin/content_preview.html` with `routes.pages.preview_page`: the preview for anything matching the\n    `content.TextBearing` protocol.\n- **The dashboard count** (`publish.changes_not_on_site`) adds `content.changes_since`:\n  - Each Page and Tournament row has `site_changed_at`, set on Publish, on an edit while Published, and on\n    Unpublish.\n  - Items deleted after they were ever Published go into `removed_content`.\n  - When an announcement changes on the site, its Published recaps are marked changed too\n    (`_recaps_change_with`).\n  - A new change that alters what the site shows must set `site_changed_at` the same way.\n- **Site build** (`app/publish.py`):\n  - `_Writer` gets `nav_pages` and works out each tree's navigation once.\n  - New `LABELS` keys: `guides`, `tournaments`, `announcement`, `recap`, `tournament_date`,\n    `no_tournament_items`, `follows`.\n  - A Chinese-only Page's language switch falls back to `en/#no-english-text`, a Chinese-only Tournament item's to\n    `en/tournaments/#no-english-text`. Both pages carry the `.fallback-notice` paragraph.\n  - **A new top-level folder in a language tree must be added to `content.RESERVED_SLUGS`,** or\n    `test_every_folder_the_site_build_makes_is_a_slug_no_page_can_take` fails. That is on purpose: otherwise a\n    Page slug could overwrite the folder.\n- **Tournament item ids are AUTOINCREMENT**, because the public address is `tournaments/<id>/`.\n- **`_trimmed` (PEP 695 generic syntax)** is fine: `pyproject.toml` requires Python ≥ 3.12.\n\n## Working conventions\n\nEverything in the \"Working conventions\" sections of handoffs 01 to 04 (`docs/handoff/0{1,2,3,4}_*.md`) still holds:\n- the typecheck and test commands,\n- the review comment before the closing commit,\n- the commit and PR style,\n- transcript commits and the credential scan,\n- `/browse` for visual checks,\n- adding each new console page to `tests/test_console_links.py`,\n- checking `scrollWidth` at 390px,\n- reading `implement/SKILL.md` by hand for `/implement #N`,\n- `git add -N` before `/code-review`.\n\nAdditions this session:\n- **T08 test helpers** in `tests/test_t08_pages_tournaments.py`:\n  - Pages: `new_page`, `save_page`, `page_act` (publish/unpublish), `published_page`; the constant `PAGE`.\n  - Tournament items: `add_tournament_item` (returns the response), `new_tournament_item`,\n    `published_tournament_item`, `save_tournament_item`, `tournament_form_values`, `announcement_option`; the\n    constant `TOURNAMENT_ITEM`.\n  - Site: `navigation(site, path)`, `tournament_list(site, lang)`, `generated_pages(site, lang)`,\n    `assert_fallback_notice(site, path, lands_on)`.\n  - `test_t03_guides.form_values` misses radio buttons and `type=\"date\"` inputs. Use `tournament_form_values`\n    for those forms.\n- **`rtk` can swallow `gh` output:** `gh issue view 9 --comments` printed nothing. Use\n  `rtk proxy gh issue view N --json title,body,comments`, and `rtk proxy gh api …` for single comments.\n- **A `cd` inside a Bash call moves the session's working directory.** Use absolute paths.\n- **Mutation check:** when a slice's tests pass at first run because the code was written ahead, break the\n  behavior on purpose (copy the file to the scratchpad, `sed` the change, run, copy back) to prove the tests can\n  fail. Mention it in the review comment or PR.\n- **`/browse` pages for T08** were saved by a scratch script (now gone with the scratchpad). To recreate it:\n  1. Run `scripts/seed_demo.py` with `CMS_DATABASE` pointing at a scratch file and throwaway\n     `CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD` / `CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD`.\n  2. Call `render_site(\".gstack/t08/site\")`.\n  3. Log in with `conftest.login` on a `TestClient`.\n  4. Write each console page's HTML to `.gstack/t08/console/`.\n  5. Screenshot with `$B viewport 1280x900` and `390x844`, then `$B js \"document.documentElement.scrollWidth\"`.\n- **PR flow used for #27:**\n  - Write the body with the `mattpocock-skills:pr` template, then add the 🤖 attribution line.\n  - Run `gh pr create --base main --head Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2`.\n  - Check mergeability with `rtk proxy gh pr view N --json mergeable,mergeStateStatus`.\n  - Merge with `gh pr merge N --merge`. Never `--delete-branch`.\n- **No `Backend:` trailer** this session: no non-Anthropic base URL was set.\n\n## Suggested skills\n\n- `mattpocock-skills:tdd`: red→green per slice at Seam 1 (console over HTTP) and Seam 2 (`render_site`). Confirm\n  any seam beyond those with the user first.\n- `code-review` (built-in, runs in the background): post its findings, and how each was resolved, on the issue\n  before the closing commit.\n- `mattpocock-skills:pr`: the PR body template used for #22 to #24, #26 and #27.\n- `browse`: visual check of changed console or site pages at 1280 and 390 px (never the `mcp__claude-in-chrome__*`\n  tools, per the user's global `CLAUDE.md`).\n- `mattpocock-skills:domain-modeling`: #25 brings a display-time rule (stored UTC, shown in Beijing time) worth a\n  line in `CONTEXT.md` or an ADR.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":4,"cache_creation_input_tokens":417,"cache_read_input_tokens":295454,"output_tokens":4737,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":1024},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":417,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":4,"output_tokens":4737,"cache_read_input_tokens":295454,"cache_creation_input_tokens":417,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":417},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01FeXALhpyyWMM2zvbBNUPd7":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/docs/handoff/05_t08-to-next_20261017.md","content":"# Handoff: 大巴扎攻略站 CMS, after T08\n\nRepo: `/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2` (a git worktree on branch\n`Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2`, reused for every ticket;
